	public class PsvScrollContainer : ScrollViewer
	{
		private enum ScrollEventSearchResult
		{
			KeepSearching,
			Accept,
			Reject
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewMouseWheel(MouseWheelEventArgs e)
		{
			for (DependencyObject dependencyObject = (DependencyObject)e.OriginalSource; dependencyObject != null && dependencyObject != this; dependencyObject = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject))
			{
				switch (_ShouldAcceptScrollEvent(dependencyObject))
				{
				case ScrollEventSearchResult.Reject:
					break;
				default:
					continue;
				case ScrollEventSearchResult.Accept:
					return;
				}
				e.Handled = true;
				break;
			}
			MouseWheelEventArgs e2 = new MouseWheelEventArgs(e.MouseDevice, e.Timestamp, e.Delta)
			{
				RoutedEvent = UIElement.MouseWheelEvent,
				Source = this
			};
			RaiseEvent(e2);
		}

		private ScrollEventSearchResult _ShouldAcceptScrollEvent(DependencyObject p)
		{
			if (p is ScrollViewer && p != this)
			{
				if (((ScrollViewer)p).ComputedVerticalScrollBarVisibility == Visibility.Visible)
				{
					return ScrollEventSearchResult.Accept;
				}
				return ScrollEventSearchResult.KeepSearching;
			}
			if (p is System.Windows.Controls.ComboBox)
			{
				if (((System.Windows.Controls.ComboBox)p).IsDropDownOpen)
				{
					return ScrollEventSearchResult.Accept;
				}
				return ScrollEventSearchResult.Reject;
			}
			if (LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(p) is Popup)
			{
				return ScrollEventSearchResult.Accept;
			}
			if (p is PsvScrollContainer && p != this)
			{
				return ScrollEventSearchResult.Accept;
			}
			return ScrollEventSearchResult.KeepSearching;
		}
	}

		private void InitializeDataGrid()
		{
			//IL_00aa: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b1: Expected O, but got Unknown
			List<FlashDataTableItem> list = new List<FlashDataTableItem>();
			if (vm.FIREIterationList != null)
			{
				foreach (IterationResultRLCFireModel fIREIteration in vm.FIREIterationList)
				{
					FlashDataTableItem item = new FlashDataTableItem(fIREIteration);
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			((DataPresenterBase)FlashData_Grid).DataSource = null;
			((DataPresenterBase)FlashData_Grid).DataSource = list;
			DataTable compositionDataSourceTable = GetCompositionDataSourceTable(list);
			if (compositionDataSourceTable != null)
			{
				((Collection<Field>)(object)CompLayout.Fields).Clear();
				foreach (DataColumn column in compositionDataSourceTable.Columns)
				{
					Field val = new Field();
					((FieldItem)val).Name = column.ColumnName;
					val.Settings.CellMinWidth = 70.0;
					if (Operators.CompareString(((FieldItem)val).Name, "Maximum", TextCompare: false) == 0)
					{
						((FieldItem)val).Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
					}
					((FieldItem)val).Label = column.ColumnName;
					((Collection<Field>)(object)CompLayout.Fields).Add(val);
				}
				((DataPresenterBase)CompositionData_Grid).FieldLayoutSettings.AutoGenerateFields = false;
				((DataPresenterBase)CompositionData_Grid).DataSource = null;
				((DataPresenterBase)CompositionData_Grid).DataSource = compositionDataSourceTable.DefaultView;
			}
			ShowZ_K_MW();
		}

		private void ShowZ_K_MW()
		{

		public DataTable GetCompositionDataSourceTable(List<FlashDataTableItem> dataS)
		{
			checked
			{
				if (vm.FireStoreStepCompostions)
				{
					((DataPresenterBase)CompositionData_Grid).DataSource = null;
					DataTable dataTable = new DataTable();
					dataTable.Columns.Add(new DataColumn(FormResource.lbl_Time));
					int num = 1;
					dataTable.Columns.Add(new DataColumn(FormResource.lbl_PercentVaporized));
					num++;
					if (vm.FireComponents != null && vm.FireComponents.Count() > 0)
					{
						string[] fireComponents = vm.FireComponents;
						foreach (string columnName in fireComponents)
						{
							DataColumn column = new DataColumn(columnName);
							dataTable.Columns.Add(column);
						}
						if (vm.FIREIterationList != null && vm.FIREIterationList.Count > 0)
						{
							DataColumn column2 = new DataColumn("Maximum");
							dataTable.Columns.Add(column2);
							foreach (IterationResultRLCFireModel fIREIteration in vm.FIREIterationList)
							{
								DataRow dataRow = dataTable.NewRow();
								dataRow[0] = dataS[vm.FIREIterationList.IndexOf(fIREIteration)].Time;
								dataRow[1] = dataS[vm.FIREIterationList.IndexOf(fIREIteration)].PctVap;
								int num2 = fIREIteration.Compositions.Count() - 1;
								for (int j = 0; j <= num2; j++)
								{
									dataRow[j + num] = fIREIteration.Compositions[j];
								}
								dataRow[dataTable.Columns.Count - 1] = dataS[vm.FIREIterationList.IndexOf(fIREIteration)].Maximum;
								dataTable.Rows.Add(dataRow);
							}
							return dataTable;
						}
						return WarningMessageTable(FormResource.NoIterationResult);
					}
					return WarningMessageTable(FormResource.NoComponent);
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public DataTable WarningMessageTable(string msg)
		{
			DataTable dataTable = new DataTable();
			DataColumn column = new DataColumn
			{
				ColumnName = FormResource.tbl_Message
			};
			dataTable.Columns.Add(column);
			DataRow dataRow = dataTable.NewRow();
			dataRow[column] = msg;
			dataTable.Rows.Add(dataRow);
			return dataTable;
		}

		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(Conversions.ToString(value)))
			{
				return System.Windows.Data.Binding.DoNothing;

			string left = value.ToString();
			string right = parameter.ToString();
			if (Operators.CompareString(left, right, TextCompare: false) == 0)

				return Visibility.Visible;

		}

		private event Action<int, PipeElementType> TypeChanged;

		public LineSizingPipeElementProxy(IUnityContainer unityContainer)
		{
			_doubleDataRule = base.IsNanOrValidNonNegativeValue;
			_isReadOnly = false;
			_type = PipeElementType.Segment;
			_name = string.Empty;
			_nd = double.NaN;
			_container = unityContainer;
			if (_registerDict == null)
			{
				RegisterDict();
			}
		}

		public void Initialize(ILineSizingPipeElement lineSizingPipeElement, Action<int, PipeElementType> onTypeChanged)
		{
			_lineSizingSettingsModel = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<LineSizingSettingsModel>(_container, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]);
			_lineSizingPipeElement = lineSizingPipeElement;
			TypeChanged += onTypeChanged;
			OnSizeChanged();
		}

		public void Initialize(string name, PipeElementType? type, double valveSize)
		{
			_lineSizingSettingsModel = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<LineSizingSettingsModel>(_container, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]);
			_name = name;
			_type = type;
			_nd = valveSize;
			_isReadOnly = true;
		}

		private ILineSizingMaterial GetMaterial(string materialName)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(materialName) && Operators.CompareString(materialName, FormResource.rls_UserSpecified, TextCompare: false) != 0)
			{
				return _lineSizingSettingsModel.PipeMaterials.Where([SpecialName] (ILineSizingMaterial matl) => Operators.CompareString(matl.Name, materialName, TextCompare: false) == 0).SingleOrDefault();
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override bool SetValue<T>(ref T storage, object value, Predicate<T> rule, [CallerMemberName] string propertyName = null)
		{
			if (_lineSizingPipeElement.ElementType.HasValue && _registerDict[propertyName].HasFlag(_lineSizingPipeElement.ElementType.GetValueOrDefault()) && value != null)
			{
				return base.SetValue(ref storage, RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(value), rule, propertyName);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool SetValueWithSmallLength(ref double storage, object value, [CallerMemberName] string propertyName = null)
		{
			bool result;
			try
			{
				double inputVal = (double)Convert.ChangeType(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(value), typeof(double));
				value = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(DefaultUnits.Instance.SmallLengthDisplayUnit, UnitStrings.SmallLength_in, inputVal, "SmallLength");
				result = SetValue(ref storage, RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(value), _doubleDataRule, propertyName);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				ProjectData.SetProjectError(ex);
				Exception ex2 = ex;
				result = false;
				ProjectData.ClearProjectError();
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected bool SetValueWithLength(ref double storage, object value, Predicate<double> rule = null, [CallerMemberName] string propertyName = null)
		{
			bool result;
			try
			{
				double inputVal = (double)Convert.ChangeType(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(value), typeof(double));
				value = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(DefaultUnits.Instance.LengthDisplayUnit, UnitStrings.Length_m, inputVal, "Length");
				result = SetValue(ref storage, RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(value), (rule == null) ? _doubleDataRule : rule, propertyName);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				ProjectData.SetProjectError(ex);
				Exception ex2 = ex;
				result = false;
				ProjectData.ClearProjectError();
			}
			return result;
		}

		private object GetValueWithSmallLength(double? field, [CallerMemberName] string propertyName = null)
		{
			if (Information.IsNothing(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(GetValueBaseOnState(field, propertyName)))))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.SmallLength_in, DefaultUnits.Instance.SmallLengthDisplayUnit, field.Value, "SmallLength");
		}

		private object GetValueWithLength(double? field, [CallerMemberName] string propertyName = null)
		{
			if (Information.IsNothing(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(GetValueBaseOnState(field, propertyName)))))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.Length_m, DefaultUnits.Instance.LengthDisplayUnit, field.Value, "Length");
		}

		private object GetValueBaseOnState(object field, [CallerMemberName] string propertyName = null)
		{
			if (field == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (IsReadOnly && (Operators.CompareString(field.ToString(), double.NaN.ToString(), TextCompare: false) == 0 || Operators.CompareString(field.ToString(), string.Empty, TextCompare: false) == 0))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (_lineSizingPipeElement.ElementType.HasValue && _registerDict[propertyName].HasFlag(_lineSizingPipeElement.ElementType.GetValueOrDefault()))
			{
				return field;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void RegisterDict()
		{
			_registerDict = new Dictionary<string, PipeElementType>
			{
				{
					"FittingType",
					PipeElementType.Fitting | PipeElementType.Tee
				},
				{
					"FlowMultiple",
					PipeElementType.All
				},
				{
					"Schedule",
					PipeElementType.All
				},
				{
					"ND",
					PipeElementType.All
				},
				{
					"ID",
					PipeElementType.All
				},
				{
					"Thickness",
					PipeElementType.All
				},
				{
					"Material",
					PipeElementType.Segment | PipeElementType.Fitting | PipeElementType.Tee
				},
				{
					"Roughness",
					PipeElementType.Segment | PipeElementType.Fitting | PipeElementType.Tee
				},
				{
					"Length",
					PipeElementType.Segment
				},
				{
					"Elevation",
					PipeElementType.Segment
				},
				{
					"K",
					PipeElementType.Fitting | PipeElementType.Swage | PipeElementType.Tee
				},
				{
					"LD",
					PipeElementType.Fitting
				},
				{
					"Quantity",
					PipeElementType.Fitting
				},
				{
					"Source",
					PipeElementType.Fitting
				},
				{
					"Angle",
					PipeElementType.Swage
				}
			};
		}

		private bool GetIsReadOnlyValue([CallerMemberName] string propertyName = null)
		{
			if (!_isReadOnly && _lineSizingPipeElement.ElementType.HasValue)
			{
				return !_registerDict[propertyName.Replace("IsReadOnly", "")].HasFlag(_lineSizingPipeElement.ElementType.GetValueOrDefault());
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void OnLineSizingPipeElementChanged()
		{
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("Name");
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("Type");
		}

		private void OnTypeChanged()
		{
			foreach (string key in _registerDict.Keys)
			{
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged(key);
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged(key + "IsReadOnly");
			}
			OnSizeChanged();
		}

		private void OnNDChanged()
		{
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("Schedule");
			OnSizeChanged();
		}

		private void OnMaterialChanged()
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, PipeElementType> item in _registerDict)
			{
				if (item.Value == PipeElementType.Segment)
				{
					NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged(item.Key);
				}
			}
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("RoughnessIsReadOnly");
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("Roughness");
		}

		private void OnFittingTypeChanged()
		{
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("K");
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("LD");
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("Source");
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("KIsReadOnly");
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("LDIsReadOnly");
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("SourceIsReadOnly");
		}

		private void OnActualSizeSelected(double innerDiameter, double wallThickness)
		{
			double innerDiameter2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(DefaultUnits.Instance.SmallLengthDisplayUnit, PSVScenarioModel.UOMPipeDiameter, innerDiameter, "SmallLength");
			double wallThickness2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(DefaultUnits.Instance.SmallLengthDisplayUnit, PSVScenarioModel.UOMPipeDiameter, wallThickness, "SmallLength");
			_lineSizingPipeElement.SpecifySizeAsActualSize(innerDiameter2, wallThickness2);
		}

		private void OnSizeChanged()
		{
			double ID = double.NaN;
			double WallThickness = double.NaN;
			if (Operators.CompareString(Schedule, FormResource.LineSizingSchedule_Actual, TextCompare: false) != 0)
			{
				if (ND != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(Schedule))
				{
					double nominalDiameter = Convert.ToDouble(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(ND), CultureInfo.CurrentCulture.NumberFormat);
					PipeSizeDataService.GetDiameterAndThickness(Schedule, nominalDiameter, out ID, out WallThickness);
				}
				_lineSizingPipeElement.SpecifySizeAsSchedulePipe(ID, WallThickness);
			}
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("ID");
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("Thickness");
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("IDIsReadOnly");
		}
	}

				}
				return FormResource.cmb_Absent;

			{

					mSceSettings.FireDrainage = true;

				else
				{
					mSceSettings.FireDrainage = false;
				}
			}
		}

		}

		public PreferencesManagerViewModel(IUnityContainer unityContainer)
			: base(unityContainer)
		{
			myOPDefaults = null;
			myVaporizedPcts = null;
			myCoeffCs = null;
			DisengagementRegimes = TranslateUiStrings.DisengagementRegime.StringValues;
			DisengagementVesselFlowModels = TranslateUiStrings.DisengagementVesselFlowModel.StringValues;

		public void Initialize(string nodeKey, IPsvCase psvcase, PsvKey psvkey)
		{
			mPSVSettings = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<PSVSettingsModel>(uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]);
			mSceSettings = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ScenarioSettingsModel>(uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]);
			mLSSettings = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<LineSizingSettingsModel>(uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]);
			mTankSettings = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<TankSettingsModel>(uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]);
			mOrificeSettings = GetOrificeSettings();
			Initialize();
			BuildGrids();
			BuildPipeDefaults();
		}

		private void BuildGrids()
		{
			if (OPDefaults == null)
			{
				OPDefaults = new ObservableCollection<DefaultValuePair>();
				DefaultValuePair item = new DefaultValuePair(FormResource.lbl_SingleValve, mPSVSettings.SingleValveOverpressurePct);
				OPDefaults.Add(item);
				DefaultValuePair item2 = new DefaultValuePair(FormResource.lbl_MultiValve, mPSVSettings.MultipleValveOverpressurePct);
				OPDefaults.Add(item2);
				DefaultValuePair item3 = new DefaultValuePair(FormResource.lbl_Fire, mPSVSettings.FireOverpressurePct);
				OPDefaults.Add(item3);
			}
			if (VaporizedPcts == null)
			{
				VaporizedPcts = new ObservableCollection<DefaultValuePair>();
				DefaultValuePair item4 = new DefaultValuePair(FormResource.lbl_Initial, mSceSettings.FireLatentHeatInitialPct);
				VaporizedPcts.Add(item4);
				DefaultValuePair item5 = new DefaultValuePair(FormResource.lbl_Final, mSceSettings.FireLatentHeatFinalPct);
				VaporizedPcts.Add(item5);
			}
			if (CoeffCs == null)
			{
				CoeffCs = new ObservableCollection<DefaultValuePair>();
				DefaultValuePair item6 = new DefaultValuePair(FormResource.rb_TFST, mSceSettings.TRCoefficientShellToTube);
				CoeffCs.Add(item6);
				DefaultValuePair item7 = new DefaultValuePair(FormResource.rb_TFTS, mSceSettings.TRCoefficientTubeToShell);
				CoeffCs.Add(item7);
			}
			if (MABPDefaults == null)
			{
				MABPDefaults = new ObservableCollection<DefaultValuePair>();
				DefaultValuePair item8 = new DefaultValuePair(FormResource.lbl_bbPSV, mPSVSettings.MaxBackPress_BalBellow);
				MABPDefaults.Add(item8);
				DefaultValuePair item9 = new DefaultValuePair(FormResource.lbl_poPSV, mPSVSettings.MaxBackPress_Pilot);
				MABPDefaults.Add(item9);
			}
		}

		private void BuildPipeDefaults()
		{
			if (PipingDefaults == null)
			{
				PipingDefaults = new ObservableCollection<PipingProperty>();
				PipingProperty pipingProperty = new PipingProperty($"{FormResource.lbl_PipeRough} ({DefaultUnits.Instance.SmallLengthDisplayUnit})");
				pipingProperty.Tag = "roughness";
				pipingProperty.InletValue = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.SmallLength_in, DefaultUnits.Instance.SmallLengthDisplayUnit, mLSSettings.InRoughness, "SmallLength");
				pipingProperty.OutletValue = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.SmallLength_in, DefaultUnits.Instance.SmallLengthDisplayUnit, mLSSettings.OutRoughness, "SmallLength");
				_ = null;
				PipingDefaults.Add(pipingProperty);
				PipingProperty pipingProperty2 = new PipingProperty($"{FormResource.PSVEquivalentLength} ({DefaultUnits.Instance.LengthDisplayUnit})");
				pipingProperty2.Tag = "length";
				pipingProperty2.InletValue = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(mLSSettings.InEquivLengthUOM, DefaultUnits.Instance.LengthDisplayUnit, mLSSettings.InEquivLength, "Length");
				pipingProperty2.OutletValue = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(mLSSettings.OutEquivLengthUOM, DefaultUnits.Instance.LengthDisplayUnit, mLSSettings.OutEquivLength, "Length");
				_ = null;
				PipingDefaults.Add(pipingProperty2);
			}
		}

		public void UpdateGridItemValue(DefaultValuePair pair, double newPercentage, int gridIndex)
		{
			switch (gridIndex)
			{
			case 0:
				if (Operators.CompareString(pair.Label, FormResource.lbl_SingleValve, TextCompare: false) == 0)
				{
					mPSVSettings.SingleValveOverpressurePct = newPercentage;
				}
				else if (Operators.CompareString(pair.Label, FormResource.lbl_MultiValve, TextCompare: false) == 0)
				{
					mPSVSettings.MultipleValveOverpressurePct = newPercentage;
				}
				else if (Operators.CompareString(pair.Label, FormResource.lbl_Fire, TextCompare: false) == 0)
				{
					mPSVSettings.FireOverpressurePct = newPercentage;
				}
				break;
			case 1:
				if (Operators.CompareString(pair.Label, FormResource.lbl_Initial, TextCompare: false) == 0)
				{
					mSceSettings.FireLatentHeatInitialPct = newPercentage;
				}
				else if (Operators.CompareString(pair.Label, FormResource.lbl_Final, TextCompare: false) == 0)
				{
					mSceSettings.FireLatentHeatFinalPct = newPercentage;
				}
				break;
			case 2:
				if (Operators.CompareString(pair.Label, FormResource.rb_TFST, TextCompare: false) == 0)
				{
					mSceSettings.TRCoefficientShellToTube = newPercentage;
				}
				else if (Operators.CompareString(pair.Label, FormResource.rb_TFTS, TextCompare: false) == 0)
				{
					mSceSettings.TRCoefficientTubeToShell = newPercentage;
				}
				break;
			case 3:
				if (Operators.CompareString(pair.Label, FormResource.lbl_conPSV, TextCompare: false) == 0)
				{
					mPSVSettings.MaxBackPress_Conventional = newPercentage;
				}
				else if (Operators.CompareString(pair.Label, FormResource.lbl_bbPSV, TextCompare: false) == 0)
				{
					mPSVSettings.MaxBackPress_BalBellow = newPercentage;
				}
				else if (Operators.CompareString(pair.Label, FormResource.lbl_poPSV, TextCompare: false) == 0)
				{
					mPSVSettings.MaxBackPress_Pilot = newPercentage;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		public void UpdatePipeGridItemValue(PipingProperty pair, double newValue, string tag)
		{
			if (Operators.CompareString(pair.Tag, "roughness", TextCompare: false) == 0)
			{
				if (Operators.CompareString(tag.ToLower(), "inlet", TextCompare: false) == 0)
				{
					mLSSettings.InRoughness = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(DefaultUnits.Instance.SmallLengthDisplayUnit, UnitStrings.SmallLength_in, newValue, "SmallLength");
				}
				else if (Operators.CompareString(tag.ToLower(), "outlet", TextCompare: false) == 0)
				{
					mLSSettings.OutRoughness = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(DefaultUnits.Instance.SmallLengthDisplayUnit, UnitStrings.SmallLength_in, newValue, "SmallLength");
				}
			}
			else if (Operators.CompareString(pair.Tag, "length", TextCompare: false) == 0)
			{
				if (Operators.CompareString(tag.ToLower(), "inlet", TextCompare: false) == 0)
				{
					mLSSettings.InEquivLength = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(DefaultUnits.Instance.LengthDisplayUnit, mLSSettings.InEquivLengthUOM, newValue, "Length");
				}
				else if (Operators.CompareString(tag.ToLower(), "outlet", TextCompare: false) == 0)
				{
					mLSSettings.OutEquivLength = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(DefaultUnits.Instance.LengthDisplayUnit, mLSSettings.OutEquivLengthUOM, newValue, "Length");
				}
			}
		}

		private void RefreshGrids()
		{
			if (OPDefaults != null && OPDefaults.Count != 0)
			{
				OPDefaults.Clear();
				OPDefaults = null;
			}
			if (MABPDefaults != null && MABPDefaults.Count != 0)
			{
				MABPDefaults.Clear();
				MABPDefaults = null;
			}
			if (VaporizedPcts != null && VaporizedPcts.Count != 0)
			{
				VaporizedPcts.Clear();
				VaporizedPcts = null;
			}
			if (CoeffCs != null && CoeffCs.Count != 0)
			{
				CoeffCs.Clear();
				CoeffCs = null;
			}
			if (PipingDefaults != null && PipingDefaults.Count != 0)
			{
				PipingDefaults.Clear();
				PipingDefaults = null;
			}
			BuildGrids();
			BuildPipeDefaults();
		}

		public void OnPrfFileLoaded()
		{
			mOrificeSettings.OnSettingsLoaded();
			RefreshGrids();
			RefreshProperties();
			mPSVSettings.OnSettingsLoaded();
			IPSVMessager iPSVMessager = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IPSVMessager>(uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]);
			iPSVMessager.PSVDefaultDesignCodeString = TranslateUiStrings.SystemDesignCode.StringValue(mPSVSettings.DesignCode);
			iPSVMessager.PSVRefreshUI();
		}

	public class DefaultValuePair
	{

		private double _spvalue;

		{

				return _label;
			}
			set
			{
				_label = value;
			}
		}

		public double SPValue
		{
			get
			{
				return _spvalue;
			}
			set
			{
				_spvalue = value;
			}
		}

		public DefaultValuePair(string name, double value)
		{
			_label = name;
			_spvalue = value;
		}
	}

		public double InletValue
		{
			get

				return _inletVal;
			}
			set
			{
				_inletVal = value;
			}
		}

		public double OutletValue
		{
			get
			{
				return _outletVal;
			}
			set
			{
				_outletVal = value;
			}
		}

		public string Tag
		{
			get
			{
				return _tag;
			}
			set
			{
				_tag = value;
			}
		}

		public PipingProperty(string name)
		{
			_propName = name;
		}
	}

		private void btnLoad_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			OpenFileDialog openFileDialog = new OpenFileDialog();
			openFileDialog.Title = FormResource.title_LoadPreference;
			openFileDialog.Filter = "Safety Environment Preference Files (*.SPRF)|*.SPRF";
			openFileDialog.FilterIndex = 1;
			openFileDialog.Multiselect = false;
			string text = Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.ApplicationData), "AspenTech");
			if (Directory.Exists(text))
			{
				openFileDialog.InitialDirectory = text;
			}
			else
			{
				openFileDialog.RestoreDirectory = true;
			}
			if (openFileDialog.ShowDialog() != DialogResult.OK)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!File.Exists(openFileDialog.FileName))
			{
				ShowErrorMessages(".SPRF File doesn't exist");
				return;
			}
			string loadVersion = string.Empty;
			IEnumerable<string> warningSections = null;
			IEnumerable<string> warningMessages = null;
			try
			{
				((PreferenceManagerWindow)MyWindow).PSVCase.ImportDefaultsFromFile(openFileDialog.FileName, ref loadVersion, out warningSections, out warningMessages);
			}
			catch (ImportExportException ex)
			{
				ProjectData.SetProjectError(ex);
				ImportExportException ex2 = ex;
				switch (ex2.ErrorType)
				{
				case ImportExportException.ErrorClassification.MissingSection:
					ShowErrorMessages(string.Format(FormResource.PrefsMissingSection, ex2.Filename, ex2.Reference));
					break;
				case ImportExportException.ErrorClassification.MissingSectionGroup:
					ShowErrorMessages(string.Format(FormResource.PrefsMissingSectionGrp, ex2.Filename, ex2.Reference));
					break;
				default:
					ShowErrorMessages(string.Format(FormResource.PrefsUnexpectedError, ex2.Filename, ex2.Reference));
					break;
				}
				ProjectData.ClearProjectError();
			}
			catch (Exception ex3)
			{
				ProjectData.SetProjectError(ex3);
				Exception ex4 = ex3;
				ShowErrorMessages(ex4.Message);
				ProjectData.ClearProjectError();
			}
			mVM.OnPrfFileLoaded();
			RefreshOrificePage();
			if (warningSections.Any() || warningMessages.Any())
			{
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
				IEnumerator<string> enumerator = warningSections.GetEnumerator();
				IEnumerator<string> enumerator2 = warningMessages.GetEnumerator();
				while (enumerator.MoveNext() && enumerator2.MoveNext())
				{
					stringBuilder.AppendLine(string.Format(FormResource.PrefsSectionMessagePair, enumerator.Current, enumerator2.Current));
				}
				ShowErrorMessages(string.Format(FormResource.PrefsNewerFile, openFileDialog.FileName, stringBuilder.ToString()));
			}
		}

		public PreferenceManagerWindow()

			base.Loaded += PreferenceManagerWindow_Loaded;
			base.Closing += PreferenceManagerWindow_Closing;

		public void Initialize(ref IPsvCase PSVCase, PsvKey key)
		{
			mpsvcase = PSVCase;
			base.ResizeMode = ResizeMode.CanMinimize;
			base.Width = 835.0;
			base.Height = 767.0;
			base.MinWidth = 481.0;
			base.MinHeight = 683.0;
			base.Title = FormResource.PreManager;
			base.WindowStyle = WindowStyle.ToolWindow;
			ctrl = (PreferencesManager)PSVCase.GetUserControl(PSVctrlIDs.ctrlPreferenceManager, key);
			ctrl.Initialize();
			base.Content = ctrl;
			ctrl.MyWindow = this;
		}

		private void PreferencesWindow_Closed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!Information.IsNothing(mpsvcase))
			{
				mpsvcase.UpdateOverpressure();
				mpsvcase.UpdateSelectedOrifices();
				ctrl.NotifyOrificeSizesChanged();
			}
		}

		{
			((UIElement)(object)ctrl.tabControl).Focus();
		}

		private void PreferenceManagerWindow_Closing(object sender, CancelEventArgs e)
		{
			ctrl.NotifyClosing();
		}
	}

		private void InsertRowCommand_Execute(object parameter)
		{
			ExecutehodBase(checked([SpecialName] (int index) =>
			{
				ILineSizingPipe lineSizingPipe;
				int index2;
				if (IsAddBelow)
				{
					lineSizingPipe = _lineSizingOutletPipe;
					index2 = index - 2 - _lineSizingInletPipe.WorkingCopy.Count;
				}
				else
				{
					lineSizingPipe = _lineSizingInletPipe;
					index2 = index;
				}
				lineSizingPipe.InsertElement(index2);
				LineSizingPipeElementProxy lineSizingPipeElementProxy = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<LineSizingPipeElementProxy>(uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]);
				lineSizingPipeElementProxy.Initialize(lineSizingPipe.WorkingCopy[index2], ChangeElementType);
				LineSizingModelCollection.Insert(IsAddBelow ? (index + 1) : index, lineSizingPipeElementProxy);
			}), RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(parameter));
		}

		private bool InsertRowCommand_CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return CanExecutehodBase([SpecialName] (int index) =>
			{

				return index != num;

		private void RemoveRowCommand_Execute(object parameter)
		{
			ExecutehodBase([SpecialName] (int index) =>

		private void SwapElements(int indexA, int indexB)
		{
			LineSizingModelCollection.Move(indexA, indexB);
			checked
			{
				if (IsAddBelow)
				{
					_lineSizingOutletPipe.SwapElements(indexA - 3 - _lineSizingInletPipe.WorkingCopy.Count, indexB - 3 - _lineSizingInletPipe.WorkingCopy.Count);
				}
				else
				{
					_lineSizingInletPipe.SwapElements(indexA, indexB);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ChangeElementType(int index, PipeElementType type)
		{
			ILineSizingPipe lineSizingPipe;
			int index2;
			if (IsAddBelow)
			{
				lineSizingPipe = _lineSizingOutletPipe;
				index2 = checked(index - 3 - _lineSizingInletPipe.WorkingCopy.Count);
			}
			else
			{
				lineSizingPipe = _lineSizingInletPipe;
				index2 = index;
			}
			lineSizingPipe.ChangeElementType(index2, type);
			LineSizingModelCollection[index].LineSizingPipeElement = lineSizingPipe.WorkingCopy[index2];
		}

		{
			get
			{
				if (mPSVScenarioModel == null || !mPSVScenarioModel.get_LineRatingRelFlowMethod(notify: true).HasValue)

				}

				if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num == 1) : ((bool?)null)) != true)
				{
					num = (int?)mPSVScenarioModel.get_LineRatingRelFlowMethod(notify: true);
					if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num.GetValueOrDefault() == 0) : ((bool?)null)) != true)
					{

						if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num == 2) : ((bool?)null)) == true)

		public string SelectedScenario
		{
			get
			{
				return mPSVScenarioModel.ScenarioName;
			}
			set
			{
				if (Operators.CompareString(SelectedScenario, value, TextCompare: false) != 0)
				{
					CleanEvent();
					mPSVScenarioModel = mPrdModel.ScenarioModels.Single([SpecialName] (PSVScenarioModel scen) => Operators.CompareString(scen.ScenarioName, value, TextCompare: false) == 0);
					mPSVScenarioModel.BaseModelChanged += OnBaseModelChanged;
					mPSVScenarioModel.PSVScenarioModelPropertyChanged += OnPSVScenarioModelPropertyChanged;
					NotifyUiPropertyChanged();
					NotifyResultsPropertyChanged();
					NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("IsScenarioCalculated");
					NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("IsSelectedScenarioTheSizingCase");
				}
			}
		}

		public LineSizingBaseViewModel(IUnityContainer unityContainer)
			: base(unityContainer)
		{
			//IL_002b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0035: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0041: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0057: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0061: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0078: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0082: Expected O, but got Unknown
			_equivalentLenRule = base.IsNanOrValidNonNegativeValue;
			_flowRateMethodItemsSource = new List<ComboBoxDataItem>
			{
				new ComboBoxDataItem((object)LineRatingFlowSpec.Required, FormResource.FlowMethod_Required),
				new ComboBoxDataItem((object)LineRatingFlowSpec.RatedArea, FormResource.FlowMethod_RatedArea),
				new ComboBoxDataItem((object)LineRatingFlowSpec.Manual, FormResource.FlowMethod_Manual)
			};
			_flowRateMethodItemsSourceRDLoverD = new List<ComboBoxDataItem>
			{
				new ComboBoxDataItem((object)LineRatingFlowSpec.RatedArea, FormResource.FlowMethod_RatedLines)
			};
			_lineSizingSettingsModel = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<LineSizingSettingsModel>(uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]);
			ConfigureCommand = new Command(ConfigureCommand_Execute);
			RunLineSizingCommand = new Command(RunLineSizingCommand_Execute, RunLineSizingCommand_CanExecute);
			RunAllLineSizingCommand = new Command(RunAllLineSizing, RunAllLineSizing_CanExecute);
		}

		private void ConfigureCommand_Execute(object parameter)
		{
			CalculationSettingsDialog calculationSettingsDialog = new CalculationSettingsDialog(uContainer, mPSVScenarioModel);
			if (System.Windows.Application.Current != null && System.Windows.Application.Current.MainWindow != null)
			{
				calculationSettingsDialog.Owner = System.Windows.Application.Current.MainWindow;
			}
			calculationSettingsDialog.ShowDialog();
		}

		private void RunLineSizingCommand_Execute(object parameter)
		{
			RunLineSizingCalculation();
			NotifyResultsPropertyChanged();
		}

		private bool RunLineSizingCommand_CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return CanRunRigorousLineSizing;
		}

		private void RunAllLineSizing(object parameter)
		{
			foreach (PSVScenarioModel item in mPrdModel.ScenarioModels.Where([SpecialName] (PSVScenarioModel scen) => scen.get_IsLineSizingCalculated(notify: true) & scen.IsLineSizingDirty))
			{
				item.ForceCalculateRigorousLineSizing();
			}
			NotifyResultsPropertyChanged();
		}

		private bool RunAllLineSizing_CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (!mPrdModel.ScenarioModels.All([SpecialName] (PSVScenarioModel scen) => !scen.get_IsLineSizingCalculated(notify: true) | scen.IsLineSizingReady))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!mPrdModel.ScenarioModels.Any([SpecialName] (PSVScenarioModel scen) => scen.IsLineSizingDirty & scen.IsLineSizingReady))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void Initialize(ref PSVScenarioModel psvScenModel)
		{
			mPSVScenarioModel = psvScenModel;
			mPrdModel = (PRDModel)psvScenModel.Owner;
			mPrdSystemModel = psvScenModel.PRDSystem;
			CleanEvent();
			_sizingMethodChangedSubscription = ((CompositePresentationEvent<SizingMethodChangedEventArgs>)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<SizingMethodChangedEvent>()).Subscribe((Action<SizingMethodChangedEventArgs>)([SpecialName] (SizingMethodChangedEventArgs e) =>
			{
				NotifyUiPropertyChanged();
			}));
			_orificeSizeChangedSubscription = ((CompositePresentationEvent<EventArgs>)(object)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<UpdateOrificeSizesEvent>()).Subscribe((Action<EventArgs>)OnOrificeSizesChanged);
			mPSVScenarioModel.BaseModelChanged += OnBaseModelChanged;
			mPSVScenarioModel.PSVScenarioModelPropertyChanged += OnPSVScenarioModelPropertyChanged;
		}

		public void RunLineSizingCalculation()
		{
			mPSVScenarioModel.ForceCalculateRigorousLineSizing();
			NotifyResultsPropertyChanged();
		}

		private ILineSizingMaterial GetMaterialFromString(string materialName)
		{
			ILineSizingMaterial result = null;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(materialName) && Operators.CompareString(materialName, FormResource.rls_UserSpecified, TextCompare: false) != 0)
			{
				result = _lineSizingSettingsModel.PipeMaterials.SingleOrDefault([SpecialName] (ILineSizingMaterial m) => Operators.CompareString(m.Name, materialName, TextCompare: false) == 0);
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected bool SetProperty<T>(ref T storage, T value, Predicate<T> rule = null)
		{
			if (EqualityComparer<T>.Default.Equals(storage, value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return base.SetValue(ref storage, value, rule, "SetProperty");
		}

		protected bool SetProperty<T>(ref T storage, object obj)
		{
			bool result;
			try
			{
				T value = (T)Convert.ChangeType(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(obj), typeof(T));
				result = SetProperty(ref storage, value);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				ProjectData.SetProjectError(ex);
				Exception ex2 = ex;
				OnInvalidValueEntered(new InvalidValueEnteredEventArgs(InvalidValueErrorType.TypeError));
				result = false;
				ProjectData.ClearProjectError();
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected bool SetValueWithUnit(ref double storage, object value, string fromUnit, string toUnit, string unitType, Predicate<double> rule = null)
		{
			bool result;
			try
			{
				double inputVal = (double)Convert.ChangeType(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(value), typeof(double));
				inputVal = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(fromUnit, toUnit, inputVal, unitType);
				result = SetProperty(ref storage, inputVal, rule);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				ProjectData.SetProjectError(ex);
				Exception ex2 = ex;
				OnInvalidValueEntered(new InvalidValueEnteredEventArgs(InvalidValueErrorType.TypeError));
				result = false;
				ProjectData.ClearProjectError();
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected bool SetValueWithMassFlow(ref double storage, object value, string baseUnit)
		{
			return SetValueWithUnit(ref storage, RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(value), DefaultUnits.Instance.MassFlowDisplayUnit, baseUnit, "MassFlow");
		}

		protected bool SetValueWithSmallLength(ref double storage, object value, string baseUnit)

			return SetValueWithUnit(ref storage, RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(value), DefaultUnits.Instance.SmallLengthDisplayUnit, baseUnit, "SmallLength");
		}

		protected bool SetValueWithLength(ref double storage, object value, string baseUnit, Predicate<double> rule = null)
		{
			return SetValueWithUnit(ref storage, RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(value), DefaultUnits.Instance.LengthDisplayUnit, baseUnit, "Length", rule);
		}

		protected double GetValueWithMassFlow(double value, string baseUnit)

	public abstract class ProcessVariablePassThrough<TVM, T, TU> : IProcessVarViewModel<T> where TVM : BaseViewModel
	{
		protected delegate TU GetDelegate(TVM obj);

		protected delegate void SetDelegate(TVM obj, TU value);

		protected GetDelegate Getter;

		protected SetDelegate Setter;

		protected List<Func<T, bool>> Validations;

		protected SpecifierType SpecifierType;

		protected string PropertyName;

		protected TVM vm;

		public static IFormatProvider FormatProvider;

		public SpecifierType SpecifierTypeProperty => SpecifierType;

		public SpecifierType VarSpecifierType => SpecifierType;

		public virtual T DisplayValue
		{
			get
			{
				return ConvertTo(UnderlyingValue);
			}
			set
			{
				UnderlyingValue = ConvertFrom(value);
			}
		}

		public TU UnderlyingValue
		{
			get
			{
				return Getter(vm);
			}
			set
			{
				if ((value != null || UnderlyingValue != null) && (value == null || !value.Equals(UnderlyingValue)))
				{
					Setter(vm, value);
					OnPropertyChanged("DisplayValue");
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsValid => Validations.All([SpecialName] (Func<T, bool> val) => val(DisplayValue));

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		public ProcessVariablePassThrough(TVM vm, Expression<Func<TVM, TU>> prop, SpecifierType specifierType, params Func<T, bool>[] validations)
		{
			Validations = new List<Func<T, bool>>();
			MemberExpression memberExpression = prop.Body as MemberExpression;
			if (memberExpression == null)
			{
				if (prop.Body != null && prop.Body.NodeType == ExpressionType.Convert && prop.Body is UnaryExpression unaryExpression)
				{
					memberExpression = unaryExpression.Operand as MemberExpression;
					if (memberExpression != null)
					{
						goto IL_0065;
					}
				}
				throw new ArgumentException("Property expression is not a member access.", "prop");
			}
			goto IL_0065;
			IL_0065:
			PropertyInfo propertyInfo = (PropertyInfo)memberExpression.Member;
			Getter = (GetDelegate)propertyInfo.GetMethod.CreateDelegate(typeof(GetDelegate));
			Setter = (SetDelegate)propertyInfo.SetMethod.CreateDelegate(typeof(SetDelegate));
			SpecifierType = specifierType;
			Validations.AddRange(validations);
		}

		protected abstract T ConvertTo(TU uv);

		protected abstract TU ConvertFrom(T v);

		protected virtual void OnPropertyChanged([CallerMemberName] string propertyName = null)
		{
			PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
		}
	}

		}

		private static bool IsAsciiLetterOrNumber(char check)
		{
			int num = Convert.ToInt32(check);
			if (num >= 48 && num <= 57)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (num >= 65 && num <= 90)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (num >= 97 && num <= 122)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool ValidID(string strID)
		{
			char[] array = strID.ToCharArray();
			int num = checked(array.Length - 1);
			for (int i = 0; i <= num; i = checked(i + 1))
			{
				if (i == 0)
				{
					if (!IsAsciiLetterOrNumber(array[i]))
					{
						return false;
					}
					continue;
				}
				char c = array[i];
				if (!((IsAsciiLetterOrNumber(c) || c == ',' || c == '$' || c == ':' || c == '+' || c == '-') | (Convert.ToInt32(c) == 13) | (Convert.ToInt32(c) == 8)))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool OnlyAscii(string strID)
		{
			if (Regex.IsMatch(strID, "[^\\u0000-\\u007F]"))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void txtBox_PreviewTextInput(object sender, TextCompositionEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0019: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (!string.Equals(Host, "ASPENPLUS"))
			{
				return;
			}
			XamTextEditor val = (XamTextEditor)sender;
			System.Windows.Controls.TextBox textBox = (System.Windows.Controls.TextBox)Utilities.GetDescendantFromName((DependencyObject)(object)val, "PART_FocusSite");
			if (textBox != null)
			{
				string text = ((ValueEditor)val).Text;
				int caretIndex = textBox.CaretIndex;
				if (textBox.SelectedText.Trim().Length > 0)
				{
					text.Replace(textBox.SelectedText, e.Text);
				}
				else
				{
					text = text.Insert(caretIndex, e.Text);
				}
				if (!ValidID(text))
				{
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}

		private void OnOK(object arg)
		{
			if (m_vm == null)
			{
				if (!Common.IsSameValue(OverPress, m_model.SpecifiedOverpressurePct))
				{
					m_model.SpecifiedOverpressurePct = OverPress;
					_isOverPressChanged = true;
				}
				Common.IsSameValue(UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(DefaultUnits.Instance.GaugePressDisplayUnit, m_model.get_UOMSetPress(notify: true), SetPress, "GaugePressure"), m_model.get_SetPress(notify: true));
				m_model.AppliedInletPressureDrop = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(DefaultUnits.Instance.DPDisplayUnit, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, InletDP, "DeltaPressure");
			}
			else
			{
				if (((MainViewModel)m_vm).get_SetPress(notify: true) != SetPress)
				{
					((MainViewModel)m_vm).set_SetPress(notify: true, SetPress);
				}
				if (!double.IsNaN(OverPress) && m_vm.OverPress != OverPress)
				{
					m_vm.OverPress = OverPress;
				}
				((MainViewModel)m_vm).set_AppliedInletPressureDrop(notify: true, InletDP);
				if (Coeff_Kp_Opt)
				{
					m_vm.Coeff_Kp_Opt = ProcessDataSource.Calculated;
				}
				else
				{
					m_vm.Coeff_Kp_Opt = ProcessDataSource.Specified;
					m_vm.Coeff_Kp = Coeff_Kp;
				}
			}
			base.DialogResult = true;
			Close();
		}

					_maxAllowBP = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.GaugePressure_barG, DefaultUnits.Instance.GaugePressDisplayUnit, inputVal, "GaugePressure");
					PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs("myMaxAllowBP"));
				}
				else if (m_model != null)
				{
					double superVariableBP = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(DefaultUnits.Instance.DPDisplayUnit, UnitStrings.DeltaPressure_bar, value, "DeltaPressure");
					double inputVal2 = m_model.MaxAllowBPByValues(myMaxAllowBPPercent, superVariableBP);
					_maxAllowBP = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.GaugePressure_barG, DefaultUnits.Instance.GaugePressDisplayUnit, inputVal2, "GaugePressure");
					PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs("myMaxAllowBP"));
				}
			}
		}

		public double myBuiltupBackPress
		{
			get
			{
				return _builtupBackPress;
			}
			set
			{
				_builtupBackPress = value;
				_totBackPress = _superImpConstBackPress + _superImpVarBackPress + _builtupBackPress - _atmPress;
				PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs("myTotBackPress"));
			}
		}

		public bool IsMaxAllowBPReadOnly => (m_model ?? vm.PSVModel).IsConventionalPsv;

		public TotalBackPressDialog(IUnityContainer unityContainer, PSVScenarioControlViewModel vm = null, PSVScenarioModel scenmodel = null, bool isRuptureDisk = false)
		{
			base.Loaded += Window_Loaded;
			PropertyChanged += TotalBackPressDialog_PropertyChanged;
			m_Container = null;
			m_model = null;
			_isRuptureDisk = false;
			m_Container = unityContainer;
			InitializeComponent();
			if (vm != null)
			{
				this.vm = vm;
			}
			if (scenmodel != null)
			{
				m_model = scenmodel;
			}
			_isRuptureDisk = isRuptureDisk;
			InitializeProperties();
			if (isRuptureDisk)
			{
				this.SetHelpId(9828, unityContainer);
			}
			else
			{
				this.SetHelpId(9808, unityContainer);
			}
			base.CommandBindings.Add(new CommandBinding(ApplicationCommands.Help, HelpExecuted));
		}

		private void InitializeProperties()
		{
			if (vm != null)
			{
				_coeff_kb = vm.Coeff_kb;
				_superImpConstBackPress = vm.SuperImpConstBackPress;
				_superImpVarBackPress = vm.SuperImpVarBackPress;
				_builtupBackPress = vm.BuiltupBackPress;
				_maxAllowBPPercent = vm.MaxAllowBPPercent;
				_atmPress = ((MainViewModel)vm).get_AtmPress(notify: true);
				_totBackPress = vm.TotBackPress;
				_maxAllowBP = vm.MaxAllowBPForDisplay;
				_coeff_kw = vm.Coeff_kw;
				_coeffKbCalculated = vm.CoeffKbCalculated;
				_coeffKwCalculated = vm.CoeffKwCalculated;
				_sizingMethod = vm.SizingMethodValue;
			}
			else if (m_model != null)
			{
				_coeff_kb = m_model.get_Coeff_kb(notify: true);
				_superImpConstBackPress = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(m_model.UOMSuperImpConstBackPress, DefaultUnits.Instance.AbsPressDisplayUnit, m_model.SuperImpConstBackPress, "AbsolutePressure");
				_superImpVarBackPress = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(m_model.UOMSuperImpVarBackPress, DefaultUnits.Instance.DPDisplayUnit, m_model.SuperImpVarBackPress, "DeltaPressure");
				_builtupBackPress = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(m_model.UOMBuiltupBackPress, DefaultUnits.Instance.DPDisplayUnit, m_model.get_BuiltupBackPress(notify: true), "DeltaPressure");
				_maxAllowBPPercent = m_model.MaxAllowBpPercent_ByUser;
				_atmPress = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(m_model.get_UOMAtmPress(notify: true), DefaultUnits.Instance.AbsPressDisplayUnit, m_model.AtmPress, "AbsolutePressure");
				_totBackPress = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(m_model.UOMTotBackPress, DefaultUnits.Instance.GaugePressDisplayUnit, m_model.get_TotBackPress(notify: true), "GaugePressure");
				_maxAllowBP = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(m_model.UOMMaxAllowBP, DefaultUnits.Instance.GaugePressDisplayUnit, m_model.get_MaxAllowBP(notify: true), "GaugePressure");
				_coeff_kw = m_model.Coeff_kw;
				if (m_model.Coeff_kb_opt == ProcessDataSource.Calculated)
				{
					_coeffKbCalculated = true;
				}
				else
				{
					_coeffKbCalculated = false;
				}
				if (m_model.Coeff_kw_opt == ProcessDataSource.Calculated)
				{
					_coeffKwCalculated = true;
				}
				else
				{
					_coeffKwCalculated = false;
				}
				_sizingMethod = m_model.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true);
			}
		}

		private void Window_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.DataContext = this;
			if (_isRuptureDisk)
			{
				border_1.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				psvallowBP.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				psvbox5.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				border_2.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				tb_1.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				FactorRadio1.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				FactorRadio2.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				psvfactor2.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				border_3.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
		}

		private void TotalBackPressDialog_PropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Operators.CompareString(e.PropertyName, "myTotBackPress", TextCompare: false) == 0)
			{
				CalculateUpdatedKb();
				CalculateUpdatedKw();
			}
		}

		private void CalculateUpdatedKw()
		{
			if (_coeffKwCalculated && vm != null)
			{
				double totalBP = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(DefaultUnits.Instance.AbsPressDisplayUnit, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, _totBackPress + _atmPress, "AbsolutePressure");
				_coeff_kw = vm.CoeffKwByValues(totalBP);
				RaisePropertyChanged("myCoeff");
			}
		}

		private void CalculateUpdatedKb()
		{
			if (_coeffKbCalculated && vm != null)
			{
				double totalBP = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(DefaultUnits.Instance.AbsPressDisplayUnit, UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA, _totBackPress + _atmPress, "AbsolutePressure");
				_coeff_kb = vm.CoeffKbByValues(totalBP);
				RaisePropertyChanged("myCoeff");
			}
		}

		private void RaisePropertyChanged([CallerMemberName] string propertyName = null)
		{
			PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
		}

		private void btnCancel_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.DialogResult = false;
			Close();
		}

		private void btnOK_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (vm != null)
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(_superImpVarBackPress) & vm.ValuesAreDifferent(vm.SuperImpVarBackPress, _superImpVarBackPress))
				{
					vm.SuperImpVarBackPress = _superImpVarBackPress;
				}
				if (!double.IsNaN(_builtupBackPress) & vm.ValuesAreDifferent(vm.BuiltupBackPress, _builtupBackPress))
				{
					vm.BuiltupBackPress = _builtupBackPress;
				}
				if (vm.ValuesAreDifferent(vm.MaxAllowBPPercent, _maxAllowBPPercent))
				{
					vm.MaxAllowBPPercent = _maxAllowBPPercent;
				}
				if (vm.CoeffKbCalculated != _coeffKbCalculated)
				{
					vm.CoeffKbCalculated = _coeffKbCalculated;
				}
				if (!vm.CoeffKbCalculated && (!double.IsNaN(_coeff_kb) & vm.ValuesAreDifferent(vm.Coeff_kb, _coeff_kb)))
				{
					vm.Coeff_kb = _coeff_kb;
				}
				if (vm.CoeffKwCalculated != _coeffKwCalculated)
				{
					vm.CoeffKwCalculated = _coeffKwCalculated;
				}
				if (!vm.CoeffKwCalculated && (!double.IsNaN(_coeff_kw) & vm.ValuesAreDifferent(vm.Coeff_kw, _coeff_kw)))
				{
					vm.Coeff_kw = _coeff_kw;
				}
				if (!double.IsNaN(_totBackPress) & vm.ValuesAreDifferent(vm.TotBackPress, _totBackPress))
				{
					vm.TotBackPress = _totBackPress;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(_superImpVarBackPress) & !Common.IsSameValue(UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(m_model.UOMSuperImpVarBackPress, DefaultUnits.Instance.DPDisplayUnit, m_model.SuperImpVarBackPress, "DeltaPressure"), _superImpVarBackPress))
				{
					m_model.SuperImpVarBackPress = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(DefaultUnits.Instance.DPDisplayUnit, m_model.UOMSuperImpVarBackPress, _superImpVarBackPress, "DeltaPressure");
				}
				if (!double.IsNaN(_builtupBackPress) & !Common.IsSameValue(UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(m_model.UOMBuiltupBackPress, DefaultUnits.Instance.DPDisplayUnit, m_model.get_BuiltupBackPress(notify: true), "DeltaPressure"), _builtupBackPress))
				{
					m_model.set_BuiltupBackPress(notify: true, UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(DefaultUnits.Instance.DPDisplayUnit, m_model.UOMBuiltupBackPress, _builtupBackPress, "DeltaPressure"));
				}
				if (!Common.IsSameValue(m_model.MaxAllowBpPercent_ByUser, _maxAllowBPPercent))
				{
					m_model.MaxAllowBpPercent_ByUser = _maxAllowBPPercent;
				}
				if (_coeffKbCalculated && m_model.Coeff_kb_opt != ProcessDataSource.Calculated)
				{
					m_model.Coeff_kb_opt = ProcessDataSource.Calculated;
				}
				if (!_coeffKbCalculated && m_model.Coeff_kb_opt != ProcessDataSource.Specified)
				{
					m_model.Coeff_kb_opt = ProcessDataSource.Specified;
				}
				if (m_model.Coeff_kb_opt == ProcessDataSource.Specified && (!double.IsNaN(_coeff_kb) & !Common.IsSameValue(m_model.get_Coeff_kb(notify: true), _coeff_kb)))
				{
					m_model.set_Coeff_kb(notify: true, _coeff_kb);
				}
				if (_coeffKwCalculated && m_model.Coeff_kw_opt != ProcessDataSource.Calculated)
				{
					m_model.Coeff_kw_opt = ProcessDataSource.Calculated;
				}
				if (!_coeffKwCalculated && m_model.Coeff_kw_opt != ProcessDataSource.Specified)
				{
					m_model.Coeff_kw_opt = ProcessDataSource.Specified;
				}
				if (m_model.Coeff_kw_opt == ProcessDataSource.Specified && (!double.IsNaN(_coeff_kw) & !Common.IsSameValue(m_model.Coeff_kw, _coeff_kw)))
				{
					m_model.Coeff_kw = _coeff_kw;
				}
				if (!double.IsNaN(_totBackPress) & !Common.IsSameValue(_totBackPress, UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(m_model.UOMTotBackPress, DefaultUnits.Instance.GaugePressDisplayUnit, m_model.get_TotBackPress(notify: true), "GaugePressure")))
				{
					m_model.set_TotBackPress(notify: true, UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(DefaultUnits.Instance.GaugePressDisplayUnit, m_model.UOMTotBackPress, _totBackPress, "GaugePressure"));
				}
			}
			base.DialogResult = true;
			Close();
		}

		}

		protected void HelpExecuted(object sender, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			PSVHelpEventArgs e2 = new PSVHelpEventArgs();
			if (_isRuptureDisk)
			{
				e2.TopicID = 9828;
			}
			else
			{
				e2.TopicID = 9808;
			}
			((RoutedCompositePresentationEvent<PSVHelpEventArgs>)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(m_Container, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<PSVShowHelpEvent>()).Publish(e2);
			e.Handled = true;
		}

		public object PropertyValue
		{
			get
			{
				if (_propertyValue is bool)
				{
					return _propertyValue;
				}
				if (_propertyValue is double && double.IsNaN(Conversions.ToDouble(_propertyValue)))
				{
					return FormResource.str_Empty;
				}
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_propertyValue.ToString()))
				{
					return FormResource.str_Empty;
				}
				if (Operators.CompareString(_propertyValue.ToString(), "blank", TextCompare: false) == 0)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				if (Operators.CompareString(PropertyName, "SelRDDiam", TextCompare: false) == 0)
				{
					return Format.FormatOrificeValue(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(_propertyValue));
				}
				return _propertyValue;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null || IsReadOnly)
				{
					return;
				}
				checked
				{
					if (!_isValueValid)
					{
						_propertyValue = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(value);
					}
					else if (!Information.IsNothing(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(OriginalValue)) && value.GetType() == OriginalValue.GetType() && Operators.ConditionalCompareObjectEqual(value, OriginalValue, TextCompare: false))
					{
						_propertyValue = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(value);
					}
					else
					{
						if ((object)_propertyInfo == null)
						{
							return;
						}
						double result;
						if (Operators.CompareString(_propertyInfo.PropertyType.Name, "String", TextCompare: false) == 0)
						{
							string value2 = value.ToString();
							if (_propertyInfo.GetIndexParameters().Length > 0)
							{
								object[] array = new object[_propertyInfo.GetIndexParameters().Length - 1 + 1];
								int num = 0;
								ParameterInfo[] indexParameters = _propertyInfo.GetIndexParameters();
								foreach (ParameterInfo parameterInfo in indexParameters)
								{
									array[num] = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(parameterInfo.DefaultValue);
									num++;
								}
								_propertyInfo.SetValue(_vm, value2, array);
							}
							else
							{
								_propertyInfo.SetValue(_vm, value2, null);
							}
						}
						else if (Operators.CompareString(_propertyInfo.PropertyType.Name, "Double", TextCompare: false) == 0 && string.Compare("SelRDDiam", PropertyName, ignoreCase: true) == 0)
						{
							if (double.TryParse(Conversions.ToString(value), out result))
							{
								result = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value.ToString()) ? double.NaN : UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue("in", "cm", result, _unittype));
								if (_propertyInfo.GetIndexParameters().Length > 0)
								{
									object[] array2 = new object[_propertyInfo.GetIndexParameters().Length - 1 + 1];
									int num2 = 0;
									ParameterInfo[] indexParameters2 = _propertyInfo.GetIndexParameters();
									foreach (ParameterInfo parameterInfo2 in indexParameters2)
									{
										array2[num2] = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(parameterInfo2.DefaultValue);
										num2++;
									}
									_propertyInfo.SetValue(_vm, result, array2);
								}
								else
								{
									_propertyInfo.SetValue(_vm, result, null);
								}
							}
							else
							{
								value = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(PropertyValue);
							}
						}
						else if (Operators.CompareString(_propertyInfo.PropertyType.Name, "Double", TextCompare: false) == 0 && string.Compare("SelectOrifice", PropertyName, ignoreCase: true) != 0)
						{
							if (double.TryParse(Conversions.ToString(value), out result))
							{
								if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value.ToString()))
								{
									if (!string.Equals(UOMUnit, DefaultUnit, StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase))
									{
										result = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(_defaultUnit, _uomUnit, result, _unittype);
									}
								}
								else
								{
									result = double.NaN;
								}
								if (_propertyInfo.GetIndexParameters().Length > 0)
								{
									object[] array3 = new object[_propertyInfo.GetIndexParameters().Length - 1 + 1];
									int num3 = 0;
									ParameterInfo[] indexParameters3 = _propertyInfo.GetIndexParameters();
									foreach (ParameterInfo parameterInfo3 in indexParameters3)
									{
										array3[num3] = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(parameterInfo3.DefaultValue);
										num3++;
									}
									_propertyInfo.SetValue(_vm, result, array3);
								}
								else
								{
									_propertyInfo.SetValue(_vm, result, null);
								}
							}
							else
							{
								value = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(PropertyValue);
							}
						}
						else if (Operators.CompareString(_propertyInfo.PropertyType.BaseType.Name, "Enum", TextCompare: false) == 0)
						{
							if (Operators.CompareString(value.GetType().Name, _propertyInfo.PropertyType.Name, TextCompare: false) == 0)
							{
								_propertyInfo.SetValue(_vm, RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(value), null);
							}
							else
							{
								value = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(PropertyValue);
							}
						}
						else if (Operators.CompareString(_propertyInfo.PropertyType.Name, "Boolean", TextCompare: false) == 0)
						{
							if ((object)value.GetType() == typeof(string))
							{
								value = (Operators.ConditionalCompareObjectEqual(value, "Yes", TextCompare: false) ? ((object)true) : ((!Operators.ConditionalCompareObjectEqual(value, "No", TextCompare: false)) ? RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(PropertyValue) : ((object)false)));
							}
							_propertyInfo.SetValue(_vm, RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(value), null);
						}
						else if (double.TryParse(Conversions.ToString(value), out result))
						{
							if (_propertyInfo.GetIndexParameters().Length > 0)
							{
								object[] array4 = new object[_propertyInfo.GetIndexParameters().Length - 1 + 1];
								int num4 = 0;
								ParameterInfo[] indexParameters4 = _propertyInfo.GetIndexParameters();
								foreach (ParameterInfo parameterInfo4 in indexParameters4)

									array4[num4] = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(parameterInfo4.DefaultValue);
									num4++;
								}
								_propertyInfo.SetValue(_vm, result, array4);
							}
							else
							{
								_propertyInfo.SetValue(_vm, result, null);
							}
						}
						else
						{
							value = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(PropertyValue);
						}
						_propertyValue = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(value);
						_originalValue = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(value);
						if (RefreshRequired)
						{
							RaiseContentsChanged();
						}
					}
				}
			}

		public GridDataItem(BaseViewModel vm, object propertyValue, string propertyName, string label, string unittype = "", string defaultUnit = "", string uomUnit = "", ReliefDeviceType type = ReliefDeviceType.Psv)
		{
			Id = Guid.NewGuid();
			_isValueValid = true;
			_canBeEmpty = false;
			_isReadOnly = false;
			_isEnabled = true;
			_hasCheckBox = false;
			_hasUnit = false;
			_minValue = 0.0;
			_maxValue = 1E+36;
			_contentAlignment = System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Right;
			RefreshRequired = false;
			_vm = vm;
			_propertyName = propertyName;
			_isReadOnly = IsReadOnly;
			_defaultUnit = defaultUnit;
			_uomUnit = uomUnit;
			_unittype = unittype;
			_deviceType = type;
			InitializePropertyInfo();
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(defaultUnit))
			{
				_label = label + " [" + defaultUnit + "]";
			}
			else
			{
				_label = label;
			}
			_AssignPropertyValue(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(propertyValue));
		}

		private void _AssignPropertyValue(object propertyValue)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			if (_deviceType == ReliefDeviceType.Psv)
			{
				if (string.Compare("ValveName", PropertyName, ignoreCase: true) == 0)
				{
					_propertyValue = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(propertyValue);
				}
				else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(UOMUnit) && !string.Equals(UOMUnit, DefaultUnit, StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase))
				{
					if (UOMUnit.ToLower().Equals("mt"))
					{
						UOMUnit = "m";
					}
					if (double.TryParse(propertyValue.ToString(), out result))
					{
						_propertyValue = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UOMUnit, DefaultUnit, result, UnitType);
					}
					else
					{
						_propertyValue = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(propertyValue);
					}
				}
				else if (double.TryParse(propertyValue.ToString(), out result))
				{
					_propertyValue = result;
				}
				else
				{
					_propertyValue = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(propertyValue);
				}
			}
			else if (double.TryParse(propertyValue.ToString(), out result))
			{
				_propertyValue = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UOMUnit, DefaultUnit, result, UnitType);
			}
			else
			{
				_propertyValue = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(propertyValue);
			}
			_originalValue = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(_propertyValue);
		}

		private void _RefreshPropertyValue()
		{
			if ((object)_propertyInfo == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			checked
			{
				object objectValue;
				if (_propertyInfo.GetIndexParameters().Length > 0)
				{
					object[] array = new object[_propertyInfo.GetIndexParameters().Length - 1 + 1];
					int num = 0;
					ParameterInfo[] indexParameters = _propertyInfo.GetIndexParameters();
					foreach (ParameterInfo parameterInfo in indexParameters)
					{
						array[num] = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(parameterInfo.DefaultValue);
						num++;
					}
					objectValue = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(_propertyInfo.GetValue(_vm, array));
				}
				else
				{
					objectValue = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(_propertyInfo.GetValue(_vm));
				}
				_AssignPropertyValue(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(objectValue));
			}
		}

		private void InitializePropertyInfo()
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(PropertyName))
			{
				Type type = _vm.GetType();
				_propertyInfo = type.GetProperty(PropertyName);
			}
		}

		private void _NotifyPropertyChanged([CallerMemberName] string propertyName = null)
		{
			PropertyChangedEventArgs e = new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName);
			PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, e);
		}

		public void RaiseContentsChanged()
		{
			_RefreshPropertyValue();
			_NotifyPropertyChanged("PropertyValue");
		}

		void IPsvDataGridItem.RaiseContentsChanged()
		{
			//ILSpy generated this explicit interface implementation from .override directive in RaiseContentsChanged
			this.RaiseContentsChanged();
		}

	internal class PropertySetHelper<TClass>
	{
		internal interface IPropertySetImpl
		{
			object GetValue(TClass host);

			void SetValue(TClass host, object value);
		}

		private class PropertySetImpl<TValue> : IPropertySetImpl
		{
			private delegate TValue _GetDelegate(TClass obj);

			private delegate void _SetDelegate(TClass obj, TValue value);

			private readonly _GetDelegate _Getter;

			private readonly _SetDelegate _Setter;

			public PropertySetImpl(PropertyInfo propInfo, bool includeSetter)
			{
				_Getter = (_GetDelegate)propInfo.GetMethod.CreateDelegate(typeof(_GetDelegate));
				if (includeSetter)
				{
					_Setter = (_SetDelegate)propInfo.SetMethod.CreateDelegate(typeof(_SetDelegate));
				}
			}

			public object GetValue(TClass host)
			{
				return _Getter(host);
			}

			object IPropertySetImpl.GetValue(TClass host)
			{
				//ILSpy generated this explicit interface implementation from .override directive in GetValue
				return this.GetValue(host);
			}

			public void SetValue(TClass host, object value)
			{
				_Setter(host, Conversions.ToGenericParameter<TValue>(value));
			}

			void IPropertySetImpl.SetValue(TClass host, object value)
			{
				//ILSpy generated this explicit interface implementation from .override directive in SetValue
				this.SetValue(host, value);
			}
		}

		private readonly IPropertySetImpl _Setter;

		public PropertySetHelper(Type propertyType, Expression<Func<TClass, object>> propertyExpression, bool includeSetter)
		{
			if (propertyExpression == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			MemberExpression memberExpression = propertyExpression.Body as MemberExpression;
			if (memberExpression == null)
			{
				if (propertyExpression.Body != null && propertyExpression.Body.NodeType == ExpressionType.Convert && propertyExpression.Body is UnaryExpression unaryExpression)
				{
					memberExpression = unaryExpression.Operand as MemberExpression;
					if (memberExpression != null)
					{
						goto IL_0060;
					}
				}
				throw new ArgumentException("Property expression is not a member access.", "prop");
			}
			goto IL_0060;
			IL_0060:
			PropertyInfo propertyInfo = (PropertyInfo)memberExpression.Member;
			ConstructorInfo constructor = typeof(PropertySetImpl<>).MakeGenericType(typeof(TClass), propertyType).GetConstructor(new Type[2]
			{
				typeof(PropertyInfo),
				typeof(bool)
			});
			_Setter = (IPropertySetImpl)constructor.Invoke(new object[2] { propertyInfo, includeSetter });
		}

		public object GetValue(TClass host)
		{
			return _Setter.GetValue(host);
		}

		public void SetValue(TClass host, object newValue)
		{
			_Setter.SetValue(host, RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(newValue));
		}
	}
	public class ScenarioFireGridItem : INotifyPropertyChanged, IPsvDataGridItem
	{
		private readonly MainViewModel _vm;

		private readonly IReadOnlyList<Scenario_FireVesselViewModel> _vesselVms;

		private readonly Type _propertyType;

		private readonly PropertySetHelper<MainViewModel> _SetterForVm;

		private readonly PropertySetHelper<Scenario_FireVesselViewModel> _SetterForVessel;

		private readonly Func<object, bool> _Validation;

		private readonly int _valueCount;

		private string _label;

		private Dictionary<int, bool> _isValueValid;

		private Dictionary<int, object> _originalValue;

		private Dictionary<int, object> _propertyValue;

		private bool _isSpecialLabel;

		private bool _hasUnit;

		private double _minValue;

		private double _maxValue;

		private string _maxValueBaseOnUnit;

		private string _unittype;

		private ValueConstraint _valueConstraint;

		private string _uomUnit;

		private string _toolTip;

		private System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment _contentAlignment;

		private bool _allowEmpty;

		public string Label => _label;

		public bool IsValueValidVesselN
		{
			get
			{
				bool value = false;
				_isValueValid.TryGetValue(vesselNumber, out value);
				return value;
			}
			set
			{
				_isValueValid[vesselNumber] = value;
			}
		}

		public object OriginalValueVesselN
		{
			get
			{
				object value = null;
				_originalValue.TryGetValue(vesselNumber, out value);
				return value;
			}
			set
			{
				_originalValue[vesselNumber] = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(value);
			}
		}

		private object _UnderlyingPropertyValue
		{
			get
			{
				if (_SetterForVm != null)
				{
					return _SetterForVm.GetValue(_vm);
				}
				return _SetterForVessel.GetValue(_vesselVms[checked(vesselNumber - 1)]);
			}
			set
			{
				if (_SetterForVm != null)
				{
					_SetterForVm.SetValue(_vm, RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(value));
				}
				else
				{
					_SetterForVessel.SetValue(_vesselVms[checked(vesselNumber - 1)], RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(value));
				}
			}
		}

		public object PropertyValueVesselN
		{
			get
			{
				object value = null;
				if (!_propertyValue.TryGetValue(vesselNumber, out value))
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (value is double && double.IsNaN(Conversions.ToDouble(value)))
				{
					return FormResource.str_Empty;
				}
				string text = value.ToString();
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					return FormResource.str_Empty;
				}
				if (Operators.CompareString(text, "blank", TextCompare: false) == 0)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return value;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (!this.get_IsValueValidVesselN(vesselNumber))
				{
					_propertyValue[vesselNumber] = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(value);
					return;
				}
				object value2 = null;
				if (_originalValue.TryGetValue(vesselNumber, out value2))
				{
					bool num = (value == null) & (_originalValue == null);
					bool flag = !num && value != null && value.Equals(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(value2));
					if (num || flag)
					{
						_propertyValue[vesselNumber] = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(value);
						return;
					}
				}
				if (_propertyType == typeof(string))
				{
					if (_Validation == null || _Validation(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(value)))
					{
						set__UnderlyingPropertyValue(vesselNumber, RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(value));
					}
					return;
				}
				if (_propertyType == typeof(double))
				{
					double result = double.NaN;
					if (!(value is double))
					{
						if (!double.TryParse(Conversions.ToString(value), out result))
						{
							return;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						result = Conversions.ToDouble(value);
					}
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(UOMUnit))
					{
						result = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(DefaultUnit, UOMUnit, result, UnitType);
					}
					set__UnderlyingPropertyValue(vesselNumber, (object)result);
				}
				else if (_propertyType == typeof(bool))
				{
					set__UnderlyingPropertyValue(vesselNumber, RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(value));
				}
				_propertyValue[vesselNumber] = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(value);
				_originalValue[vesselNumber] = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(value);
			}
		}

		public object PropertyValueVessel_1
		{
			get
			{
				return this.get_PropertyValueVesselN(1);

		private int _AssignPropertyValues(IEnumerable values)
		{
			int num = 1;
			checked
			{
				foreach (object value in values)
				{
					object objectValue = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(value);
					double result = double.NaN;
					if (_propertyType != typeof(double) || !double.TryParse(Conversions.ToString(objectValue), out result))
					{
						this.set_OriginalValueVesselN(num, RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(objectValue));
						this.set_PropertyValueVesselN(num, RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(objectValue));
					}
					else if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(UOMUnit) || string.Equals(UOMUnit, DefaultUnit, StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase))
					{
						this.set_OriginalValueVesselN(num, (object)result);
						this.set_PropertyValueVesselN(num, (object)result);
					}
					else
					{
						this.set_OriginalValueVesselN(num, (object)UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UOMUnit, DefaultUnit, result, _unittype));
						this.set_PropertyValueVesselN(num, (object)UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UOMUnit, DefaultUnit, result, _unittype));
					}
					num++;
				}
				return num - 1;
			}
		}

		private void _RefreshPropertyValues()
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			if (_valueCount > 0)
			{
				int valueCount = _valueCount;
				for (int i = 1; i <= valueCount; i = checked(i + 1))
				{
					arrayList.Add(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(get__UnderlyingPropertyValue(i)));
				}
			}
			else if (_SetterForVm != null)
			{
				arrayList.Add(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(get__UnderlyingPropertyValue(1)));
			}
			_AssignPropertyValues(arrayList);
		}

		public GridDataItem2(object value1, object value2, BaseViewModel vm, string label, string unittype = "", string defaultunit = "", string dbuom = "", bool hasunit = false, bool noFormat = false)
		{
			_bdisable = false;
			_bInactiveInline = false;
			_bInactiveOutline = false;
			HasUnit = false;
			_contentAlignment = System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Right;
			AllowEmpty = false;
			_propertyValue1 = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(value1);
			_propertyValue2 = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(value2);
			_vm = vm;
			DefaultUnit = defaultunit;
			HasUnit = hasunit;
			_dbuom = dbuom;
			_ut = unittype;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(DefaultUnit))
			{
				_rowLabel = label + " [" + DefaultUnit + "]";
			}
			else
			{
				_rowLabel = label;
			}
			double result = double.NaN;
			double result2 = double.NaN;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dbuom) & (string.Compare(dbuom, defaultunit, ignoreCase: true) != 0))
			{
				if (double.TryParse(value1.ToString(), out result))
				{
					_propertyValue1 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(dbuom, defaultunit, result, _ut);
				}
				else
				{
					_propertyValue1 = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(value1);
				}
				if (double.TryParse(value2.ToString(), out result2))
				{
					_propertyValue2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(dbuom, defaultunit, result2, _ut);
				}
				else
				{
					_propertyValue2 = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(value2);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (double.TryParse(value1.ToString(), out result) & (Operators.CompareString(label, FormResource.lbl_PipeSchedule, TextCompare: false) != 0))
				{
					_propertyValue1 = result;
				}
				else
				{
					_propertyValue1 = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(value1);
				}
				if (double.TryParse(value2.ToString(), out result2) & (Operators.CompareString(label, FormResource.lbl_PipeSchedule, TextCompare: false) != 0))
				{
					_propertyValue2 = result2;
				}
				else
				{
					_propertyValue2 = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(value2);
				}
			}
		}

		protected int ConvertToInt32(ref string str)
		{
			int result;
			try
			{
				result = Convert.ToInt32(str);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				ProjectData.SetProjectError(ex);
				Exception ex2 = ex;
				str = "0";
				result = 0;
				ProjectData.ClearProjectError();
			}
			return result;
		}

	public class MulValveConfigGridItem : INotifyPropertyChanged
	{

		private bool _isSetPreIncReadOnly;

		private bool _isReqFlowSplitReadOnly;

		public string Name => _prdvm.PRDName;

		public double SetPreInc
		{
			get
			{
				return _summaryvm.get_SplitSetPressureIncrease(_prdvm.Index);
			}
			set
			{
				_summaryvm.set_SplitSetPressureIncrease(_prdvm.Index, value);
				_summaryvm.UpdatePRDSystemMessages();
				NotifyAllPropertyChanged();
			}
		}

		public double SetPre => _prdvm.SetPressure;

		public double AllOverPre
		{
			get
			{
				if (_prdvm.SizingCaseModel != null)
				{
					return _prdvm.SizingCaseModel.SpecifiedOverpressurePct;
				}
				return double.NaN;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_prdvm.SizingCaseModel != null)
				{
					_prdvm.SizingCaseModel.SpecifiedOverpressurePct = value;
					_summaryvm.UpdatePRDSystemMessages();
					NotifyAllPropertyChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool CanEditOverPress
		{
			get

				return _caneditOverPress;
			}
			set
			{
				_caneditOverPress = value;
			}
		}

		public double RelPress
		{
			get
			{
				if (_prdvm.SizingCaseModel != null)
				{
					double num = _prdvm.SizingCaseModel.get_RelPress(notify: true);
					if (!double.IsNaN(num))
					{
						return UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.GaugePressure_barG, DefaultUnits.Instance.GaugePressDisplayUnit, num, "GaugePressure");
					}
					return num;
				}
				return double.NaN;
			}
		}

		public double ReqFlowSplit
		{
			get
			{
				return _summaryvm.get_FlowSplit(_prdvm.Index);
			}
			set
			{
				_summaryvm.set_FlowSplit(_prdvm.Index, value);
				NotifyAllPropertyChanged();
			}
		}

		public bool IsFlowSplitNormalized => _summaryvm.IsFlowSplitNormalized;

		public double FlowAmount => _prdvm.RelFlow;

		public double CalOri
		{
			get
			{
				if (_prdvm.SizingCaseModel != null)
				{
					if (_prdvm.SizingCaseModel.PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.Psv)
					{
						double num = _prdvm.SizingCaseModel.get_CalcOrifice(notify: true);
						if (!double.IsNaN(num))
						{
							return UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.SmallArea_cm2, DefaultUnits.Instance.AreaDisplayUnit, num, "SmallArea");
						}
						return num;
					}
					double num2 = _prdvm.SizingCaseModel.get_CalcRDDiam(notify: true);
					if (double.IsNaN(num2))
					{
						return double.NaN;
					}
					if (num2 > 0.0)
					{
						num2 = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.SmallLength2_cm, DefaultUnits.Instance.SmallLength2DisplayUnit, num2, "SmallLength2");
					}
					return num2;
				}
				return double.NaN;
			}
		}

		public object SelOri
		{
			get
			{
				if (_prdvm.SizingCaseModel != null)
				{
					return _prdvm.SizingCaseModel.SelectedOrificeName;
				}
				return null;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_prdvm.SizingCaseModel != null)
				{
					_prdvm.SizingCaseModel.SetSelectedValve(Conversions.ToString(value));
				}
			}
		}

		public double FractionOfFullLift => (_summaryvm?.PRDSystemModel?.DisplayedReliefDevice as PSVValveModel)?.LiftRestriction ?? double.NaN;

		public double RatedFlow
		{
			get
			{
				if (_prdvm.SizingCaseModel != null)
				{
					return UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(inputVal: (_prdvm.SizingCaseModel.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true) != OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod) ? _prdvm.SizingCaseModel.RatedFlow : _prdvm.SizingCaseModel.get_CalcMassFlowrate(notify: true), selectedUnit: UnitStrings.MassFlow_kgh, displayUnit: DefaultUnits.Instance.MassFlowDisplayUnit, unittype: "MassFlow");
				}
				return double.NaN;
			}
		}

		public double CapPer => _summaryvm.get_RatedFlowCapacity(_prdvm.Index) * 100.0;

		public bool IsSetPreIncReadOnly
		{

			}
			set

				_isSetPreIncReadOnly = value;
