	public class RatingSceGridItem
	{
		private PRDSummaryViewModel _prdSystemVM;

		private PSVScenarioModel _sce;

		private int _sceIndex;

		private int _resultType;

		private int _prdCount;

		private double _ratedFlowWarningPct;

		private bool _showratedflowWarning;

		public string SceName
		{
			get
			{
				if (_sce.IsSizingCase)
				{
					return "+" + _sce.ScenarioName;
				}
				return _sce.ScenarioName;
			}
		}

		public string SceType => TranslateUiStrings.EmergScenarioType.StringValue(_sce.EmergencyType);

		public double ReqFlow => UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(_sce.get_UOMRelFlow(notify: true), DefaultUnits.Instance.MassFlowDisplayUnit, _sce.get_RelFlow(notify: true), "MassFlow");

		public double CalOri => UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(_sce.UOMCalcOrifice, DefaultUnits.Instance.AreaDisplayUnit, _sce.get_CalcOrifice(notify: true), "SmallArea");

		private OrificeSizingMethod? Method => _sce.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true);

		public string PhaseMethod => TranslateUiStrings.OrificeSizingMethod.StringValue(Method);

		public double PRDA
		{
			get
			{
				if ((_sceIndex >= 0) & (_prdCount > 0))
				{
					if (_resultType == 0)
					{
						return _prdSystemVM.get_OrificeUsedFraction(_sceIndex, 0) * 100.0;
					}
					if (_resultType == 1)
					{
						return UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.SmallArea_cm2, DefaultUnits.Instance.AreaDisplayUnit, _prdSystemVM.get_OrificeUsedArea(_sceIndex, 0), "SmallArea");
					}
					if (_resultType == 2)
					{
						return UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.MassFlow_kgh, DefaultUnits.Instance.MassFlowDisplayUnit, _prdSystemVM.get_FlowAmountUsed(_sceIndex, 0), "MassFlow");
					}
					if (_resultType == 3)
					{
						return _prdSystemVM.get_FlowAmountOfTotalFraction(_sceIndex, 0) * 100.0;
					}
					return double.NaN;
				}
				return double.NaN;
			}
		}

		public string Background
		{
			get
			{
				if (!_prdSystemVM.get_IsPRDSystemSizedOK(_sceIndex))
				{
					return "Red";
				}
				if (!_prdSystemVM.get_IsPRDSystemCapacityOK(_sceIndex))
				{
					return "Yellow";
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}
		}

		public string PRDABackground
		{
			get
			{
				if ((_sceIndex >= 0) & (_prdCount > 0))
				{
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Background))
					{
						return Background;
					}
					if (_showratedflowWarning && _prdSystemVM.get_OrificeUsedFraction(_sceIndex, 0) > 0.0 && _prdSystemVM.get_OrificeUsedFraction(_sceIndex, 0) < _ratedFlowWarningPct / 100.0)
					{
						return "Yellow";
					}
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}
		}

		public double PRDB
		{
			get
			{
				if ((_sceIndex >= 0) & (_prdCount > 1))
				{
					if (_resultType == 0)

					}
					if (_resultType == 1)
					{
						return UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.SmallArea_cm2, DefaultUnits.Instance.AreaDisplayUnit, _prdSystemVM.get_OrificeUsedArea(_sceIndex, 1), "SmallArea");

					}
					return double.NaN;
				}
				return double.NaN;
			}
		}

			get
			{
				if ((_sceIndex >= 0) & (_prdCount > 1))

				if ((_sceIndex >= 0) & (_prdCount > 5))
				{
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Background))
					{
						return Background;
					}
					if ((_prdSystemVM.get_OrificeUsedFraction(_sceIndex, 5) > 0.0) & (_prdSystemVM.get_OrificeUsedFraction(_sceIndex, 5) < 0.6))
					{
						return "Yellow";
					}
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}
		}

		public double PRDG
		{
			get
			{
				if ((_sceIndex >= 0) & (_prdCount > 6))
				{
					if (_resultType == 0)
					{
						return _prdSystemVM.get_OrificeUsedFraction(_sceIndex, 6) * 100.0;
					}
					if (_resultType == 1)
					{
						return UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.SmallArea_cm2, DefaultUnits.Instance.AreaDisplayUnit, _prdSystemVM.get_OrificeUsedArea(_sceIndex, 6), "SmallArea");
					}
					if (_resultType == 2)
					{
						return UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.MassFlow_kgh, DefaultUnits.Instance.MassFlowDisplayUnit, _prdSystemVM.get_FlowAmountUsed(_sceIndex, 6), "MassFlow");
					}
					if (_resultType == 3)
					{
						return _prdSystemVM.get_FlowAmountOfTotalFraction(_sceIndex, 6) * 100.0;
					}
					return double.NaN;
				}
				return double.NaN;
			}
		}

		public PSVScenarioModel PSVModel
		{
			get
			{
				return mPSVScenarioModel;
			}
			set
			{
				mPSVScenarioModel = value;
			}
		}

		public bool InDesignMode
		{
			get
			{
				return !mPSVScenarioModel.IsLineSizingRatingMode;
			}
			set
			{
				if (mPSVScenarioModel.IsLineSizingRatingMode)
				{
					mPSVScenarioModel.IsLineSizingRatingMode = !value;
					NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("InDesignMode");
					NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("InRatingMode");
					NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("IsDisplayAccordingToOrificeSizingMethod");
					NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("IsLeungMethod");
				}
			}
		}

		public bool InRatingMode
		{
			get
			{
				return mPSVScenarioModel.IsLineSizingRatingMode;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!mPSVScenarioModel.IsLineSizingRatingMode && (!value || mPSVScenarioModel.get_LineSizingMethod(notify: true) == LineSizingMethod.Rigorous || System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(FormResource.rls_ChallengeChangeToRating, FormResource.rls_ChallengeTitle, MessageBoxButton.OKCancel) == MessageBoxResult.OK))
				{
					mPSVScenarioModel.IsLineSizingRatingMode = value;
					NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("InRatingMode");
					NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("InDesignMode");
					NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("IsDisplayAccordingToOrificeSizingMethod");
					NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("IsDisplayAvgVelocity");
					NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("IsLeungMethod");
				}
			}
		}

		public string PrdTypeIconPath
		{
			get
			{
				if (_splitPRDModels.Count <= 1)
				{
					return "/AspenTech.EquipmentAnalysis.PSVControlResources;component/Images/valve_small.png";

				return "/AspenTech.EquipmentAnalysis.PSVControlResources;component/Images/multivalve_small.png";
			}
		}

		private void ShowRigorousLineSizing_Execute(object parameter)
		{
			RigorousLineSizingDialog rigorousLineSizingDialog = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<RigorousLineSizingDialog>(uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]);
			rigorousLineSizingDialog.Initialize(mPSVScenarioModel);
			if (System.Windows.Application.Current != null && System.Windows.Application.Current.MainWindow != null)
			{
				rigorousLineSizingDialog.Owner = System.Windows.Application.Current.MainWindow;
			}
			bool? flag = rigorousLineSizingDialog.ShowDialog();
			if (flag.HasValue && flag.Value)
			{
				mPSVScenarioModel.AcceptPipeChanges();
			}
			else
			{
				mPSVScenarioModel.CancelPipeChanges();
			}
		}

		}

		private void ShowLegacySettingCommand_Execute(object parameter)
		{
			LineSizingLimitsDialog lineSizingLimitsDialog = new LineSizingLimitsDialog(uContainer, mPSVScenarioModel);
			if (System.Windows.Application.Current != null && System.Windows.Application.Current.MainWindow != null)
			{
				lineSizingLimitsDialog.Owner = System.Windows.Application.Current.MainWindow;
			}
			if (lineSizingLimitsDialog.ShowDialog() == true)
			{
				NotifyResultsPropertyChanged();
			}
		}

		public FireCalcMethod? FireCalculationMethod
		{
			get
			{
				return mPSVModel.get_FIRECalcMethod(notify: true);
			}
			set
			{
				int? num = (int?)value;
				int? num2 = (int?)mPSVModel.get_FIRECalcMethod(notify: true);
				if (((num.HasValue & num2.HasValue) ? new bool?(num.GetValueOrDefault() == num2.GetValueOrDefault()) : ((bool?)null)) == true)
				{
					return;
				}
				using (new WaitCursorOverride())
				{
					mPSVModel.set_FIRECalcMethod(notify: true, value);
					if (value.HasValue && value == FireCalcMethod.TwoPhaseRigorous)
					{
						this.set_FireCalculateExposedAreaVesselN(1, value: true);
					}
					NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("IsCalExposedAreaReadOnly");
					NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("RelTemp");
					NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("FireVesselCountList");
				}
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("IsRelTempOptionVisible");
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("IsVaryWettedVisible");
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("IsDisengagementCalculated");
			}
		}

		public bool IsCalExposedAreaReadOnly
		{
			get
			{
				if (!FireCalculationMethod.HasValue)
				{
					return true;
				}
				switch (FireCalculationMethod.GetValueOrDefault())
				{
				case FireCalcMethod.FIREWetted:
				case FireCalcMethod.FIREUnwetted:
				case FireCalcMethod.SinglePhaseRigorous:
				case FireCalcMethod.NFPA30:
					return false;
				case FireCalcMethod.TwoPhaseRigorous:
					return true;
				default:
					return true;
				}
			}
		}

		public Visibility IsVaryWettedVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (!FireCalculationMethod.HasValue)
				{
					return Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
				switch (FireCalculationMethod.GetValueOrDefault())
				{
				case FireCalcMethod.FIREWetted:
				case FireCalcMethod.FIREUnwetted:
				case FireCalcMethod.SinglePhaseRigorous:
				case FireCalcMethod.NFPA30:
					return Visibility.Collapsed;
				case FireCalcMethod.TwoPhaseRigorous:
					return Visibility.Visible;
				default:
					return Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsDisengagementCalculated
		{
			get
			{
				FireCalcMethod valueOrDefault = mPSVModel.get_FIRECalcMethod(notify: false).GetValueOrDefault();
				if (valueOrDefault == FireCalcMethod.FIREWetted || valueOrDefault == FireCalcMethod.NFPA30)
				{
					return CalculateDisengagement;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool CalculateDisengagement
		{
			get
			{
				return mPSVModel.FireCalculateDisengagement;

			set
			{
				mPSVModel.FireCalculateDisengagement = value;
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("IsDisengagementCalculated");
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("FireEditableLiquidLevelForNFPA30VesselN");
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable<int> FireVesselCountList
		{
			get
			{
				switch (FireCalculationMethod ?? FireCalcMethod.SinglePhaseRigorous)
				{
				case FireCalcMethod.FIREWetted:
				case FireCalcMethod.NFPA30:
					if (CalculateDisengagement)
					{
						return new int[1] { 1 };
					}
					return Enumerable.Range(1, 9);
				case FireCalcMethod.FIREUnwetted:
					return Enumerable.Range(1, 9);
				default:
					return new int[1] { 1 };
				}
			}
		}

		public int FireVesselCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (!_FireVesselCount.HasValue && mPSVModel.FIREVesselList != null)
				{
					_FireVesselCount = mPSVModel.FIREVesselList.Where([SpecialName] (Vessel_FireCalcModel v) => v.get_FIREVesselActive(notify: false)).Count();
				}
				return _FireVesselCount.GetValueOrDefault();
			}
			set
			{
				int fireVesselCount = FireVesselCount;
				if (value == fireVesselCount)
				{
					return;
				}
				_FireVesselCount = value;
				checked
				{
					if (value < fireVesselCount)
					{
						int num = fireVesselCount - 1;
						for (int i = value; i <= num; i++)
						{
							mPSVModel.FIREVesselList[i].set_FIREVesselActive(notify: true, value: false);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						int num2 = value - 1;
						for (int j = fireVesselCount; j <= num2; j++)
						{
							mPSVModel.FIREVesselList[j].set_FIREVesselActive(notify: true, value: true);
						}
					}
					NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("FireVesselCount");
				}
			}
		}

		public List<PTPhaseDataGridItem> GridDataSource
		{
			get
			{
				if (Information.IsNothing(_gridDataSource))
				{
					PTPhaseDataGridItem pTPhaseDataGridItem = new PTPhaseDataGridItem(this, 1);
					pTPhaseDataGridItem.Label = FormResource.Scenario_TubeRupture_Pressure;
					pTPhaseDataGridItem.MethodTooltip = FormResource.Scenario_TubeRupture_HighPressureSide_Pressure_Tooltip;
					pTPhaseDataGridItem.HasUnit = true;
					pTPhaseDataGridItem.UnitSource = GenaricSettings.GaugePressUnits;
					pTPhaseDataGridItem.UnitType = "GaugePressure";
					pTPhaseDataGridItem.UOMUnit = UnitStrings.GaugePressure_barG;
					pTPhaseDataGridItem.MinValue = -14.696;
					pTPhaseDataGridItem.MaxValueBaseOnUnit = UnitStrings.GaugePressure_psiG;
					PTPhaseDataGridItem pTPhaseDataGridItem2 = new PTPhaseDataGridItem(this, 2);
					pTPhaseDataGridItem2.Label = FormResource.Scenario_TubeRupture_Temperature;
					pTPhaseDataGridItem2.MethodTooltip = FormResource.Scenario_TubeRupture_HighPressureSide_Temp_Tooltip;
					pTPhaseDataGridItem2.HasUnit = true;
					pTPhaseDataGridItem2.UnitSource = GenaricSettings.TempUnits;
					pTPhaseDataGridItem2.UnitType = "Temperature";
					pTPhaseDataGridItem2.UOMUnit = UnitStrings.Temp_C;
					pTPhaseDataGridItem2.MinValue = -273.15;
					pTPhaseDataGridItem2.MaxValueBaseOnUnit = UnitStrings.Temp_C;
					PTPhaseDataGridItem pTPhaseDataGridItem3 = new PTPhaseDataGridItem(this, 3);
					pTPhaseDataGridItem3.Label = FormResource.Scenario_TubeRupture_Phase;
					pTPhaseDataGridItem3.HasComboBox = false;
					List<PTPhaseDataGridItem> list = new List<PTPhaseDataGridItem>();
					list.Add(pTPhaseDataGridItem);
					list.Add(pTPhaseDataGridItem2);
					list.Add(pTPhaseDataGridItem3);
					_gridDataSource = list;
				}
				return _gridDataSource;
			}
		}

		protected string NBoolToString(bool? b)
		{
			if (!b.HasValue)
			{
				return FormResource.str_Empty;
			}
			if (b.Value)
			{
				return FormResource.str_Yes;
			}
			return FormResource.str_No;
		}

	public class OrificeSizeSettingViewModel : BaseViewModel
	{
		private OrificeSizeSettingModel _orificeSizeModel;

		private ICommand _addRowCommand;

		private ICommand _removeRowCommand;

		private ObservableCollection<OrificeSpecViewModel> _availableOrifices;

		public ICommand AddRowCommand
		{
			get
			{
				return _addRowCommand;
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ref _addRowCommand, value, "AddRowCommand");
			}
		}

		public ICommand RemoveRowCommand
		{
			get
			{
				return _removeRowCommand;
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ref _removeRowCommand, value, "RemoveRowCommand");
			}
		}

		public ObservableCollection<OrificeSpecViewModel> AvailableOrifices => _availableOrifices;

		public OrificeSizeSettingViewModel(IUnityContainer unityContainer)
			: base(unityContainer)
		{
			_availableOrifices = new ObservableCollection<OrificeSpecViewModel>();
		}

		public void Initialize(PsvKey PSVkey = null)
		{
			base.Initialize();
			if (Information.IsNothing(_orificeSizeModel))
			{
				_orificeSizeModel = GetOrificeSettings();
			}
			LoadOrificeSpecifications();
			_addRowCommand = new Command(AddRowCommandExecute);
			_removeRowCommand = new Command(RemoveRowCommandExecute, RemoveRowCommandCanExecute);
		}

		private void AddRowCommandExecute(object obj)
		{
			AddNewOrifice();
		}

		private void RemoveRowCommandExecute(object obj)
		{
			//IL_004d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			XamDataGrid val = (XamDataGrid)((obj is XamDataGrid) ? obj : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (((DataPresenterBase)val).SelectedItems != null && ((SelectedItemCollectionBase)((DataPresenterBase)val).SelectedItems.Records).Count > 0)
			{
				List<int> list = new List<int>();
				foreach (DataRecord record in ((DataPresenterBase)val).SelectedItems.Records)
				{
					if (record.DataItem is OrificeSpecViewModel { Override: not false } orificeSpecViewModel)
					{
						list.Add(_availableOrifices.IndexOf(orificeSpecViewModel));
					}
				}
				if (System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(FormResource.ConfirmDeleteRows, FormResource.PSVSizing, MessageBoxButton.YesNo, MessageBoxImage.Exclamation) != MessageBoxResult.Yes)
				{
					return;
				}
				{
					foreach (int item in list.OrderByDescending([SpecialName] (int r) => r))
					{
						RemoveOrifice(item);
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			if (((DataPresenterBase)val).ActiveDataItem != null && ((DataPresenterBase)val).ActiveDataItem is OrificeSpecViewModel { Override: not false } orificeSpecViewModel2 && System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(FormResource.ConfirmDeleteRows, FormResource.PSVSizing, MessageBoxButton.YesNo, MessageBoxImage.Exclamation) == MessageBoxResult.Yes)
			{
				RemoveOrifice(_availableOrifices.IndexOf(orificeSpecViewModel2));
			}
		}

		private bool RemoveRowCommandCanExecute(object obj)
		{
			//IL_0041: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			XamDataGrid val = (XamDataGrid)((obj is XamDataGrid) ? obj : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				if (((DataPresenterBase)val).SelectedItems != null && ((SelectedItemCollectionBase)((DataPresenterBase)val).SelectedItems.Records).Count > 0)
				{
					foreach (DataRecord record in ((DataPresenterBase)val).SelectedItems.Records)
					{
						if (record.DataItem is OrificeSpecViewModel { Override: not false })
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
				else if (((DataPresenterBase)val).ActiveDataItem != null && ((DataPresenterBase)val).ActiveDataItem is OrificeSpecViewModel { Override: not false })
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void LoadOrificeSpecifications()
		{
			_availableOrifices.Clear();
			foreach (OrificeSpecModel item in _orificeSizeModel.get_AvailableOrifices(ReliefDeviceType.Psv))
			{
				OrificeSpecViewModel orificeSpecViewModel = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<OrificeSpecViewModel>(uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]);
				orificeSpecViewModel.Initialize(item);
				_availableOrifices.Add(orificeSpecViewModel);
			}
		}

		public void AddNewOrifice()
		{
			OrificeSpecModel oSpecModel = _orificeSizeModel.CreateCustomOrifice(uContainer);
			OrificeSpecViewModel orificeSpecViewModel = new OrificeSpecViewModel();
			orificeSpecViewModel.Initialize(oSpecModel);
			_availableOrifices.Add(orificeSpecViewModel);
		}

		public void RemoveOrifice(int index)
		{
			if (_orificeSizeModel.RemoveCustomOrifice(index))
			{
				_availableOrifices.RemoveAt(index);
			}
		}
	}
	public class OrificeSpecViewModel : INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private static List<string> _designationValues = GetDesignationValues();

		private OrificeSpecModel _orificeSpecModel;

		private double _area;

		private string _inletSizing;

		private string _inletRating;

		private string _outletSizing;

		private string _outletRating;

		public static List<string> ApiDesignations => _designationValues;

		public bool Override => !_orificeSpecModel.IsBuiltInOrifice;

		public string OrificeName
		{
			get
			{
				return _orificeSpecModel.OrificeName;
			}
			set
			{
				_orificeSpecModel.OrificeName = value;
			}
		}

		public string Designation
		{
			get
			{
				return TranslateUiStrings.ApiDesignation.StringValue(_orificeSpecModel.Designation);
			}
			set
			{
				if (Operators.CompareString(value, FormResource.str_Empty, TextCompare: false) == 0)
				{
					_orificeSpecModel.Designation = null;
				}
				else
				{
					_orificeSpecModel.Designation = TranslateUiStrings.ApiDesignation.Enum(value);
				}
			}
		}

		public double Area
		{
			get
			{
				return _area;
			}
			set
			{
				_area = value;
			}
		}

		public string InletFlange
		{
			get
			{
				return _inletSizing;
			}
			set
			{
				_inletSizing = value;
			}
		}

		public string InletFlangeRating
		{
			get
			{
				return _inletRating;
			}
			set
			{
				_inletRating = value;
			}
		}

		public string OutletFlange
		{
			get
			{
				return _outletSizing;
			}
			set

		public void UpdateModelProperty(string propname, double value)
		{
			switch (propname)
			{
			case "Area":
			{
				double num = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(DefaultUnits.Instance.AreaDisplayUnit, UnitStrings.SmallArea_cm2, value, "SmallArea");
				if (!Common.IsSameValue(num, _orificeSpecModel.Area))
				{
					_orificeSpecModel.Area = Conversions.ToDouble(Format.FormatOrificeValue(num));
				}
				break;
			}
			case "InletFlange":
				_orificeSpecModel.InletFlangeSize = value;
				break;
			case "InletFlangeRating":
				_orificeSpecModel.InletFlangeRating = value;
				break;
			case "OutletFlange":
				_orificeSpecModel.OutletFlangeSize = value;
				break;
			case "OutletFlangeRating":
				_orificeSpecModel.OutletFlangeRating = value;
				break;
			case "VaporKd":
				_orificeSpecModel.VaporKd = value;
				break;
			case "LiquidKd":
				_orificeSpecModel.LiquidKd = value;
				break;
			case "MixedKd":
				_orificeSpecModel.MixedKd = value;
				break;
			}
		}

	public class OrificeKdValidationRule : ValidationRule
	{
		public override ValidationResult Validate(object value, CultureInfo cultureInfo)
		{
			double result = double.NaN;
			if (value is double)
			{
				result = Conversions.ToDouble(value);
			}
			else if (!double.TryParse(value.ToString(), out result))
			{
				return new ValidationResult(isValid: false, FormResource.ErrorInvalidKd);
			}
			if (result <= 0.0 || result > 1.0)
			{
				return new ValidationResult(isValid: false, FormResource.ErrorInvalidKd);
			}
			return new ValidationResult(isValid: true, null);
		}
	}

						return string.Empty;
					}
					PSVScenarioModel pSVScenarioModel = _myPRDModel.ScenarioModels.FirstOrDefault([SpecialName] (PSVScenarioModel s) => s.IsSizingCase);
					if (pSVScenarioModel == null)
					{
						return FormResource.str_Empty;
					}
					if (double.IsNaN(pSVScenarioModel.InND))
					{
						return FormResource.str_Empty;
					}
					return Format.FormatNumber(UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.SmallLength_in, DefaultUnits.Instance.SmallLength2DisplayUnit, pSVScenarioModel.InND, "SmallLength2"));
				}
			}

			public string RDDiameter
			{
				get
				{
					if (IsBlankSeparator)
					{
						return string.Empty;
					}
					PSVScenarioModel pSVScenarioModel = _myPRDModel.ScenarioModels.FirstOrDefault([SpecialName] (PSVScenarioModel s) => s.IsSizingCase);
					if (pSVScenarioModel == null)
					{
						return FormResource.str_Empty;
					}
					if (double.IsNaN(pSVScenarioModel.SelRDDiam))
					{
						return FormResource.str_Empty;
					}
					return Format.FormatNumber(UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.SmallLength2_cm, DefaultUnits.Instance.SmallLength2DisplayUnit, pSVScenarioModel.SelRDDiam, "SmallLength2"));
				}
			}

			public string OutletDiameter
			{
				get
				{
					if (IsBlankSeparator)
					{
						return string.Empty;
					}
					PSVScenarioModel pSVScenarioModel = _myPRDModel.ScenarioModels.FirstOrDefault([SpecialName] (PSVScenarioModel s) => s.IsSizingCase);
					if (pSVScenarioModel == null)
					{
						return FormResource.str_Empty;
					}
					if (double.IsNaN(pSVScenarioModel.OutND))
					{
						return FormResource.str_Empty;
					}
					return Format.FormatNumber(UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.SmallLength_in, DefaultUnits.Instance.SmallLength2DisplayUnit, pSVScenarioModel.OutND, "SmallLength2"));
				}
			}

			public string DiskLD
			{
				get
				{
					if (IsBlankSeparator)
					{
						return string.Empty;
					}
					PSVScenarioModel pSVScenarioModel = _myPRDModel.ScenarioModels.FirstOrDefault([SpecialName] (PSVScenarioModel s) => s.IsSizingCase);
					if (pSVScenarioModel == null)
					{
						return FormResource.str_Empty;
					}
					if (double.IsNaN(pSVScenarioModel.get_RDLOverD(notify: true, byUser: true)))
					{
						return FormResource.str_Empty;
					}
					return Format.FormatNumber(pSVScenarioModel.get_RDLOverD(notify: true, byUser: true));
				}
			}

			public string Notes
			{
				get
				{
					if (IsBlankSeparator)
					{
						return string.Empty;
					}
					return _myPRDModel.ValveMessages;
				}
			}

			public MessageLevel MessageLevel
			{
				get
				{
					if (IsBlankSeparator)
					{
						return MessageLevel.Uninitialized;
					}
					return _myPRDModel.ValveMessageLevel;
				}
			}

			public PRDModel DataSourceModel => _myPRDModel;

			public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

			public RuptureDiskSummaryData(ref PRDModel prdModel, bool isspare)
			{
				IsBlankSeparator = false;
				_bspare = false;
				_myPRDModel = prdModel;
				_bspare = isspare;
				_myPRDModel.ScenarioUpdated += UpdateProperties;
			}

			public RuptureDiskSummaryData()
			{
				IsBlankSeparator = false;
				_bspare = false;
				IsBlankSeparator = true;
			}

			public void UpdateProperties()
			{
				PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs("CalcOrifice"));
				PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs("SelectOrifice"));
				PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs("OutletFlageSize"));
				PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs("OutletFlageRating"));
				PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs("FlageDesCode"));
				PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs("InletFlageRating"));
				PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs("InletFlageSize"));
				UpdateMessageProperties();
			}

			public void NotifyNameChanged()
			{
				PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs("PRDName"));
			}

			void IDeviceData.NotifyNameChanged()
			{
				//ILSpy generated this explicit interface implementation from .override directive in NotifyNameChanged
				this.NotifyNameChanged();
			}

			public void NotifyRealFieldChanged()
			{
				PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs("CalcOrifice"));
				PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs("SelectOrifice"));
				PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs("InletDiameter"));
				PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs("OutletDiameter"));
				PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs("RDDiameter"));
			}

			public void UpdateMessageProperties()
			{
				PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs("MessageLevel"));
				PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs("Notes"));
			}

			public void CleanEvent()
			{
				if (!IsBlankSeparator)
				{
					_myPRDModel.ScenarioUpdated -= UpdateProperties;
				}
			}
		}

		private PRDModel mCurrentPRDModel
		{
			get
			{
				if (mPRDSystemModel == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return mPRDSystemModel.DisplayedReliefDevice;
			}
			set
			{
				if (mPRDSystemModel != null || value != null)
				{
					mPRDSystemModel.DisplayedReliefDevice = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("mCurrentPRDModel");
				}
			}
		}

		private PSVScenarioModel mSizingScenarioModel
		{
			get
			{
				if (!Information.IsNothing(mCurrentPRDModel))
				{
					PSVScenarioModel sizingCaseModel = mCurrentPRDModel.GetSizingCaseModel();
					if (sizingCaseModel != _sizingScenarioModel)
					{
						if (!Information.IsNothing(_sizingScenarioModel))
						{
							_sizingScenarioModel.RemoveObserver(this);
						}
						_sizingScenarioModel = sizingCaseModel;
						if (!Information.IsNothing(_sizingScenarioModel))
						{
							_sizingScenarioModel.AddObserver(this);
						}
					}
					return sizingCaseModel;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public string ImageString
		{
			get
			{
				if (mPRDSystemModel.SystemType == ReliefDeviceType.Psv)
				{
					if (mPRDSystemModel.SplitPRDModels.Count > 1)
					{
						return "/AspenTech.EquipmentAnalysis.PSVControlResources;component/Images/multivalve_small.png";
					}
					return "/AspenTech.EquipmentAnalysis.PSVControlResources;component/Images/valve_small.png";
				}
				return "/AspenTech.EquipmentAnalysis.PSVControlResources;component/Images/rupture_disc_small.png";
			}
		}

		public bool IsFirstPRD
		{
			get
			{
				bool result = false;
				if (mCurrentPRDModel != null)
				{
					if (mCurrentPRDModel.IsOverallModel)
					{
						result = true;
					}
					else if (mCurrentPRDModel.ModelKey == mPRDSystemModel.SplitPRDModels[0].ModelKey)
					{
						result = true;
					}
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		public ObservableCollection<PRDSummaryData> PRDDataCollection { get; }

		public ReliefDeviceType SystemType => mPRDSystemModel.SystemType;

		public int PRDType
		{
			get
			{
				if (mPRDSystemModel.SystemType == ReliefDeviceType.Psv)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return 1;
			}
			set
			{
				System.Windows.Input.Mouse.OverrideCursor = System.Windows.Input.Cursors.Wait;
				if (value != Convert.ToInt32((int)mPRDSystemModel.SystemType))
				{
					ReliefDeviceType systemType = mPRDSystemModel.SystemType;
					mPRDSystemModel.SystemType = (ReliefDeviceType)value;
					FillInGridSource();
					if (value == 0)
					{
						mCurrentPRDModel = PRDDataCollection.First().DataSourceModel;
					}
					else
					{
						mCurrentPRDModel = RuptureDiskCollection.First().DataSourceModel;
					}
					base.NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("PRDType");
					base.NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("PRDMaterials");
					base.NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("PRDTypes");
					base.NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("VMaterial");
					base.NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("VMaterialString");
					base.NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("VType");
					base.NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("VTypeString");
					NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("Coeff_Kd");
					if (mPRDSystemModel.SystemType == ReliefDeviceType.Psv)
					{
						NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("Coeff_Kc");
						NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("RuptDisk");
					}
					else
					{
						NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("NegDesType");
						NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("PosDesType");
						NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("BurstTolType");
						NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("RDNegDesPBoolType");
						NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("RDNotNegDesPBoolType");
						NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("RDPosDesPBoolType");
						NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("RDNotPosDesPBoolType");
						NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("RDBurstTolPBoolType");
						NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("RDNotBurstTolPBoolType");
						base.NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("RDLOverD_Visibility");
						base.NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("RDNegDesPRange");
						base.NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("RDNegDesPPercent");
						NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("RDPosDesPPercent");
						NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("RDPosDesPRange");
						base.NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("RDBurstTol");
						NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("RDBurstTolPercent");
					}
					((CompositePresentationEvent<PRDTypeChangedEventArgs>)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<PRDTypeChangedEvent>()).Publish(new PRDTypeChangedEventArgs(systemType, mPRDSystemModel.SystemType));
					mPRDSystemModel.RaisePRDSystemModelPropertyChangedEvent(this, "PRDType");
					NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("ImageString");
					NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("IsPilotOperatedValve");
				}
				System.Windows.Input.Mouse.OverrideCursor = null;
			}
		}

					mPRDSystemModel.CalcCode = null;

		{
			get
			{
				return mCurrentPRDModel.Suffix;
			}
			set
			{
				string text = string.Empty;
				if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
				{
					text = value.Trim();
				}
				if (Operators.CompareString(mCurrentPRDModel.Suffix, text, TextCompare: false) != 0)
				{
					mCurrentPRDModel.Suffix = text;
					UpdateCurrentPRDSuffix();
				}
			}
		}

		public int SplitModelCount => mPRDSystemModel.SplitPRDModels.Count;

		public double SetPressure
		{
			get
			{
				return UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.GaugePressure_barG, DefaultUnits.Instance.GaugePressDisplayUnit, mCurrentPRDModel.get_SetPressure(recalculateOnChange: true), "GaugePressure");
			}
			set
			{
				double num = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(DefaultUnits.Instance.GaugePressDisplayUnit, UnitStrings.GaugePressure_barG, value, "GaugePressure");
				if (!Common.IsSameValue(mPRDSystemModel.OverallPRDModel.get_SetPressure(recalculateOnChange: true), num))
				{
					mPRDSystemModel.UpdateSystemSetPressures(num, notify: true);
					UpdatePRDMessages();
					NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("BurstTolType");
					NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("RDBurstTolPBoolType");
					NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("RDNotBurstTolPBoolType");
					NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("RelPress");
					mPRDSystemModel.RaisePRDSystemModelPropertyChangedEvent(this, "SetPressure");
				}
			}
		}

		public bool UseDP
		{
			get
			{
				return mPRDSystemModel.OverallPRDModel.get_IsSetPressFromDesign(updateSystem: true);
			}
			set
			{
				if (mCurrentPRDModel != null)
				{
					mCurrentPRDModel.set_IsSetPressFromDesign(updateSystem: true, value);
					PRDSystemModel pRDSystemModel = mPRDSystemModel;
					PRDModel modifiedPRD = mCurrentPRDModel;
					pRDSystemModel.PRDInputChanged(ref modifiedPRD);
					mCurrentPRDModel = modifiedPRD;
					mPRDSystemModel.UpdatePRDSetPressures();
					NotifyPropertyChanged("SetPressure");
					if (value)
					{
						UpdatePRDMessages();
					}
					mPRDSystemModel.RaisePRDSystemModelPropertyChangedEvent(this, "UseDP");
				}
			}
		}

		public double ConstBackPress
		{
			get
			{
				return UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(mPRDSystemModel.OverallPRDModel.UOMSuperImpConstBackPress, DefaultUnits.Instance.AbsPressDisplayUnit, mPRDSystemModel.OverallPRDModel.ConstBackPress, "AbsolutePressure");
			}
			set
			{
				double num = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(DefaultUnits.Instance.AbsPressDisplayUnit, mPRDSystemModel.OverallPRDModel.UOMSuperImpConstBackPress, value, "AbsolutePressure");
				if (!Common.IsSameValue(mPRDSystemModel.OverallPRDModel.ConstBackPress, num))
				{
					mPRDSystemModel.OverallPRDModel.ConstBackPress = num;
					UpdatePRDMessages();
					mPRDSystemModel.RaisePRDSystemModelPropertyChangedEvent(this, "ConstBackPress");
				}
			}
		}

				{
					return (TranslateUiStrings.OrificeSizingMethod.Enum(Method) ?? OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_Direct) == OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod;

		public Visibility RDLOverD_Visibility
		{
			get
			{
				IPSVMessager iPSVMessager = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IPSVMessager>(uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]);
				if (!Information.IsNothing(iPSVMessager) & (Operators.CompareString(iPSVMessager.PSVHostType, "ASPENPLUS", TextCompare: false) == 0))
				{
					if (mPRDSystemModel.SystemType.Equals(ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk))
					{
						return Visibility.Visible;
					}
					return Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
				return Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
		}

		public List<string> PRDTypes => _prdtypes[mPRDSystemModel.SystemType];

		public string VTypeString
		{
			get
			{
				if (mCurrentPRDModel == null)
				{
					return "";
				}
				if (mPRDSystemModel.SystemType == ReliefDeviceType.Psv)
				{
					return TranslateUiStrings.PsvType.StringValue(((PSVValveModel)mCurrentPRDModel).ValveType);
				}
				return TranslateUiStrings.RuptureDiskType.StringValue(((RuptureDiskModel)mCurrentPRDModel).RDSelDiskType);
			}
			set
			{
				if (mCurrentPRDModel == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (mPRDSystemModel.SystemType == ReliefDeviceType.Psv)
				{
					PsvType? valveType = TranslateUiStrings.PsvType.Enum(value);
					if (valveType.HasValue)
					{
						((PSVValveModel)mCurrentPRDModel).ValveType = valveType;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					RuptureDiskType? rDSelDiskType = TranslateUiStrings.RuptureDiskType.Enum(value);
					if (rDSelDiskType.HasValue)
					{
						((RuptureDiskModel)mCurrentPRDModel).RDSelDiskType = rDSelDiskType;
					}
				}
				PRDSystemModel pRDSystemModel = mPRDSystemModel;
				PRDModel modifiedPRD = mCurrentPRDModel;
				pRDSystemModel.PRDInputChanged(ref modifiedPRD);
				mCurrentPRDModel = modifiedPRD;
				mPRDSystemModel.RaisePRDSystemModelPropertyChangedEvent(this, "VType");
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("VTypeString");
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("RDOperRatio");
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("IsPilotOperatedValve");
			}
		}

		public List<string> PRDMaterials => _prdMaterials[mPRDSystemModel.SystemType];

		public string VMaterialString
		{
			get
			{
				return PRDMaterials[VMaterial];
			}
			set
			{
				VMaterial = PRDMaterials.IndexOf(value);
			}
		}

		public int VMaterial
		{
			get
			{
				if (mPRDSystemModel.SystemType == ReliefDeviceType.Psv)
				{
					string text = TranslateUiStrings.ApiValveMaterial.StringValue(((PSVValveModel)mCurrentPRDModel).ValveMaterial);
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
					{
						_prdmaterial = 2;
					}
					else
					{
						_prdmaterial = _prdMaterials[mPRDSystemModel.SystemType].FindIndex([SpecialName] (string m) => string.Compare(m.Trim(), text.Trim(), ignoreCase: true) == 0);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					string text2 = TranslateUiStrings.EquipmentMaterial.StringValue(((RuptureDiskModel)mCurrentPRDModel).RDSelBodyMtl);
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
					{
						_prdmaterial = 0;
					}
					else
					{
						_prdmaterial = _prdMaterials[mPRDSystemModel.SystemType].FindIndex([SpecialName] (string m) => string.Compare(m.Trim(), text2.Trim(), ignoreCase: true) == 0);
					}
				}
				return _prdmaterial;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_prdmaterial != value && value != -1)
				{
					_prdmaterial = value;
					if (mPRDSystemModel.SystemType.Equals(ReliefDeviceType.Psv))
					{
						((PSVValveModel)mCurrentPRDModel).ValveMaterial = TranslateUiStrings.ApiValveMaterial.Enum(_prdMaterials[mPRDSystemModel.SystemType][value]);
					}
					else
					{
						((RuptureDiskModel)mCurrentPRDModel).RDSelBodyMtl = TranslateUiStrings.EquipmentMaterial.Enum(_prdMaterials[mPRDSystemModel.SystemType][value]);
					}
					PRDSystemModel pRDSystemModel = mPRDSystemModel;
					PRDModel modifiedPRD = mCurrentPRDModel;
					pRDSystemModel.PRDInputChanged(ref modifiedPRD);
					mCurrentPRDModel = modifiedPRD;
					mPRDSystemModel.RaisePRDSystemModelPropertyChangedEvent(this, "VMaterial");
					base.NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("VMaterialString");
					UpdatePRDMessages();
				}
			}
		}

		public double Coeff_Kc
		{
			get
			{
				if (Information.IsNothing(mCurrentPRDModel))
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
				if (mPRDSystemModel.SystemType != ReliefDeviceType.Psv || !(mCurrentPRDModel is PSVValveModel { Coeff_Kc: var coeff_Kc }))
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
				return coeff_Kc;
			}
			set
			{
				if (mPRDSystemModel.SystemType == ReliefDeviceType.Psv)
				{
					if (mCurrentPRDModel is PSVValveModel pSVValveModel && !Common.IsSameValue(pSVValveModel.Coeff_Kc, value))
					{
						pSVValveModel.Coeff_Kc = value;
						PRDSystemModel pRDSystemModel = mPRDSystemModel;
						PRDModel modifiedPRD = mCurrentPRDModel;
						pRDSystemModel.PRDInputChanged(ref modifiedPRD);
						mCurrentPRDModel = modifiedPRD;
					}
					mPRDSystemModel.RaisePRDSystemModelPropertyChangedEvent(this, "Coeff_Kc");
					UpdatePRDMessages();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool RuptDisk
		{
			get
			{
				if (Information.IsNothing(mCurrentPRDModel))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (mPRDSystemModel.SystemType != ReliefDeviceType.Psv || !(mCurrentPRDModel is PSVValveModel { RuptDisk: var ruptDisk }))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return ruptDisk;
			}
			set
			{
				if (mPRDSystemModel.SystemType == ReliefDeviceType.Psv)
				{
					if (mCurrentPRDModel is PSVValveModel pSVValveModel)
					{
						pSVValveModel.RuptDisk = value;
						NotifyPropertyChanged("Coeff_Kc");
						PRDSystemModel pRDSystemModel = mPRDSystemModel;
						PRDModel modifiedPRD = mCurrentPRDModel;
						pRDSystemModel.PRDInputChanged(ref modifiedPRD);
						mCurrentPRDModel = modifiedPRD;
					}
					mPRDSystemModel.RaisePRDSystemModelPropertyChangedEvent(this, "RuptDisk");
					UpdatePRDMessages();
				}
			}
		}

		public double LiftRestriction
		{
			get
			{
				if (Information.IsNothing(mCurrentPRDModel))
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
				if (mPRDSystemModel.SystemType != ReliefDeviceType.Psv || !(mCurrentPRDModel is PSVValveModel { LiftRestriction: var liftRestriction }))
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
				return liftRestriction;
			}
			set
			{
				if (mPRDSystemModel.SystemType == ReliefDeviceType.Psv)
				{
					if (mCurrentPRDModel is PSVValveModel pSVValveModel && !Common.IsSameValue(pSVValveModel.LiftRestriction, value))
					{
						pSVValveModel.LiftRestriction = value;
						PRDSystemModel pRDSystemModel = mPRDSystemModel;
						PRDModel modifiedPRD = mCurrentPRDModel;
						pRDSystemModel.PRDInputChanged(ref modifiedPRD);
						mCurrentPRDModel = modifiedPRD;
					}
					mPRDSystemModel.RaisePRDSystemModelPropertyChangedEvent(this, "LiftRestriction");
					UpdatePRDMessages();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsRestrictedLift
		{
			get
			{
				if (Information.IsNothing(mCurrentPRDModel))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (mPRDSystemModel.SystemType != ReliefDeviceType.Psv || !(mCurrentPRDModel is PSVValveModel { IsRestrictedLift: var isRestrictedLift }))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return isRestrictedLift;
			}
			set
			{
				if (mPRDSystemModel.SystemType == ReliefDeviceType.Psv)
				{
					if (mCurrentPRDModel is PSVValveModel pSVValveModel)
					{
						pSVValveModel.IsRestrictedLift = value;
						PRDSystemModel pRDSystemModel = mPRDSystemModel;
						PRDModel modifiedPRD = mCurrentPRDModel;
						pRDSystemModel.PRDInputChanged(ref modifiedPRD);
						mCurrentPRDModel = modifiedPRD;
						NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("LiftRestriction");
					}
					mPRDSystemModel.RaisePRDSystemModelPropertyChangedEvent(this, "IsRestrictedLift");
					NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("LiftRestriction");
					UpdatePRDMessages();
				}
			}
		}

		public string PRDMessages
		{
			get
			{
				string pRDSystemMessages = mPRDSystemModel.PRDSystemMessages;
				if (!Information.IsNothing(pRDSystemMessages))
				{
					return pRDSystemMessages;
				}
				if (mPRDSystemModel.PRDSystemMessageLevel == MessageLevel.Error)
				{
					return FormResource.lbl_Error;
				}
				if (mPRDSystemModel.PRDSystemMessageLevel == MessageLevel.Warning)
				{
					return FormResource.str_Warning;
				}
				return FormResource.str_OK;
			}
		}

		public string KshFromCal
		{
			get
			{
				if (mSizingScenarioModel == null)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return (mSizingScenarioModel.Coeff_Ksh_opt == ProcessDataSource.Calculated) ? "Calculated" : "by User";
			}
			set
			{
				if (mSizingScenarioModel != null)
				{
					mSizingScenarioModel.Coeff_Ksh_opt = ((Operators.CompareString(value, "Calculated", TextCompare: false) == 0) ? ProcessDataSource.Calculated : ProcessDataSource.Specified);
					NotifyPropertyChanged("KshFromCal");
					NotifyPropertyChanged("IsNotUserEnteredKsh");
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsNotUserEnteredKsh
		{
			get
			{
				if (mSizingScenarioModel != null)
				{
					return mSizingScenarioModel.Coeff_Ksh_opt != ProcessDataSource.Specified;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public string NoiseLevel
		{
			get
			{

					return FormResource.str_Empty;

				{
					return FormResource.str_Empty;
				}
				return string.Format("{0} {1}", Format.FormatNumber(mSizingScenarioModel.get_Noise(notify: true)), "dBA");
			}
		}

			get
			{
				if (mPRDSystemModel.SystemType == ReliefDeviceType.Psv)
				{
					return ((PSVValveModel)mCurrentPRDModel).IsRemoteSensingPilot;
				}
				return false;
			}
			set
			{
				if (mPRDSystemModel.SystemType == ReliefDeviceType.Psv)
				{
					((PSVValveModel)mCurrentPRDModel).IsRemoteSensingPilot = value;
				}
			}
		}

				{
					_addPRDCommand = new Command(AddNewPRD, CanAddPRD);

				return _addPRDCommand;

		}

				return FormResource.str_Empty;

		public PRDDataViewModel(IUnityContainer unityContainer)
			: base(unityContainer)
		{
			mAddHandler = false;
			PRDDataCollection = new ObservableCollection<PRDSummaryData>();
			_disList = null;
			_disDes = 1;
			_prdtypes = null;
			_prdMaterials = null;
			_prdmaterial = 0;
			_posDesType = 0;
			_negDesType = 0;
			_burstTolType = 1;
			_RuptureDiskCollection = new ObservableCollection<RuptureDiskSummaryData>();
			_addPRDCommand = null;
			_addSpareCommand = null;
			_delPRDCommand = null;
			_delSpareCommand = null;
		}

		public void Initialize(ref PRDSystemModel prdSystemModel)
		{
			Initialize();
			if (!Information.IsNothing(mPRDSystemModel))
			{
				mPRDSystemModel.DePressChanged -= OnPRDSystemDataChanged;
				mPRDSystemModel.PRDSystemModelPropertyChanged -= OnPRDModelPropertyChanged;
				mPRDSystemModel.OnActivePRDChanged -= OnActivePRDChanged;
				mPRDSystemModel.SplitModelCountChanged -= OnSplitModelCountChanged;
			}
			mPRDSystemModel = prdSystemModel;
			SetActivePRDModel();
			GenerateMaterialAndTypeLists();
			_disList = TranslateUiStrings.DischargeLocation.StringValues;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(mPRDSystemModel.FluidDischarge))
			{
				_disDes = (int)(mPRDSystemModel.FluidDischargeId ?? ((AspenTech.EquipmentAnalysis.Infrastructure.DischargeLocation)(-1)));
			}
			AddSizingScenarioEventHandler();
			mPRDSystemModel.DePressChanged += OnPRDSystemDataChanged;
			mPRDSystemModel.PRDSystemModelPropertyChanged += OnPRDModelPropertyChanged;
			mPRDSystemModel.OnActivePRDChanged += OnActivePRDChanged;
			mPRDSystemModel.SplitModelCountChanged += OnSplitModelCountChanged;
			((CompositePresentationEvent<EventArgs>)(object)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<UpdateOrificeSizesEvent>()).Subscribe((Action<EventArgs>)OnOrificeSizesChanged);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<EventArgs>)(object)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<DefaultWarningSeetingChangedEvent>()).Subscribe((Action<EventArgs>)OnWarningSettingChanged);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<SizingCaseChangedEventArgs>)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<SizingCaseChangedEvent>()).Subscribe((Action<SizingCaseChangedEventArgs>)OnSizingCaseChanged);
			Make("PRDSuffix").ObservesProperty(() => mCurrentPRDModel.Suffix);
		}

		private void OnSplitModelCountChanged()
		{
			OnPropertyChanged("PRDSuffix");
			OnPropertyChanged("IsRestrictedLift");
			OnPropertyChanged("LiftRestriction");
		}

		private void OnWarningSettingChanged(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (mPRDSystemModel != null)
			{
				UpdatePRDMessages();
			}
		}

		private void OnOrificeSizesChanged(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (mPRDSystemModel != null)
			{
				UpdatePRDMessages();
			}
		}

		private void OnPRDModelPropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender.GetHashCode() == GetHashCode())
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (e.PropertyName)
			{
			case "UseDP":
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("UseDP");
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("SetPressure");
				break;
			case "SetPressure":
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("SetPressure");
				break;
			case "PRDNotes":
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("PRDNotes");
				break;
			case "DischargeTo":
				if (mPRDSystemModel != null)
				{
					_ = mPRDSystemModel.FluidDischarge;
					_disDes = (int)(mPRDSystemModel.FluidDischargeId ?? ((AspenTech.EquipmentAnalysis.Infrastructure.DischargeLocation)(-1)));
					NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("DischargeTo");
				}
				break;
			case "PRDService":
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("PRDService");
				break;
			case "PRDType":
				FillInGridSource();
				if (mPRDSystemModel.SystemType == ReliefDeviceType.Psv)
				{
					mCurrentPRDModel = PRDDataCollection.First().DataSourceModel;
				}
				else
				{
					mCurrentPRDModel = RuptureDiskCollection.First().DataSourceModel;
				}
				base.NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("PRDType");
				base.NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("PRDMaterials");
				base.NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("PRDTypes");
				base.NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("VMaterial");
				base.NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("VMaterialString");
				base.NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("VType");
				base.NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("VTypeString");
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("IsPilotOperatedValve");
				break;
			case "BurstTolType":
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("RDBurstTolPBoolType");
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("RDNotBurstTolPBoolType");
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("BurstTolType");
				break;
			case "VMaterial":
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("VMaterial");
				base.NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("VMaterialString");
				break;
			case "VType":
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("VType");
				base.NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("VTypeString");
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("IsPilotOperatedValve");
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("IsRemoteSensingPilot");
				break;
			case "RDPosDesPRange":
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("RDPosDesPRange");
				break;
			case "RDPosDesPPercent":
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("RDPosDesPPercent");
				break;
			case "RDNegDesPRange":
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("RDNegDesPRange");
				break;
			case "RDNegDesPPercent":
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("RDNegDesPPercent");
				break;
			case "RDBurstTol":
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("RDBurstTol");
				break;
			case "RDBurstTolPercent":
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("RDBurstTolPercent");
				break;
			case "PosDesType":
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("PosDesType");
				break;
			case "RDOperRatio":
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("RDOperRatio");
				break;
			case "NegDesType":
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("NegDesType");
				break;
			case "SplitModelCount":
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("SplitModelCount");
				break;
			case "RuptDisk":
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("RuptDisk");
				break;
			case "PRDGRID":
				FillInGridSource();
				UpdatePRDMessages();
				break;
			case "ConstBackPress":
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("ConstBackPress");
				break;
			case "PRDName":
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("PRDName");
				foreach (PRDSummaryData item in PRDDataCollection)
				{
					if (!item.IsBlankSeparator)
					{
						item.NotifyNameChanged();
					}
				}
				{
					foreach (RuptureDiskSummaryData item2 in RuptureDiskCollection)
					{
						if (!item2.IsBlankSeparator)
						{
							item2.NotifyNameChanged();
						}
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void AddNewPRD(object o)
		{
			System.Windows.Forms.Cursor.Current = System.Windows.Forms.Cursors.WaitCursor;
			PRDModel prdModel = mPRDSystemModel.CreateSplitPRD();
			PRDSummaryData pRDSummaryData = PRDDataCollection.Where([SpecialName] (PRDSummaryData p) => p.IsBlankSeparator).FirstOrDefault();
			if (pRDSummaryData != null)
			{
				int index = PRDDataCollection.IndexOf(pRDSummaryData);
				PRDDataCollection.Insert(index, new PRDSummaryData(ref prdModel, isspare: false));
			}
			else
			{
				PRDDataCollection.Add(new PRDSummaryData(ref prdModel, isspare: false));
			}
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("SplitModelCount");
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("ImageString");
			if (mPRDSystemModel.SplitPRDModels.Count == 2)
			{
				ObservableCollection<PRDSummaryData> pRDDataCollection = PRDDataCollection;
				IList<PRDModel> splitPRDModels;
				PRDModel prdModel2 = (splitPRDModels = mPRDSystemModel.SplitPRDModels)[0];
				PRDSummaryData value = new PRDSummaryData(ref prdModel2, isspare: false);
				splitPRDModels[0] = prdModel2;
				pRDDataCollection[0] = value;
				if (mPRDSystemModel.SystemType == ReliefDeviceType.Psv)
				{
					NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("SelectedPSVItem");
				}
				else
				{
					NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("SelectedRDItem");
				}
			}
			mPRDSystemModel.RaisePRDSystemModelPropertyChangedEvent(this, "SplitModelCount");
			UpdatePRDMessages();
			mPRDSystemModel.RaisePRDSystemModelPropertyChangedEvent(this, "PRDGRID");
			System.Windows.Forms.Cursor.Current = System.Windows.Forms.Cursors.Default;
		}

		private bool CanAddPRD(object o)
		{
			if (mPRDSystemModel.SystemType == ReliefDeviceType.Psv && mPRDSystemModel.SplitPRDModels.Count < 10)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void AddNewSpare(object o)
		{
			System.Windows.Forms.Cursor.Current = System.Windows.Forms.Cursors.WaitCursor;
			if (PRDType == 0)
			{
				int count = mPRDSystemModel.SparePRDModels.Count;
				PRDModel prdModel = mPRDSystemModel.CreateSparePRD();
				if (!Information.IsNothing(prdModel))
				{
					if (count == 0 && PRDDataCollection.Where([SpecialName] (PRDSummaryData p) => p.IsBlankSeparator).FirstOrDefault() == null)
					{
						PRDDataCollection.Add(new PRDSummaryData());
					}
					PRDDataCollection.Add(new PRDSummaryData(ref prdModel, isspare: true));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				int count2 = mPRDSystemModel.SparePRDModels.Count;
				PRDModel prdModel2 = mPRDSystemModel.CreateSparePRD();
				if (!Information.IsNothing(prdModel2))
				{
					if (count2 == 0 && RuptureDiskCollection.Where([SpecialName] (RuptureDiskSummaryData p) => p.IsBlankSeparator).FirstOrDefault() == null)
					{
						RuptureDiskCollection.Add(new RuptureDiskSummaryData());
					}
					RuptureDiskCollection.Add(new RuptureDiskSummaryData(ref prdModel2, isspare: true));
				}
			}
			mPRDSystemModel.RaisePRDSystemModelPropertyChangedEvent(this, "PRDGRID");
			System.Windows.Forms.Cursor.Current = System.Windows.Forms.Cursors.Default;
		}

		private bool CanAddSpare(object o)
		{
			if (mPRDSystemModel.SparePRDModels != null && mPRDSystemModel.SparePRDModels.Count < 10)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void DelLastPRD(object o)
		{
			if (System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(FormResource.msg_DeleteLastPRD, FormResource.PSVSizing, MessageBoxButton.YesNo, MessageBoxImage.Exclamation) == MessageBoxResult.Yes)
			{
				System.Windows.Forms.Cursor.Current = System.Windows.Forms.Cursors.WaitCursor;
				if (mCurrentPRDModel == mPRDSystemModel.SplitPRDModels.Last())
				{
					mCurrentPRDModel = mPRDSystemModel.SplitPRDModels.First();
					OnActivePRDChanged(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(o));
				}
				PRDSummaryData pRDSummaryData = PRDDataCollection.FirstOrDefault([SpecialName] (PRDSummaryData p) => Operators.CompareString(p.PRDName, mPRDSystemModel.SplitPRDModels.Last().PRDName, TextCompare: false) == 0);
				if (pRDSummaryData != null)
				{
					PRDDataCollection.Remove(pRDSummaryData);
				}
				PRDSystemModel pRDSystemModel = mPRDSystemModel;
				PRDModel splitPRD = mPRDSystemModel.SplitPRDModels.Last();
				pRDSystemModel.DeleteSplitPRD(ref splitPRD);
				if (mPRDSystemModel.SplitPRDModels.Count == 1)
				{
					ObservableCollection<PRDSummaryData> pRDDataCollection = PRDDataCollection;
					IList<PRDModel> splitPRDModels;
					splitPRD = (splitPRDModels = mPRDSystemModel.SplitPRDModels)[0];
					PRDSummaryData value = new PRDSummaryData(ref splitPRD, isspare: false);
					splitPRDModels[0] = splitPRD;
					pRDDataCollection[0] = value;
					NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("SplitModelCount");
					NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("ImageString");
				}
				mPRDSystemModel.RaisePRDSystemModelPropertyChangedEvent(this, "SplitModelCount");
				UpdatePRDMessages();
				mPRDSystemModel.RaisePRDSystemModelPropertyChangedEvent(this, "PRDGRID");
				System.Windows.Forms.Cursor.Current = System.Windows.Forms.Cursors.Default;
			}
		}

		private bool CanDelPRD(object o)
		{
			if (mPRDSystemModel.SystemType == ReliefDeviceType.Psv && mPRDSystemModel.SplitPRDModels.Count > 1)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void DelLastSpare(object o)
		{
			if (System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(FormResource.msg_DeleteLastSpare, FormResource.PSVSizing, MessageBoxButton.YesNo, MessageBoxImage.Exclamation) != MessageBoxResult.Yes)
			{
				return;
			}
			System.Windows.Forms.Cursor.Current = System.Windows.Forms.Cursors.WaitCursor;
			if (mCurrentPRDModel == mPRDSystemModel.SparePRDModels.Last())
			{
				mCurrentPRDModel = mPRDSystemModel.SplitPRDModels.First();
				OnActivePRDChanged(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(o));
			}
			PRDSystemModel pRDSystemModel = mPRDSystemModel;
			PRDModel sparePRD = mPRDSystemModel.SparePRDModels.Last();
			pRDSystemModel.DeleteSparePRD(ref sparePRD);
			if (PRDType == 0)
			{
				PRDSummaryData pRDSummaryData = PRDDataCollection.LastOrDefault([SpecialName] (PRDSummaryData p) => p.IsSpare);
				if (pRDSummaryData != null)
				{
					PRDDataCollection.Remove(pRDSummaryData);
				}
				if (mPRDSystemModel.SparePRDModels.Count == 0)
				{
					PRDSummaryData pRDSummaryData2 = PRDDataCollection.Where([SpecialName] (PRDSummaryData p) => p.IsBlankSeparator).FirstOrDefault();
					if (pRDSummaryData2 != null)
					{
						PRDDataCollection.Remove(pRDSummaryData2);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				RuptureDiskSummaryData ruptureDiskSummaryData = RuptureDiskCollection.LastOrDefault([SpecialName] (RuptureDiskSummaryData p) => p.IsSpare);
				if (ruptureDiskSummaryData != null)
				{
					RuptureDiskCollection.Remove(ruptureDiskSummaryData);
				}
				if (mPRDSystemModel.SparePRDModels.Count == 0)
				{
					RuptureDiskSummaryData ruptureDiskSummaryData2 = RuptureDiskCollection.Where([SpecialName] (RuptureDiskSummaryData p) => p.IsBlankSeparator).FirstOrDefault();
					if (ruptureDiskSummaryData2 != null)
					{
						RuptureDiskCollection.Remove(ruptureDiskSummaryData2);
					}
				}
			}
			mPRDSystemModel.RaisePRDSystemModelPropertyChangedEvent(this, "PRDGRID");
			System.Windows.Forms.Cursor.Current = System.Windows.Forms.Cursors.Default;
		}

		private bool CanDelSpare(object o)
		{
			if (mPRDSystemModel.SparePRDModels.Count >= 1)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void FillInGridSource()
		{
			ClearGridSources();
			if (PRDType == 0)
			{
				if (mPRDSystemModel.SystemType == ReliefDeviceType.Psv)
				{
					foreach (PRDModel splitPRDModel in mPRDSystemModel.SplitPRDModels)
					{
						PRDModel prdModel = splitPRDModel;
						PRDDataCollection.Add(new PRDSummaryData(ref prdModel, isspare: false));
					}
				}
				else
				{
					ObservableCollection<PRDSummaryData> pRDDataCollection = PRDDataCollection;
					PRDModel prdModel2 = mPRDSystemModel.OverallPRDModel;
					pRDDataCollection.Add(new PRDSummaryData(ref prdModel2, isspare: false));
				}
				if (PRDDataCollection.Count == 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				PRDDataCollection.Add(new PRDSummaryData());
				foreach (PRDModel sparePRDModel in mPRDSystemModel.SparePRDModels)
				{
					PRDModel prdModel3 = sparePRDModel;
					PRDDataCollection.Add(new PRDSummaryData(ref prdModel3, isspare: true));
				}
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("SelectedPSVItem");
				return;
			}
			if (mPRDSystemModel.SystemType == ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk)
			{
				foreach (PRDModel splitPRDModel2 in mPRDSystemModel.SplitPRDModels)
				{
					PRDModel prdModel4 = splitPRDModel2;
					RuptureDiskCollection.Add(new RuptureDiskSummaryData(ref prdModel4, isspare: false));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ObservableCollection<RuptureDiskSummaryData> ruptureDiskCollection = RuptureDiskCollection;
				PRDModel prdModel2 = mPRDSystemModel.OverallPRDModel;
				ruptureDiskCollection.Add(new RuptureDiskSummaryData(ref prdModel2, isspare: false));
			}
			if (RuptureDiskCollection.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			RuptureDiskCollection.Add(new RuptureDiskSummaryData());
			foreach (PRDModel sparePRDModel2 in mPRDSystemModel.SparePRDModels)
			{
				PRDModel prdModel5 = sparePRDModel2;
				RuptureDiskCollection.Add(new RuptureDiskSummaryData(ref prdModel5, isspare: true));
			}
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("SelectedRDItem");
		}

		public void ClearGridSources()
		{
			foreach (PRDSummaryData item in PRDDataCollection)
			{
				item.CleanEvent();
			}
			PRDDataCollection.Clear();
			foreach (RuptureDiskSummaryData item2 in RuptureDiskCollection)
			{
				item2.CleanEvent();
			}
			RuptureDiskCollection.Clear();
		}

		public void PRDNameChanged()
		{
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("PRDName");
			foreach (PRDSummaryData item in PRDDataCollection)
			{
				if (!item.IsBlankSeparator)
				{
					item.NotifyNameChanged();
				}
			}
			foreach (RuptureDiskSummaryData item2 in RuptureDiskCollection)
			{
				if (!item2.IsBlankSeparator)
				{
					item2.NotifyNameChanged();
				}
			}
			if (!Information.IsNothing(mPRDSystemModel))
			{
				mPRDSystemModel.RaisePRDSystemModelPropertyChangedEvent(this, "PRDName");
			}
		}

		private void OnSizingCaseChanged(SizingCaseChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			SizeCaseStatusChanged();
		}

		public void SizeCaseStatusChanged()
		{
			AddSizingScenarioEventHandler();
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("HasSizingCase");
			RefreshSizingScenarioParameters();
		}

		public void RecordSelectionChanged(IDeviceData dataitem)
		{
			if (dataitem == null)
			{
				SetActivePRDModel();
				mPRDSystemModel.RaiseActivePRDChangedEvent(this);
				RefreshPRDSpecificProperties();
				if (HasSizingCase)
				{
					AddSizingScenarioEventHandler();
					RefreshSizingScenarioParameters();
				}
				return;
			}
			if (PRDType == 0)
			{
				if (((PRDSummaryData)dataitem).IsBlankSeparator)
				{
					return;
				}
				PRDSummaryData pRDSummaryData = null;
				if (mCurrentPRDModel != null)
				{
					pRDSummaryData = PRDDataCollection.FirstOrDefault([SpecialName] (PRDSummaryData p) => !p.IsBlankSeparator && string.Compare(p.PRDName, mCurrentPRDModel.PRDName, ignoreCase: true) == 0);
				}
				if (pRDSummaryData != null)
				{
					if (string.Compare(pRDSummaryData.PRDName, dataitem.PRDName, ignoreCase: true) != 0)
					{
						mCurrentPRDModel = dataitem.DataSourceModel;
						RefreshPRDSpecificProperties();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					mCurrentPRDModel = dataitem.DataSourceModel;
					RefreshPRDSpecificProperties();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (((RuptureDiskSummaryData)dataitem).IsBlankSeparator)
				{
					return;
				}
				RuptureDiskSummaryData ruptureDiskSummaryData = RuptureDiskCollection.FirstOrDefault([SpecialName] (RuptureDiskSummaryData p) => !p.IsBlankSeparator && string.Compare(p.PRDName, mCurrentPRDModel.PRDName, ignoreCase: true) == 0);
				if (ruptureDiskSummaryData != null)
				{
					if (string.Compare(ruptureDiskSummaryData.PRDName, dataitem.PRDName, ignoreCase: true) != 0)
					{
						mCurrentPRDModel = dataitem.DataSourceModel;
						RefreshPRDSpecificProperties();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					mCurrentPRDModel = dataitem.DataSourceModel;
					RefreshPRDSpecificProperties();
				}
			}
			mPRDSystemModel.DisplayedReliefDevice = mCurrentPRDModel;
			mPRDSystemModel.RaiseActivePRDChangedEvent(this);
			if (HasSizingCase)
			{
				AddSizingScenarioEventHandler();
				RefreshSizingScenarioParameters();
			}
		}

		public void HandleGridUnitChanged()
		{
			DefaultUnits.Instance.NotifyPropertyChanged("SmallLength2DisplayUnit");
			foreach (PRDSummaryData item in PRDDataCollection)
			{
				if (!item.IsBlankSeparator)
				{
					item.NotifyRealFieldChanged();
				}
			}
			RuptureDiskCollection.ToList().ForEach([SpecialName] (RuptureDiskSummaryData rd) =>
			{
				if (!rd.IsBlankSeparator)
				{
					rd.NotifyRealFieldChanged();
				}
			});
		}

		public void HandlePSVEditBoxUnitChanged()
		{
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("SetPressure");
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("ConstBackPress");
			if (HasSizingCase)
			{
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("RelTemp");
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("RelPress");
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("TotBackPress");
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("NoiseHeight");
			}
		}

		public void HandlePressureReliefDeviceGroupUnitChanged()
		{
			DefaultUnits.Instance.NotifyPropertyChanged("DPDisplayUnit");
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("RDPosDesPRange");
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("RDNegDesPRange");
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("RDBurstTol");
		}

		public void CleanEvent()
		{
			mPRDSystemModel.DePressChanged -= OnPRDSystemDataChanged;
			mPRDSystemModel.PRDSystemModelPropertyChanged -= OnPRDModelPropertyChanged;
			mPRDSystemModel.OnActivePRDChanged -= OnActivePRDChanged;
			((CompositePresentationEvent<EventArgs>)(object)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<UpdateOrificeSizesEvent>()).Unsubscribe((Action<EventArgs>)OnOrificeSizesChanged);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<EventArgs>)(object)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<DefaultWarningSeetingChangedEvent>()).Unsubscribe((Action<EventArgs>)OnWarningSettingChanged);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<SizingCaseChangedEventArgs>)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<SizingCaseChangedEvent>()).Unsubscribe((Action<SizingCaseChangedEventArgs>)OnSizingCaseChanged);
			if (!Information.IsNothing(mSizingScenarioModel))
			{
				mSizingScenarioModel.BaseModelChanged -= RefreshSizingScenarioParameters;
			}
			foreach (PRDSummaryData item in PRDDataCollection)
			{
				item.CleanEvent();
			}
			foreach (RuptureDiskSummaryData item2 in RuptureDiskCollection)
			{
				item2.CleanEvent();
			}
			if (!Information.IsNothing(_sizingScenarioModel))
			{
				_sizingScenarioModel.RemoveObserver(this);
			}
		}

		private void UpdatePRDMessages()
		{
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("PRDMessages");
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("PRDMessageLevel");
			if (mPRDSystemModel.SystemType == ReliefDeviceType.Psv)
			{
				if (PRDDataCollection == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				{
					foreach (PRDSummaryData item in PRDDataCollection)
					{
						if (!item.IsBlankSeparator)
						{
							item.UpdateMessageProperties();
							item.UpdateProperties();
						}
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			if (RuptureDiskCollection == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (RuptureDiskSummaryData item2 in RuptureDiskCollection)
			{
				if (!item2.IsBlankSeparator)
				{
					item2.UpdateMessageProperties();
					item2.UpdateProperties();
				}
			}
		}

			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("PRDSuffix");

		private void GenerateMaterialAndTypeLists()
		{
			_prdMaterials = new Dictionary<ReliefDeviceType, List<string>>();
			_prdMaterials.Add(ReliefDeviceType.Psv, TranslateUiStrings.ApiValveMaterial.StringValues);
			_prdMaterials.Add(ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk, TranslateUiStrings.EquipmentMaterial.StringValues);
			_prdtypes = new Dictionary<ReliefDeviceType, List<string>>();
			_prdtypes.Add(ReliefDeviceType.Psv, TranslateUiStrings.PsvType.StringValues);
			_prdtypes.Add(ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk, TranslateUiStrings.RuptureDiskType.StringValues);
		}

		private void AddSizingScenarioEventHandler()
		{
			if (mSizingScenarioModel != null)
			{
				if (mAddHandler)
				{
					mSizingScenarioModel.BaseModelChanged -= RefreshSizingScenarioParameters;
				}
				mSizingScenarioModel.BaseModelChanged += RefreshSizingScenarioParameters;
				mAddHandler = true;
			}
		}

		private void RefreshSizingScenarioParameters(AspenTech.EquipmentAnalysis.PSVModelLibrary.IBaseModel sender, bool recalculateRatingModels)
		{
			RefreshSizingScenarioParameters();
		}

		private void RefreshSizingScenarioParameters()
		{
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("RelPress");
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("RelTemp");
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("TotBackPress");
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("Phase");
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("Method");
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("Ksh");
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("KshFromCal");
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("IsNotUserEnteredKsh");
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("NoiseLevel");
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("NoiseHeight");
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("VapKd");
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("MixKd");
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("LiqKd");
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("ScenarioName");
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("ScenarioType");
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("MethodIndex");
			if (mPRDSystemModel.SystemType == ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk)
			{
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("VapKr");
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("MixKr");
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("LiqKr");
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("RDLOverD");
			}
			base.NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("Coeff_Kd");
			base.NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("Coeff_Kd_ReadOnly");
			base.NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("RDLOverD_ReadOnly");
			base.NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("RDLOverD_Visibility");
			UpdatePRDMessages();
		}

		private void UpdateCurrentPRDSuffix()
		{
			IDeviceData deviceData = null;
			((IDeviceData)((mPRDSystemModel.SystemType != ReliefDeviceType.Psv) ? ((object)RuptureDiskCollection.FirstOrDefault([SpecialName] (RuptureDiskSummaryData p) => !p.IsBlankSeparator && p.DataSourceModel.ModelKey == mCurrentPRDModel.ModelKey)) : ((object)PRDDataCollection.FirstOrDefault([SpecialName] (PRDSummaryData p) => !p.IsBlankSeparator && p.DataSourceModel.ModelKey == mCurrentPRDModel.ModelKey))))?.NotifyNameChanged();
		}

		private void SetActivePRDModel()
		{
			if ((mCurrentPRDModel == null || (mPRDSystemModel.SystemType == ReliefDeviceType.Psv && mCurrentPRDModel is RuptureDiskModel) || (mPRDSystemModel.SystemType == ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk && mCurrentPRDModel is PSVValveModel)) && mPRDSystemModel.SplitPRDModels.Count > 0)
			{
				mCurrentPRDModel = mPRDSystemModel.SplitPRDModels[0];
			}
		}

		public void OnOverPressChanged()
		{
			if (mPRDSystemModel.SplitPRDModels.Count > 1)
			{
				mPRDSystemModel.IsUsingAPIArrangement = false;
			}
		}

		private void OnActivePRDChanged(object sender)
		{
			if (sender == null || GetHashCode() != sender.GetHashCode())
			{
				SetActivePRDModel();
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("SelectedPSVItem");
				RefreshPRDSpecificProperties();
				if (HasSizingCase)
				{
					AddSizingScenarioEventHandler();
					RefreshSizingScenarioParameters();
				}
			}
		}

		public void Update(string propertyName)
		{
			if (Operators.CompareString(propertyName, "ScenarioName", TextCompare: false) == 0)
			{
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("ScenarioName");
			}
		}

		void IObserver.Update(string propertyName)
		{
			//ILSpy generated this explicit interface implementation from .override directive in Update
			this.Update(propertyName);
		}

		private void unitCmb_SelectedItemChanged(object sender, RoutedPropertyChangedEventArgs<object> e)
		{
			if ((object)e.OriginalSource.GetType() == typeof(XamComboEditor))
			{
				_showmsg = false;
				string text = ((ValueEditor)_unitComboBox).Value.ToString().Trim();
				if (string.Compare(text, DefaultUnit, ignoreCase: true) == 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				double result = double.NaN;
				if (double.TryParse(((ValueEditor)_valueTextBox).Value.ToString(), out result) && !double.IsNaN(result))
				{
					result = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(text, DefaultUnit, result, UnitType);
					if (_validationRule == null)
					{
						SetValueValidationRule();
					}
					_validationRule.ValidateData(result, UnitType);
					_showmsg = true;
					if (!_validationRule.IsValid)
					{
						System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(FormResource.msg_invalid, FormResource.PSVSizing, MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Hand);
						((ValueEditor)_valueTextBox).Value = _oldvalue;
					}
					else
					{
						((ValueEditor)_valueTextBox).Value = result;
						UpdateEditorValue();
						UpdateValueInDB();
					}
				}
				_unitComboBox.IsDropDownOpen = false;
				((UIElement)(object)_unitComboBox).Visibility = UnitComboVisibility;
				((UIElement)(object)_valueTextBox).Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				((UIElement)(object)_displayValBox).Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				if (string.Compare(text, DefaultUnit, ignoreCase: true) != 0)
				{
					((ValueEditor)_unitComboBox).Value = DefaultUnit;
				}
			}
			e.Handled = true;
		}

				}
			}
			((UIElement)(object)val).Visibility = UnitComboVisibility;
			((UIElement)(object)_valueTextBox).Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			((UIElement)(object)_displayValBox).Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
		}

		private void valBox_EditModeStarted(object sender, EditModeStartedEventArgs e)
		{
			double result = double.NaN;
			if (double.TryParse(((ValueEditor)_valueTextBox).Value.ToString(), out result))
			{
				_oldvalue = result;
			}
			else
			{
				_oldvalue = double.NaN;
			}
			_dbvalueUpdated = false;
			_revertchange = false;
			_cmbstayopen = false;
			_valueTextBox.SelectAll();
		}

		private void displaybox_GotFocus(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (((ValueEditor)_displayValBox).IsReadOnly)
			{
				_displayValBox.SelectAll();
				return;
			}
			_dbvalueUpdated = false;
			if (Operators.CompareString(UnitType, "Viscosity", TextCompare: false) == 0 || Operators.CompareString(UnitType, "Percentage", TextCompare: false) == 0)
			{
				((UIElement)(object)_displayValBox).Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				((UIElement)(object)_valueTextBox).Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				((ValueEditor)_valueTextBox).StartEditMode();
				return;
			}
			if (BindingOperations.GetBindingExpression((DependencyObject)(object)_unitComboBox, ValueEditor.ValueProperty) == null)
			{
				System.Windows.Data.Binding binding = new System.Windows.Data.Binding();
				binding.Path = new PropertyPath(DefaultUnitProperty);
				binding.Mode = BindingMode.OneWay;
				binding.Source = this;
				_ = null;
				((FrameworkElement)(object)_unitComboBox).SetBinding(ValueEditor.ValueProperty, (BindingBase)binding);
			}
			((UIElement)(object)_displayValBox).Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			((UIElement)(object)_valueTextBox).Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			((ValueEditor)_valueTextBox).StartEditMode();
			((UIElement)(object)_unitComboBox).Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
		}

		public void UpdateValueInDB()
		{
			if (!_dbvalueUpdated)
			{
				BindingExpression bindingExpression = GetBindingExpression(DoubleValueProperty);
				if (bindingExpression != null)
				{
					bindingExpression.UpdateSource();
					_dbvalueUpdated = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateEditorValue()
		{
			((FrameworkElement)(object)_valueTextBox).GetBindingExpression(ValueEditor.ValueProperty)?.UpdateSource();
		}

		public void SetValueValidationRule()
		{
			if (EditorType != EditorType.NumericEditor || IsReadOnly)
			{
				return;
			}
			_validationRule = new RangeValidationRule();
			_validationRule.Max = ValueHighLimit;
			_validationRule.Min = _valueLowLimit;
			_validationRule.InputUnit = DefaultUnit;
			_validationRule.MaxInclusive = HighLimitInclusive;
			_validationRule.MinInclusive = LowLimitInclusive;
			_validationRule.AllowEmpty = AllowEmpty;
			if (string.Compare(UnitType, "Temperature", ignoreCase: true) == 0)
			{
				_validationRule.ValidateUnit = UnitStrings.Temp_K;
			}
			else if (string.Compare(UnitType, "GaugePressure", ignoreCase: true) == 0)
			{
				_validationRule.ValidateUnit = UnitStrings.GaugePressure_barG;
			}
			else if (string.Compare(UnitType, "AbsolutePressure", ignoreCase: true) == 0)
			{
				_validationRule.ValidateUnit = UnitStrings.AbsPressure_barA;
			}
			else if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(DataValidationUnit))
			{
				if (ValidateInCalculationUnit && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(UnitType))
				{
					_validationRule.ValidateUnit = UnitConversion.GetCalculationUnit(UnitType);
				}
				else
				{
					_validationRule.ValidateUnit = _validationRule.InputUnit;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				_validationRule.ValidateUnit = DataValidationUnit;
			}
		}

		public void ForceCallValueToDisplayTextConverter()
		{
			if (_displayValBox != null)
			{
				((ValueEditor)_displayValBox).Text = $"0.0000 {UnitConversion.GetDefaultUnit(UnitType)}";
			}
		}

		private void valBox_EditModeEnded(object sender, EditModeEndedEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Expected O, but got Unknown
			XamTextEditor val = (XamTextEditor)sender;
			if (!Information.IsNothing(val) && ValueType == typeof(int) && !int.TryParse(((ValueEditor)val).Value.ToString(), out var _))
			{
				((ValueEditor)val).Value = _oldvalue;
			}
			else
			{
				if (((UIElement)(object)_unitComboBox).Visibility == Visibility.Visible && (_cmbstayopen || ((UIElement)(object)_unitComboBox).IsMouseOver))
				{
					return;
				}

					if (!_validationRule.IsValid)
					{
						System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(FormResource.msg_invalid, FormResource.PSVSizing, MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Hand);
						((ValueEditor)val).Value = _oldvalue;
					}
					else
					{
						UpdateEditorValue();
						UpdateValueInDB();
					}
				}
				((UIElement)(object)_displayValBox).Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				((UIElement)(object)_valueTextBox).Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
		}

			}
		}

		private void valBox_PreviewKeyDown(object sender, System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Key == Key.Space && _unitComboBox != null && Operators.CompareString(UnitType, "Percentage", TextCompare: false) != 0)
			{
				_cmbstayopen = true;
				((UIElement)(object)_unitComboBox).Focus();
				_unitComboBox.IsDropDownOpen = true;
				e.Handled = true;
			}
			else if (e.Key == Key.Return)
			{
				if (_unitComboBox != null && ((UIElement)(object)_unitComboBox).Visibility == Visibility.Visible && ((UIElement)(object)_unitComboBox).IsMouseOver)
				{
					((UIElement)(object)_unitComboBox).Visibility = UnitComboVisibility;
				}
			}
			else if (e.Key == Key.Escape)
			{
				_revertchange = true;
				((ValueEditor)_valueTextBox).EndEditMode(false, true);
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		{
			TextBoxEditModeEnded?.Invoke();
		}

	public class RangeValidationRule
	{
		private double _min;

		private double _max;

		private string _vunit;

		private string _iunit;

		private bool _allowEmpty;

		private bool _maxinclude;

		private bool _mininclude;

		private bool _isvalid;

		public bool MaxInclusive
		{
			get
			{
				return _maxinclude;
			}
			set
			{
				_maxinclude = value;
			}
		}

		public bool MinInclusive
		{
			get
			{
				if (!_mininclude && _min != 0.0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			set
			{
				_mininclude = value;
			}
		}

		public double Min
		{
			get
			{
				if (_mininclude || _min != 0.0)
				{
					return _min;
				}
				return 1E-36;
			}
			set
			{
				_min = value;
			}
		}

		public double Max
		{
			get
			{
				return _max;
			}
			set
			{
				_max = value;
			}
		}

		public string ValidateUnit
		{
			get
			{
				return _vunit;
			}
			set
			{
				_vunit = value;
			}
		}

		public string InputUnit
		{
			get
			{
				return _iunit;
			}
			set
			{
				_iunit = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsValid => _isvalid;

		public bool AllowEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				return _allowEmpty;
			}
			set
			{
				_allowEmpty = value;
			}
		}

		public RangeValidationRule()
		{
			_allowEmpty = false;
			_maxinclude = false;
			_isvalid = true;
		}

		public void ValidateData(object value, string unittype)
		{
			try
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value.ToString()))
				{
					_isvalid = true;
					return;
				}
				if (!double.TryParse(value.ToString(), out var result))
				{
					_isvalid = false;
					return;
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(result))
				{
					if (AllowEmpty)
					{
						_isvalid = true;
					}
					else
					{
						_isvalid = false;
					}
					return;
				}
				_isvalid = false;
				if (string.Compare(_vunit, _iunit, ignoreCase: true) != 0)
				{
					result = UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(_iunit, _vunit, result, unittype);
				}
				bool flag = ((!MinInclusive) ? MyMath.ValueExceeds(result, Min, 1E-08, 0.0) : (!MyMath.ValueExceeds(Min, result, 1E-08, 0.0)));
				bool flag2 = ((!MaxInclusive) ? MyMath.ValueExceeds(Max, result, 1E-08, 0.0) : (!MyMath.ValueExceeds(result, Max, 1E-08, 0.0)));
				_isvalid = flag && flag2;
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				ProjectData.SetProjectError(ex);
				Exception ex2 = ex;
				_isvalid = false;
				ProjectData.ClearProjectError();
			}
		}
	}
