				if (string.Compare(((FrameworkElement)(object)val).Tag.ToString(), "Percentage", ignoreCase: true) == 0)
				{
					return text;
				}
				empty = UnitConversion.GetDefaultUnit(((FrameworkElement)(object)val).Tag.ToString());
				return $"{text} {empty}";
			}
			return text;
		}

		object IValueConverter.Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			//ILSpy generated this explicit interface implementation from .override directive in Convert
			return this.Convert(value, targetType, parameter, culture);
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			double result = double.NaN;
			if (double.TryParse(Conversions.ToString(value), out result))
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (Operators.CompareString(targetType.Name, "Double", TextCompare: false) == 0)
			{
				if (value.ToString().Equals(string.Empty) | value.ToString().Equals("NaN"))
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
				return result;
			}
			return value.ToString();
		}

		object IValueConverter.ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			//ILSpy generated this explicit interface implementation from .override directive in ConvertBack
			return this.ConvertBack(value, targetType, parameter, culture);
		}
	}
	public class StringFieldValueToDisplayTextConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(value.ToString()))
			{
				return FormResource.str_Empty;
			}
			return value.ToString();
		}

		object IValueConverter.Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			//ILSpy generated this explicit interface implementation from .override directive in Convert
			return this.Convert(value, targetType, parameter, culture);
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value == null || string.Compare(FormResource.str_Empty, value.ToString(), ignoreCase: true) == 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return value.ToString();
		}

		object IValueConverter.ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			//ILSpy generated this explicit interface implementation from .override directive in ConvertBack
			return this.ConvertBack(value, targetType, parameter, culture);
		}
	}

		public void CleanEvent()
		{
			mPSVModel.ValveSetPressChanged -= OnValveSetPressureChanged;
			mPSVModel.NotifyVFTypeFlow_RelChanged -= OnVFTypeFlow_RelChanged;
			mPSVModel.ScenarioModelPropertyChanged -= OnScenarioModelPropertyChanged;
			mPSVModel.LineSizingMethodChanging -= OnLineSizingMethodChanging;
			mPSVModel.ScenarioDataChanged -= OnScenarioDataChanged;
			mPSVModel.BaseModelChanged -= OnBaseModelChanged;
			mPSVModel.FireVesselCountChanged -= base.OnFireVesselCountChanged;
			((CompositePresentationEvent<RenameEventArgs>)(object)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<RenameEvent>()).Unsubscribe((Action<RenameEventArgs>)OnScenarioNamedChanged);
			ReliefComposition.Clear();
		}

		public PSVScenarioControlViewModel(IUnityContainer unityContainer)
			: base(unityContainer)
		{
			_valveTypes = null;
			_valveType = 0;
			_materials = null;
			_material = 0;
			ReliefComposition = new ObservableCollection<object>();
			OverrideStreamCommand = new Command(OverrideStreamCommandExecute);
		}

		public void Initialize(string PSVnodeKey, IPsvCase PSVCase, PsvKey RowNum = null)
		{
			Initialize(RowNum);
			_PSVnodeKey = PSVnodeKey;
			object objectValue = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(PSVCase.GetPSVScenarioModel(RowNum));
			if (objectValue != null)
			{
				mPSVModel = (PSVScenarioModel)objectValue;
				InitializeFireVesselList();
				FillInEditBoxValue();
				CleanEvent();
				mPSVModel.ValveSetPressChanged += OnValveSetPressureChanged;
				mPSVModel.NotifyVFTypeFlow_RelChanged += OnVFTypeFlow_RelChanged;
				mPSVModel.ScenarioModelPropertyChanged += OnScenarioModelPropertyChanged;
				mPSVModel.LineSizingMethodChanging += OnLineSizingMethodChanging;
				mPSVModel.ScenarioDataChanged += OnScenarioDataChanged;
				mPSVModel.BaseModelChanged += OnBaseModelChanged;
				mPSVModel.FireVesselCountChanged += base.OnFireVesselCountChanged;
				((CompositePresentationEvent<RenameEventArgs>)(object)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<RenameEvent>()).Subscribe((Action<RenameEventArgs>)OnScenarioNamedChanged);
				Host = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IPSVMessager>(uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).PSVHostType;
			}
		}

		private void OnScenarioNamedChanged(RenameEventArgs args)
		{
			if (Operators.CompareString(args.ObjectType, "ScenarioName", TextCompare: false) == 0 && args.HashCode != GetHashCode())
			{
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("ScenarioName");
			}
		}

		private void OnScenarioModelPropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender == null || sender.GetHashCode() != GetHashCode())
			{
				string propertyName = e.PropertyName;
				if (Operators.CompareString(propertyName, "OrificeCalcModel", TextCompare: false) == 0)
				{
					UpdateSizingMethodForDuplicatedFroms?.Invoke();
					NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("IsSteamSizing");
					NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("IsSaturatedOmegaSizing");
					NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("IsSubcooledOmegaSizing");
					NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("IsDirectIntegrationSizing");
					NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("IsLiquidSizing");
				}
				else
				{
					NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged(e.PropertyName);
				}
			}
		}

		public void NotifySizingCaseChanged()
		{
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("IsSizingCase");
		}

		private void OverrideStreamCommandExecute(object obj)
		{
			string text = ScenarioNodeKey + "." + base.Simulator.PSVNavigationStrings.ScenarioOverrideStream;
			bool flag = false;
			if (string.Equals(Host, "ASPENPLUS"))
			{
				flag = true;
				CxsCaseHelper.MyDataProvider.BatchSet(text, "value", (string)null, (object)1);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ScenarioNodeKey))
				{
					int length = ScenarioNodeKey.IndexOf(".PSVScenario");
					string text2 = ScenarioNodeKey.Substring(0, length);
					text2 = text2.Replace("Top.appModelV8", "Plant").Replace(".Blocks", "").Replace(".Data", "");
					IPSVMessager iPSVMessager = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IPSVMessager>(uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]);
					if (!Information.IsNothing(iPSVMessager))
					{
						string text3 = iPSVMessager.ShowSelectReferenceStreamDialog(text2);
						if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text3))
						{
							return;
						}
						string streamID = Conversions.ToString(CxsCaseHelper.MyDataProvider.BatchGet(text3, "id", (string)null));
						string text4 = ScenarioNodeKey + "." + base.Simulator.PSVNavigationStrings.ScenarioOverrideStreamID;
						string fullPathWithID = GetFullPathWithID(text3, text4, streamID);
						CxsCaseHelper.MyDataProvider.BatchSet(text4, "value", (string)null, (object)fullPathWithID);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				CxsCaseHelper.MyDataProvider.BatchSet(text, "value", (string)null, (object)true);
				flag = CxsConverter.ValueToBoolean(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(CxsCaseHelper.MyDataProvider.BatchGet(ScenarioNodeKey + ".Is New Stream", "value", (string)null)))) ?? true;
			}
			CxsCaseHelper.MyDataProvider.UpdateDataCache();
			ReliefComposition.Clear();
			if (flag)
			{
				mPSVModel.OnChangeReferenceStream();
			}
			NotifyPropertyChanged("HostStream");
			NotifyPropertyChanged("RelievingFlow");
			NotifyPropertyChanged("RelTemp");
			NotifyPropertyChanged("Phase");
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("IsRelTempOptionVisible");
		}

		public void NotifyPhasePropertyChanged()
		{
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("Phase");
		}

		public void NotifyFIREUseIdealGasAssumptionPropertyChanged()

			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("FIREUseIdealGasAssumption");
		}

		public static string GetFullPathWithID(string FullStreamPath, string FullScenarioPath, string StreamID)
		{
			int startIndex = FullScenarioPath.IndexOf(".PSVScenario.");
			string text = FullStreamPath.Substring(startIndex);
			startIndex = text.IndexOf(".Blocks.");
			string text2 = null;
			checked
			{
				while (startIndex != -1)
				{
					startIndex += 8;
					int num = text.IndexOf(".Data.");
					text2 = ((!Information.IsNothing(text2)) ? (text2 + "." + text.Substring(startIndex, num - startIndex)) : text.Substring(startIndex, num - startIndex));
					text = text.Substring(num);
					startIndex = text.IndexOf(".Blocks.");
				}
				if (Information.IsNothing(text2))
				{
					return StreamID;
				}
				return text2 + "." + StreamID;
			}
		}

		private void FillInEditBoxValue()
		{
			_valveTypes = TranslateUiStrings.GetEnumTranslator<eValveType>().StringValues;
			_materials = TranslateUiStrings.GetEnumTranslator<eMaterialType>().StringValues;
			string text = TranslateUiStrings.PsvType.StringValue(mPSVModel.ValveType);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				_valveType = _valveTypes.FindIndex([SpecialName] (string t) => string.Compare(t.Trim(), text.Trim(), ignoreCase: true) == 0);
			}
			if (mPSVModel.ValveMaterial.HasValue)
			{
				string text2 = TranslateUiStrings.ApiValveMaterial.StringValue(mPSVModel.ValveMaterial);
				_material = _materials.FindIndex([SpecialName] (string m) => string.Compare(m.Trim(), text2.Trim(), ignoreCase: true) == 0);
			}
		}

		public void ChangeSizingMethod(OrificeSizingMethod method)
		{
			try
			{
				System.Windows.Input.Mouse.OverrideCursor = System.Windows.Input.Cursors.Wait;
				if (mPSVModel.ChangeSizingMethod(method))
				{
					NotifyPropertyChanged("RelFlowCalcEnabled");
					NotifyPropertyChanged("RelFlowFromRef");
					NotifyPropertyChanged("RelFlowSpecified");
					NotifyPropertyChanged("RelFlowCalculated");
					NotifyPropertyChanged("RelFlow");
					NotifyPropertyChanged("Coeff_Kd");
					NotifyPropertyChanged("IsSteamSizing");
					NotifyPropertyChanged("IsLiquidSizing");
					NotifyPropertyChanged("IsSaturatedOmegaSizing");
					NotifyPropertyChanged("IsSubcooledOmegaSizing");
					NotifyPropertyChanged("IsDirectIntegrationSizing");
					mPSVModel.RaiseScenarioModelPropertyChangedEvent(this, "OrificeCalcModel");
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				System.Windows.Input.Mouse.OverrideCursor = null;
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateReliefComposition()
		{
			if (mPSVModel.ReliefCompositions.Length == 0)
			{
				ReliefComposition.Clear();
				return;
			}
			checked
			{
				if (!ReliefComposition.Any())
				{
					int num = mPSVModel.ComponentNames.Length - 1;
					for (int i = 0; i <= num; i++)
					{
						ReliefComposition.Add(new ReliefCompositionItem(mPSVModel.ComponentNames[i], mPSVModel.ReliefCompositions[i]));
					}
				}
				else
				{
					int num2 = mPSVModel.ReliefCompositions.Length - 1;
					for (int j = 0; j <= num2; j++)
					{
						((ReliefCompositionItem)ReliefComposition[j]).Fraction = mPSVModel.ReliefCompositions[j];
					}
				}
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("ReliefComposition");
			}
		}
	}

		public string HostUO
		{
			get
			{
				string empty = string.Empty;
				string text = NodeKey + "." + base.Simulator.PSVNavigationStrings.PSVProtectedUO;
				IPSVMessager iPSVMessager = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IPSVMessager>(uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]);
				if (iPSVMessager != null && string.Equals(iPSVMessager.PSVHostType, "ASPENPLUS"))
				{
					empty = Conversions.ToString(iPSVMessager.GetIHNodeValue(text, "value"));
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(empty))
					{
						return FormResource.str_Empty;
					}
					return empty;
				}
				empty = CxsConverter.ValueToString(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(CxsCaseHelper.MyDataProvider.BatchGet(text, "value", (string)null)));
				if (empty.ToLower().StartsWith("feederblock"))
				{
					return FormResource.str_Empty;
				}
				return empty;
			}
		}

					break;

					break;
				}
				mPRDSystemModel.RaisePRDSystemModelPropertyChangedEvent(this, "OpTempSource");
				mPRDSystemModel.RaisePRDSystemModelPropertyChangedEvent(this, "OperatingTemp");

		{
			get

					PRDViewModel item = new PRDViewModel(splitPRDModel, num);

				return _prdList;
			}
		}

				}
				return _sparePRDList;
			}
		}

		public PRDSummaryViewModel(IUnityContainer unityContainer)
			: base(unityContainer)
		{
			_key = null;
			_prdList = new List<PRDViewModel>();
			_sparePRDList = new List<PRDViewModel>();
			_summarydata = new ObservableCollection<ScenarioSummaryData>();
			_createCommand = null;
			_deleteCommand = null;
			_openCommand = null;
			_duplicateCommand = null;
		}

		public void Initialize(string nodeKey, PsvKey psvkey, string psvname, IPsvCase PSVCase)
		{
			Initialize();
			_nodeKey = nodeKey;
			_key = psvkey;
			mPRDSystemModel = (PRDSystemModel)PSVCase.GetPRDSystemModel(_key);
			if (mPRDSystemModel != null)
			{
				mPRDModel = mPRDSystemModel.OverallPRDModel;
				UpdatePRDSystemMessages();
				mPRDModel.ScenarioDeleted -= ScenarioDeleted;
				mPRDModel.ScenarioUpdated -= PSVScenarioUpdated;
				mPRDModel.ScenarioModelsCountChanged -= ScenarioModelsChanged;
				mPRDSystemModel.DataChanged -= OnDataChanged;
				mPRDSystemModel.SplitModelCountChanged -= OnModelCountChanged;
				mPRDSystemModel.PRDSystemModelPropertyChanged -= OnPRDSystemModelPropertyChanged;
				mPRDSystemModel.SystemTypeChanged -= OnSystemTypeChanged;
				mPRDSystemModel.ScenarioDuplicated -= OnScenarioDuplicated;
				if (!Information.IsNothing(uContainer))
				{
					((CompositePresentationEvent<SizingCaseChangedEventArgs>)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<SizingCaseChangedEvent>()).Unsubscribe((Action<SizingCaseChangedEventArgs>)OnSizingCaseChanged);
					((CompositePresentationEvent<EventArgs>)(object)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<DefaultWarningSeetingChangedEvent>()).Unsubscribe((Action<EventArgs>)OnWarningSettingChanged);
				}
				mPRDModel.ScenarioDeleted += ScenarioDeleted;
				mPRDModel.ScenarioUpdated += PSVScenarioUpdated;
				mPRDModel.ScenarioModelsCountChanged += ScenarioModelsChanged;
				mPRDSystemModel.DataChanged += OnDataChanged;
				mPRDSystemModel.SplitModelCountChanged += OnModelCountChanged;
				mPRDSystemModel.PRDSystemModelPropertyChanged += OnPRDSystemModelPropertyChanged;
				mPRDSystemModel.SystemTypeChanged += OnSystemTypeChanged;
				mPRDSystemModel.ScenarioDuplicated += OnScenarioDuplicated;
				if (!Information.IsNothing(uContainer))
				{
					((CompositePresentationEvent<SizingCaseChangedEventArgs>)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<SizingCaseChangedEvent>()).Subscribe((Action<SizingCaseChangedEventArgs>)OnSizingCaseChanged);
					((CompositePresentationEvent<EventArgs>)(object)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<DefaultWarningSeetingChangedEvent>()).Subscribe((Action<EventArgs>)OnWarningSettingChanged);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnSizingCaseChanged(SizingCaseChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			UpdatePRDSystemMessages();
		}

		private void OnWarningSettingChanged(EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdatePRDSystemMessages();
			DataChanged?.Invoke();
			if (SummaryData == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ScenarioSummaryData summaryDatum in SummaryData)
			{

		private void OnPRDSystemModelPropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender.GetHashCode() == GetHashCode())
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (e.PropertyName)
			{
			case "OperatingTemp":
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("OperatingTemp");
				break;
			case "OpTempSource":
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("OpTempSource");
				break;
			case "DesignTemp":
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("DesignTemp");
				break;
			case "DeTempSource":
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("DeTempSource");
				break;
			case "OperatingPress":
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("OperatingPress");
				break;
			case "OpPressSource":
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("OpPressSource");
				break;
			case "DesignPress":
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("DesignPress");
				break;
			case "DePressSource":
				NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("DePressSource");
				break;
			case "PRDType":
				if (uContainer != null && uContainer.Parent != null)
				{
					((CompositePresentationEvent<PRDTypeChangedEventArgsEx>)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(uContainer.Parent, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<PRDTypeChangedEventEx>()).Publish(new PRDTypeChangedEventArgsEx(_nodeKey, mPRDSystemModel.SystemType));
				}
				break;
			}
			UpdatePRDSystemMessages();
		}

		private bool CanDeleteScenario(object o)
		{
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0024: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (SummaryData == null || SummaryData.Count < 1 || o == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			XamDataGrid val = (XamDataGrid)o;
			if (val == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if ((((DataPresenterBase)val).SelectedItems == null || ((IEnumerable<ISelectableItem>)((DataPresenterBase)val).SelectedItems).Count() < 1) && ((DataPresenterBase)val).ActiveCell == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void OpenScenario(object o)
		{
			ScenarioSummaryData scenarioSummaryData = (ScenarioSummaryData)o;
			SummaryData.IndexOf(scenarioSummaryData);
			ViewEmergencyScenarioNodeEventArgs e = new ViewEmergencyScenarioNodeEventArgs();
			e.ValveName = mPRDSystemModel.PRDSystemName;
			e.ScenarioName = scenarioSummaryData.ScenarioName;
			e.Key = scenarioSummaryData.ScenarioModel.DBKey;
			e.PSVNodeKey = NodeKey;
			((RoutedCompositePresentationEvent<ViewEmergencyScenarioNodeEventArgs>)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<ViewEmergencyScenarioNodeEvent>()).Publish(e);
		}

		private bool CanOpenScenario(object o)
		{
			if (SummaryData == null || SummaryData.Count < 1 || o == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void DuplicateScenario(object o)
		{
			ScenarioSummaryData scenarioSummaryData = (ScenarioSummaryData)o;
			if (scenarioSummaryData != null)
			{
				mPRDSystemModel.DuplicateScenario(scenarioSummaryData.ScenarioModel, NodeKey, null);
			}
		}

		private bool CanDupScenario(object o)
		{
			if (SummaryData == null || SummaryData.Count < 1 || o == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void PSVScenarioUpdated()
		{
			SummaryData.Clear();
			FillInSummaryData();
		}

		private void ScenarioModelsChanged(object sender, ScenarioCountChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.NewCount > e.OldCount)
			{
				ObservableCollection<ScenarioSummaryData> summaryData = SummaryData;
				IList<PSVScenarioModel> scenarioModels;
				int index;
				PSVScenarioModel scenarioModel = (scenarioModels = mPRDModel.ScenarioModels)[index = checked(e.NewCount - 1)];
				PRDSystemModel parentModel = mPRDSystemModel;
				ScenarioSummaryData item = new ScenarioSummaryData(ref scenarioModel, ref parentModel);
				mPRDSystemModel = parentModel;
				scenarioModels[index] = scenarioModel;
				summaryData.Add(item);
			}
		}

		public void ScenarioDeleted(ScenarioDeletedEventArgs e)
		{
			ScenarioSummaryData scenarioSummaryData = SummaryData.Where([SpecialName] (ScenarioSummaryData p) => p.ScenarioModel.DBKey.Equals(e.Key)).FirstOrDefault();
			if (scenarioSummaryData != null)
			{
				if (e.IsSizingCase)
				{
					NotifySizeCaseExistsPropertyChanged();
					SizingCaseDeleted?.Invoke();
				}
				if (scenarioSummaryData != null)
				{
					SummaryData.Remove(scenarioSummaryData);
				}
				UpdatePRDSystemMessages();
			}
		}

		public void FillInSummaryData()
		{
			if (SummaryData == null)
			{
				SummaryData = new ObservableCollection<ScenarioSummaryData>();
			}
			foreach (PSVScenarioModel scenarioModel2 in mPRDModel.ScenarioModels)
			{
				PSVScenarioModel scenarioModel = scenarioModel2;
				PRDSystemModel parentModel = mPRDSystemModel;
				ScenarioSummaryData scenarioSummaryData = new ScenarioSummaryData(ref scenarioModel, ref parentModel);
				mPRDSystemModel = parentModel;
				ScenarioSummaryData item = scenarioSummaryData;
				SummaryData.Add(item);
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable<(double Area, string Name)> GetOrificeSizesWithCode()
		{
			return from x in mPRDSystemModel.GetOrifices(mPRDSystemModel.SystemType)
				select (x.Area, x.OrificeName);
		}

		public void RefreshSummaryData()
		{
			if (SummaryData != null)
			{
				foreach (ScenarioSummaryData summaryDatum in SummaryData)
				{
					summaryDatum.CleanEvent();
				}
				SummaryData.Clear();
			}
			FillInSummaryData();
		}

		public void UpdateFieldsUnit()
		{
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("DesignTemp");
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("OperatingTemp");
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("OperatingPress");
			NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("DesignPress");
			DefaultUnits.Instance.NotifyPropertyChanged("TempDisplayUnit");
			DefaultUnits.Instance.NotifyPropertyChanged("AbsPressDisplayUnit");
			DefaultUnits.Instance.NotifyPropertyChanged("GaugePressDisplayUnit");
			DefaultUnits.Instance.NotifyPropertyChanged("MassFlowDisplayUnit");
			DefaultUnits.Instance.NotifyPropertyChanged("AreaDisplayUnit");
			DefaultUnits.Instance.NotifyPropertyChanged("LengthDisplayUnit");
			DefaultUnits.Instance.NotifyPropertyChanged("SmallLengthDisplayUnit");
			DefaultUnits.Instance.NotifyPropertyChanged("VelocityDisplayUnit");
			DefaultUnits.Instance.NotifyPropertyChanged("RhoV2DisplayUnit");
			DefaultUnits.Instance.NotifyPropertyChanged("ForceDisplayUnit");
		}

		public void UpdatePRDSystemMessages()
		{
			NotifyPRDSystemMessagesPropertyChanged();
		}

		public void NotifySizingCaseChanged()
		{
			foreach (ScenarioSummaryData summaryDatum in SummaryData)
			{
				summaryDatum.UpdateSizing();
			}
			UpdatePRDSystemMessages();
		}
	}
	public class ScenarioSummaryData : INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private PSVScenarioModel _myScenarioModel;

		private PRDSystemModel _myParentModel;

		private bool _load;

		public PSVScenarioModel ScenarioModel => _myScenarioModel;

		public bool Load
		{
			get
			{
				return _load;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_load != value)
				{
					_load = value;
					PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs("Load"));
				}
			}
		}

		public string ScenarioName
		{
			get
			{
				return _myScenarioModel.ScenarioName;
			}
			set
			{
				if (string.Compare(value, _myScenarioModel.ScenarioName, ignoreCase: false) != 0)
				{
					RenameEventArgs e = new RenameEventArgs();
					e.Path = _myScenarioModel.PSVNodeKey;
					e.OldName = _myScenarioModel.ScenarioName;
					_myScenarioModel.ScenarioName = value;
					e.NewName = _myScenarioModel.ScenarioName;
					e.ObjectType = "ScenarioName";
					e.Key = _myScenarioModel.DBKey;
					((RoutedCompositePresentationEvent<RenameEventArgs>)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(_myScenarioModel.uContainer.Parent, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<RenameEvent>()).Publish(e);
					_myScenarioModel.RaisePSVScenarioModelPropertyChangedEvent(_myScenarioModel, "ScenarioName");
				}
			}
		}

		public string ScenarioType
		{
			get
			{
				return TranslateUiStrings.EmergScenarioType.StringValue(_myScenarioModel.EmergencyType);
			}
			set
			{
				EmergScenarioType? emergScenarioType = TranslateUiStrings.EmergScenarioType.Enum(value);
				int? num = (int?)_myScenarioModel.EmergencyType;
				int? num2 = (int?)emergScenarioType;
				if (((num.HasValue & num2.HasValue) ? new bool?(num.GetValueOrDefault() != num2.GetValueOrDefault()) : ((bool?)null)) == true)
				{
					_myScenarioModel.ChangeEmergencyScenario(emergScenarioType.GetValueOrDefault());
				}
			}
		}

		public string HostStream => Interaction.IIf(string.IsNullOrEmpty(_myScenarioModel.ChosenStream), FormResource.str_Empty, _myScenarioModel.ChosenStream).ToString();

		public double HostStrMW => _myScenarioModel.PhysicalPropPkgFluid.OverallMolecularWeight();

		public string Phase => TranslateUiStrings.FluidPhaseRegime.StringValue(_myScenarioModel.Phase);

		public string Method => TranslateUiStrings.OrificeSizingMethod.StringValue(_myScenarioModel.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true));

		public bool IsLiquidPhase
		{
			get
			{
				PSVScenarioModel myScenarioModel = _myScenarioModel;
				return ((myScenarioModel != null) ? new bool?(myScenarioModel.get_OpPhase(notify: true) == FluidPhaseRegime.Liquid) : ((bool?)null)) == true;
			}
		}

		public bool IsVaporPhase
		{
			get
			{
				PSVScenarioModel myScenarioModel = _myScenarioModel;
				return ((myScenarioModel != null) ? new bool?(myScenarioModel.get_OpPhase(notify: true) == FluidPhaseRegime.Vapor) : ((bool?)null)) == true;
			}
		}

		public double RelFlowRequired
		{
			get
			{
				double num = _myScenarioModel.get_RelievingFlow(notify: true);
				if (!double.IsNaN(num) && string.Compare(DefaultUnits.Instance.MassFlowDisplayUnit, _myScenarioModel.UOMRelievingFlow, ignoreCase: true) != 0)
				{
					return UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(_myScenarioModel.get_UOMRelFlow(notify: true), DefaultUnits.Instance.MassFlowDisplayUnit, num, "MassFlow");
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		public double RelFlowRated
		{
			get
			{
				double num = ((_myParentModel.SystemType != ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk || _myScenarioModel.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true) != OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod) ? _myScenarioModel.RatedFlow : _myScenarioModel.get_CalcMassFlowrate(notify: true));
				if (!double.IsNaN(num) && string.Compare(DefaultUnits.Instance.MassFlowDisplayUnit, _myScenarioModel.UOMRelievingFlow, ignoreCase: true) != 0)
				{
					return UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(_myScenarioModel.UOMRelievingFlow, DefaultUnits.Instance.MassFlowDisplayUnit, num, "MassFlow");
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		public double CalcOrifice
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsKrMethod)
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
				return UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(_myScenarioModel.UOMCalcOrifice, DefaultUnits.Instance.AreaDisplayUnit, _myScenarioModel.get_CalcOrifice(notify: true), "SmallArea");
			}
		}

		public double SelectOrifice
		{
			get
			{
				double selectOrifice = _myScenarioModel.SelectOrifice;
				if (!double.IsNaN(selectOrifice) && string.Compare(DefaultUnits.Instance.AreaDisplayUnit, _myScenarioModel.UOMSelectOrifice, ignoreCase: true) != 0)
				{
					return UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(_myScenarioModel.UOMSelectOrifice, DefaultUnits.Instance.AreaDisplayUnit, selectOrifice, "SmallArea");
				}
				return selectOrifice;
			}
		}

		public double CapacityUsed => _myScenarioModel.PercOrificeUsed;

		public bool IfSizing
		{
			get
			{
				return _myScenarioModel.IsSizingCase;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_myScenarioModel.IsSizingCase != value)
				{
					_myScenarioModel.IsSizingCase = value;
					PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs("IfSizing"));
				}
			}
		}

		public string InDP
		{
			get
			{
				if (_myScenarioModel.PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				double inPressDropFrac = _myScenarioModel.InPressDropFrac;
				if (double.IsNaN(inPressDropFrac))
				{
					return FormResource.str_Empty;
				}
				return Format.FormatNumber(inPressDropFrac * 100.0);
			}
		}

		public string OutDP
		{
			get
			{
				if (_myScenarioModel.PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				double outPressDropFrac = _myScenarioModel.OutPressDropFrac;
				if (double.IsNaN(outPressDropFrac))
				{
					return FormResource.str_Empty;
				}
				return Format.FormatNumber(outPressDropFrac * 100.0);
			}
		}

		public string Notes
		{
			get
			{
				return _myScenarioModel.CalcNotes;
			}
			set
			{
				if (Operators.CompareString(_myScenarioModel.CalcNotes, value, TextCompare: false) != 0)
				{
					_myScenarioModel.CalcNotes = value;
					PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs("Notes"));
					_myScenarioModel.RaiseScenarioModelPropertyChangedEvent(_myScenarioModel, "CalcNotes");
				}

				_vm = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<PSVScenarioControlViewModel>(base.uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]);
				_vm.Initialize(NodeKey, m_PSVCase, base.ModelKey);
				base.DataContext = _vm;
			}
			_vm.NotifyScenarioMessagesPropertyChanged();
			LoadPhaseList();
			SetPhaseLabel();
			LoadRelTempList();
			LoadEmergencyScenarioTypeList();
			InitializeCellStyle();
			_vm.UpdateReliefComposition();
			UpdateResultGridVisibility();
			sceFire.myContainer = base.uContainer;
			UnRegisterEvents();
			RegisterEvents();
			LoadGridData();
			_oldset = Common.PSVUnitSet;
			IPSVMessager iPSVMessager = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IPSVMessager>(base.uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]);
			if (!Information.IsNothing(iPSVMessager))
			{
				if (string.Equals(iPSVMessager.PSVHostType, "ASPENPLUS"))
				{
					XamTextEditor val = (XamTextEditor)Utilities.GetDescendantFromName((DependencyObject)sceNameEditor, "txtBox");
					if (!Information.IsNothing(val))
					{
						if (Information.IsNothing(((ValueEditor)val).ValueConstraint))
						{
							((ValueEditor)val).ValueConstraint = new ValueConstraint();
						}
						((ValueEditor)val).ValueConstraint.MaxLength = 8;
						((ValueEditor)val).TextChanged += ScenarioNameChanged;
					}
				}
				sceNameEditor.Host = iPSVMessager.PSVHostType;
			}
			if (!Information.IsNothing(_vm.PSVModel) && (_vm.PSVModel.PRDType != ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk || _vm.PSVModel.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true) != OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod))
			{
				_vm.PSVModel.UpdatePercOrificeUsedMessage();
			}
			((UIElement)(object)tabControl).Focus();
			System.Windows.Data.Binding binding = new System.Windows.Data.Binding();
			binding.Path = new PropertyPath("CalcOrifice");
			binding.Source = _vm;
			binding.NotifyOnSourceUpdated = true;
			binding.Converter = new CalculatedOrificeToSelectButtonIsEnabledConverter();
			btnSelectOriSize.SetBinding(UIElement.IsEnabledProperty, binding);
			System.Windows.Data.Binding binding2 = new System.Windows.Data.Binding();
			binding2.Path = new PropertyPath("CalcRDDiam");
			binding2.Source = _vm;
			System.Windows.Data.Binding binding3 = new System.Windows.Data.Binding();
			binding3.Path = new PropertyPath("SelectedIndex");
			binding3.Source = ComSizingMethod;
			MultiBinding multiBinding = new MultiBinding();
			multiBinding.Bindings.Add(binding2);
			multiBinding.Bindings.Add(binding3);
			multiBinding.NotifyOnSourceUpdated = true;
			multiBinding.Converter = new CalculatedRDDiameterToSelectButtonIsEnabledConverter();
			btnSelectRDSize.SetBinding(UIElement.IsEnabledProperty, multiBinding);
		}

		private void RegisterEvents()
		{
			SceSelecter.ScenarioChanged += OnSelectedScenarioChanged;
			relTempCombo.SelectedItemChanged += relTempCombo_SelectedItemChanged;
			_vm.PSVModel.BaseModelChanged += DoRefresh;
			_vm.PSVModel.ScenarioDataChanged += DoRefresh;
			_vm.RevertSelOrifice += RevertSelOrifice;
			_vm.PSVModel.ValveDimensionsChanged += RevertSelOrifice;
			_vm.UpdateSizingMethodForDuplicatedFroms += UpdateSizingMethod;
			_vm.PSVModel.PRDSystem.SystemTypeChanged += RevertSelOrifice;
			((CompositePresentationEvent<EventArgs>)(object)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<UpdateRelTempComboBoxEvent>()).Subscribe((Action<EventArgs>)UpdateComboBox);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<SizingCaseChangedEventArgs>)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<SizingCaseChangedEvent>()).Subscribe((Action<SizingCaseChangedEventArgs>)OnSizingCaseChanged);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<PRDTypeChangedEventArgs>)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<PRDTypeChangedEvent>()).Subscribe((Action<PRDTypeChangedEventArgs>)UpdatReliefDeviceType);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<EventArgs>)(object)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<DefaultWarningSeetingChangedEvent>()).Subscribe((Action<EventArgs>)OnWarningSettingChanged);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<EventArgs>)(object)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<UpdateOrificeSizesEvent>()).Subscribe((Action<EventArgs>)OnOrificeSizesChanged);
		}

		private void UnRegisterEvents()
		{
			SceSelecter.ScenarioChanged -= OnSelectedScenarioChanged;
			relTempCombo.SelectedItemChanged -= relTempCombo_SelectedItemChanged;
			if (_vm != null)
			{
				_vm.PSVModel.BaseModelChanged -= DoRefresh;
				_vm.PSVModel.ScenarioDataChanged -= DoRefresh;
				_vm.RevertSelOrifice -= RevertSelOrifice;
				_vm.PSVModel.ValveDimensionsChanged -= RevertSelOrifice;
				_vm.UpdateSizingMethodForDuplicatedFroms -= UpdateSizingMethod;
				_vm.PSVModel.PRDSystem.SystemTypeChanged -= RevertSelOrifice;
			}
			((CompositePresentationEvent<EventArgs>)(object)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<UpdateRelTempComboBoxEvent>()).Unsubscribe((Action<EventArgs>)UpdateComboBox);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<SizingCaseChangedEventArgs>)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<SizingCaseChangedEvent>()).Unsubscribe((Action<SizingCaseChangedEventArgs>)OnSizingCaseChanged);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<PRDTypeChangedEventArgs>)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<PRDTypeChangedEvent>()).Unsubscribe((Action<PRDTypeChangedEventArgs>)UpdatReliefDeviceType);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<EventArgs>)(object)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<DefaultWarningSeetingChangedEvent>()).Unsubscribe((Action<EventArgs>)OnWarningSettingChanged);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<EventArgs>)(object)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<UpdateOrificeSizesEvent>()).Unsubscribe((Action<EventArgs>)OnOrificeSizesChanged);
		}

		protected override void OnContextMenuOpening(ContextMenuEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!Information.IsNothing(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(e.OriginalSource)) && e.OriginalSource is ScrollViewer)
			{
				System.Windows.Controls.ContextMenu contextMenu = CreateNavigationContextMenu();
				if (!Information.IsNothing(contextMenu))
				{
					System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem menuItem = (System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem)contextMenu.Items[1];
					menuItem.IsEnabled = false;
					IPSVMessager iPSVMessager = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IPSVMessager>(base.uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]);
					if (!Information.IsNothing(iPSVMessager))
					{
						if ((object)GetPrdSystemKey() != null)
						{
							if (string.Equals(iPSVMessager.PSVHostType, "ASPENPLUS"))
							{
								object objectValue = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(iPSVMessager.GetIHNodeValue(NodeKey + ".Input.ROWNUMBER", "value"));
								if (!Information.IsNothing(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(objectValue)) && int.TryParse(objectValue.ToString(), out var result))
								{
									PRDSystemModel pRDSystemModel = (PRDSystemModel)m_PSVCase.GetPRDSystemModel(new PsvModelKey(eRecordType.PRDSystem, result));
									menuItem.IsEnabled = !Information.IsNothing(pRDSystemModel.GetSizingCaseModel());
								}
							}
							else
							{
								PRDSystemModel pRDSystemModel2 = (PRDSystemModel)m_PSVCase.GetPRDSystemModel(GetPrdSystemKey());
								_prdName = pRDSystemModel2.PRDSystemName;
								menuItem.IsEnabled = !Information.IsNothing(pRDSystemModel2.GetSizingCaseModel());
							}
						}
						contextMenu.IsOpen = true;
					}
				}
			}
			base.OnContextMenuOpening(e);
		}

		private System.Windows.Controls.ContextMenu CreateNavigationContextMenu()
		{
			if (Information.IsNothing(_contextMenu))
			{
				System.Windows.Controls.ContextMenu contextMenu = new System.Windows.Controls.ContextMenu();
				System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem menuItem = new System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem();
				System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem menuItem2 = new System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem();
				menuItem.Header = FormResource.GotoPRDTab;
				menuItem2.Header = FormResource.GotoLinesizingTab;
				menuItem.Click += GotoPRDTabClicked;
				menuItem2.Click += GotoLinesizingTabClicked;
				contextMenu.Items.Add(menuItem);
				contextMenu.Items.Add(menuItem2);
				_contextMenu = contextMenu;
			}
			return _contextMenu;
		}

		private void GotoPRDTabClicked(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			NavigateToFormTabEventArgs e2 = new NavigateToFormTabEventArgs();

			e2.Key = GetPrdSystemKey().AsPsvModelKey();

		}

		private void ScenarioNameChanged(object sender, RoutedPropertyChangedEventArgs<string> e)
		{
			XamTextEditor val = (XamTextEditor)((sender is XamTextEditor) ? sender : null);
			if (val != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(((ValueEditor)val).Text))
			{
				((ValueEditor)val).Text = ((ValueEditor)val).Text.ToUpper();
			}
		}

		private void OnSelectedScenarioChanged()
		{
			System.Windows.Input.Mouse.OverrideCursor = System.Windows.Input.Cursors.Wait;
			EmergScenarioType sceTag = SceSelecter.SceTag;
			_vm.ChangeEmergencyScenario(sceTag);
			EventArgs arg = new EventArgs();
			UpdateComboBox(arg);
			UpdateForm();
			if (sceTag == EmergScenarioType.Fire)
			{
				sceFire.InitializeFireCalTypeComboBoxDataSource();
			}
			System.Windows.Input.Mouse.OverrideCursor = null;
		}

		private void UpdateSizingMethod()
		{
			if (ComSizingMethod.SelectedItem != _reverseItemIndex[_vm.SizingMethodValue])
			{
				ComSizingMethod.SelectedItem = _reverseItemIndex[_vm.SizingMethodValue];
			}
		}

		public void UserControlVisibilityChanged()
		{
			if (_vm.RelFlowCalculated)
			{
				switch (SceSelecter.SceTag)
				{
				case EmergScenarioType.Fire:
					ReliefLoadVisibility = ReliefLoadType.Scenario_Fire;
					_vm.NotifyFIREUseIdealGasAssumptionPropertyChanged();
					break;
				case EmergScenarioType.Control_Valve_Failure:
					ReliefLoadVisibility = ReliefLoadType.Scenario_ValveFailure;
					break;
				case EmergScenarioType.Exch_Tube_Rupture:
					ReliefLoadVisibility = ReliefLoadType.Scenario_TubeRupture;
					break;
				case EmergScenarioType.Fan_Failure:
					ReliefLoadVisibility = ReliefLoadType.Scenario_FanFailure;
					break;
				case EmergScenarioType.Reflux_Failure:
					ReliefLoadVisibility = ReliefLoadType.Scenario_RefluxFailure;
					break;
				case EmergScenarioType.Thermal_Expansion:
					ReliefLoadVisibility = ReliefLoadType.Scenario_ThermalExpansion;
					_vm.RefreshAllFields();
					break;
				default:
					ReliefLoadVisibility = ReliefLoadType.Scenario_General;
					break;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ReliefLoadVisibility = ReliefLoadType.None;
			}
		}

		public override void UpdateUnit()
		{
			if (_oldset != Common.PSVUnitSet)
			{
				_oldset = Common.PSVUnitSet;
				_vm.OnUnitSetUpdated();
				DefaultUnits.Instance.NotifyPropertyChanged("TempDisplayUnit");
				DefaultUnits.Instance.NotifyPropertyChanged("MassFlowDisplayUnit");
				DefaultUnits.Instance.NotifyPropertyChanged("GaugePressDisplayUnit");
				DefaultUnits.Instance.NotifyPropertyChanged("AbsPressDisplayUnit");
				DefaultUnits.Instance.NotifyPropertyChanged("EnergyDisplayUnit");
				DefaultUnits.Instance.NotifyPropertyChanged("ExpansionCoeffDisplayUnit");
				DefaultUnits.Instance.NotifyPropertyChanged("CoeffCpDisplayUnit");
				DefaultUnits.Instance.NotifyPropertyChanged("IntegrandDisplayUnit");
				DefaultUnits.Instance.NotifyPropertyChanged("DensityDisplayUnit");
				DefaultUnits.Instance.NotifyPropertyChanged("FluxDisplayUnit");
				UpdateSelOriStyle();
				UpdateSelOriStyle_RD();
				LoadGridData();
				UpdateSubScenarioFormUnits();
			}
			grid1.Focus();
		}

		private void LoadEmergencyScenarioTypeList()
		{
			string noFire = _vm.NoFire;

		private void LoadPhaseList()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			PSVScenarioModel pSVScenarioModel = (PSVScenarioModel)m_PSVCase.GetPSVScenarioModel(base.ModelKey);
			if (!Information.IsNothing(pSVScenarioModel) && pSVScenarioModel.PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk && pSVScenarioModel.CanExecuteKrMethodSizing)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			_forwardItemIndex.Clear();
			_reverseItemIndex.Clear();
			List<ComboBoxItemWithTooltip> list = new List<ComboBoxItemWithTooltip>();
			string[] sizingMethodList = _vm.SizingMethodList;
			string[] sizingMethodTooltips = _vm.SizingMethodTooltips;
			OrificeSizingMethod[] sizingMethodValues = _vm.SizingMethodValues;
			checked
			{
				int num = sizingMethodList.Length - 1;
				for (int i = 0; i <= num; i++)
				{
					if (flag || sizingMethodValues[i] != OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod)
					{
						ComboBoxItemWithTooltip comboBoxItemWithTooltip = new ComboBoxItemWithTooltip(sizingMethodList[i], sizingMethodTooltips[i]);
						list.Add(comboBoxItemWithTooltip);
						_forwardItemIndex.Add(comboBoxItemWithTooltip, sizingMethodValues[i]);
						_reverseItemIndex.Add(sizingMethodValues[i], comboBoxItemWithTooltip);
						_ = sizingMethodValues[i];
						_ = 7;
					}
				}
				ComSizingMethod.ItemsSource = list;
				ComSizingMethod.SelectedItem = _reverseItemIndex[_vm.SizingMethodValue];
			}
		}

		private void LoadRelTempList()
		{
			relTempCombo.ItemsSource = GenaricSettings.RelTempSourceListGeneral;
			if (_vm.RelTempSource == ReliefTemperatureSource.Reference)
			{
				relTempCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
			}
			else if (_vm.RelTempSource == ReliefTemperatureSource.Specified)
			{
				relTempCombo.SelectedIndex = 1;
			}
			else if (_vm.RelTempSource == ReliefTemperatureSource.VaporFraction)
			{
				relTempCombo.SelectedIndex = 2;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateComboBox(EventArgs arg)
		{
			UpdateRelTempComboBox(arg);
			UpdateSizingMethodComboBox(arg);
		}

		private void UpdateSizingMethodComboBox(EventArgs arg)
		{
			if (SceSelecter.SceTag == EmergScenarioType.Fire)
			{
				if (_vm.RelFlowCalculated)
				{
					FireCalcMethod fireCalcMethod = _vm.FireCalculationMethod ?? FireCalcMethod.SinglePhaseRigorous;
					if ((uint)fireCalcMethod > 4u)
					{
						return;
					}
					int? num = (int?)_vm.FireCalculationMethod;
					if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num == 3) : ((bool?)null)) == true)
					{
						if (ComSizingMethod.SelectedIndex != 6)
						{
							ComSizingMethod.SelectedIndex = 6;
						}
						((UIElement)(object)ComSizingMethod).IsEnabled = false;
					}
					else
					{
						((UIElement)(object)ComSizingMethod).IsEnabled = true;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					((UIElement)(object)ComSizingMethod).IsEnabled = true;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				((UIElement)(object)ComSizingMethod).IsEnabled = true;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateRelTempComboBox(EventArgs arg)
		{
			if (_vm.IsFireCase)
			{
				if (_vm.RelFlowCalculated)
				{
					relTempCombo.ItemsSource = GenaricSettings.RelTempSourceListFire;
					((UIElement)(object)relTempCombo).IsEnabled = false;
					switch (_vm.FireCalculationMethod.GetValueOrDefault())
					{
					case FireCalcMethod.FIREUnwetted:
						if (relTempCombo.SelectedIndex != 0)
						{
							relTempCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
						}
						_vm.RelTempSource = ReliefTemperatureSource.Unwetted;
						break;
					case FireCalcMethod.SinglePhaseRigorous:
						if (relTempCombo.SelectedIndex != 1)
						{
							relTempCombo.SelectedIndex = 1;
						}
						_vm.RelTempSource = ReliefTemperatureSource.Rigorous;
						break;
					case FireCalcMethod.TwoPhaseRigorous:
						if (relTempCombo.SelectedIndex != 2)
						{
							relTempCombo.SelectedIndex = 2;
						}
						_vm.RelTempSource = ReliefTemperatureSource.Rigorous;
						break;
					case FireCalcMethod.FIREWetted:
					case FireCalcMethod.NFPA30:
						if (relTempCombo.SelectedIndex != 3)
						{
							relTempCombo.SelectedIndex = 3;
						}
						_vm.RelTempSource = ReliefTemperatureSource.Wetted;
						break;
					default:
						relTempCombo.ItemsSource = GenaricSettings.RelTempSourceListGeneral;
						relTempCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
						_vm.RelTempSource = ReliefTemperatureSource.Reference;
						((UIElement)(object)relTempCombo).IsEnabled = true;
						break;
					}
					return;
				}
				relTempCombo.ItemsSource = GenaricSettings.RelTempSourceListGeneral;
				if (_vm.RelTempSource == ReliefTemperatureSource.Reference)
				{
					if (relTempCombo.SelectedIndex != 0)
					{
						relTempCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
					}
				}
				else if (_vm.RelTempSource == ReliefTemperatureSource.Specified)
				{
					if (relTempCombo.SelectedIndex != 1)
					{
						relTempCombo.SelectedIndex = 1;
					}
				}
				else if (_vm.RelTempSource == ReliefTemperatureSource.VaporFraction && relTempCombo.SelectedIndex != 2)
				{
					relTempCombo.SelectedIndex = 2;
				}
				((UIElement)(object)relTempCombo).IsEnabled = true;
				return;
			}
			int? num = (int?)TranslateUiStrings.EmergScenarioType.Enum(_vm.NoFire);
			if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num == 11) : ((bool?)null)) == true)
			{
				if (_vm.RelFlowCalculated)
				{
					relTempCombo.ItemsSource = GenaricSettings.RelTempSourceListCalculated;
					((UIElement)(object)relTempCombo).IsEnabled = false;
					if (relTempCombo.SelectedIndex != 0)
					{
						relTempCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
					}
					_vm.RelTempSource = ReliefTemperatureSource.Calculated;
					return;
				}
				relTempCombo.ItemsSource = GenaricSettings.RelTempSourceListGeneral;
				if (_vm.RelTempSource == ReliefTemperatureSource.Reference)
				{
					if (relTempCombo.SelectedIndex != 0)
					{
						relTempCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
					}
				}
				else if (_vm.RelTempSource == ReliefTemperatureSource.Specified)
				{
					if (relTempCombo.SelectedIndex != 1)
					{
						relTempCombo.SelectedIndex = 1;
					}
				}
				else if (_vm.RelTempSource == ReliefTemperatureSource.VaporFraction && relTempCombo.SelectedIndex != 2)
				{
					relTempCombo.SelectedIndex = 2;
				}
				((UIElement)(object)relTempCombo).IsEnabled = true;
				return;
			}
			num = (int?)TranslateUiStrings.EmergScenarioType.Enum(_vm.NoFire);
			if ((num.HasValue ? new bool?(num == 8) : ((bool?)null)) == true)
			{
				if (_vm.RelFlowCalculated)
				{
					relTempCombo.ItemsSource = GenaricSettings.RelTempSourceListCalculated;
					((UIElement)(object)relTempCombo).IsEnabled = false;
					if (relTempCombo.SelectedIndex != 0)
					{
						relTempCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
					}
					_vm.RelTempSource = ReliefTemperatureSource.Calculated;
					return;
				}
				relTempCombo.ItemsSource = GenaricSettings.RelTempSourceListGeneral;
				if (_vm.RelTempSource == ReliefTemperatureSource.Reference)
				{
					if (relTempCombo.SelectedIndex != 0)
					{
						relTempCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
					}
				}
				else if (_vm.RelTempSource == ReliefTemperatureSource.Specified)
				{
					if (relTempCombo.SelectedIndex != 1)
					{
						relTempCombo.SelectedIndex = 1;
					}
				}
				else if (_vm.RelTempSource == ReliefTemperatureSource.VaporFraction && relTempCombo.SelectedIndex != 2)
				{
					relTempCombo.SelectedIndex = 2;
				}
				((UIElement)(object)relTempCombo).IsEnabled = true;
				return;
			}
			relTempCombo.ItemsSource = GenaricSettings.RelTempSourceListGeneral;
			if (_vm.RelTempSource == ReliefTemperatureSource.Reference)
			{
				if (relTempCombo.SelectedIndex != 0)
				{
					relTempCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
				}
			}
			else if (_vm.RelTempSource == ReliefTemperatureSource.Specified)
			{
				if (relTempCombo.SelectedIndex != 1)
				{
					relTempCombo.SelectedIndex = 1;
				}
			}
			else if (_vm.RelTempSource == ReliefTemperatureSource.VaporFraction && relTempCombo.SelectedIndex != 2)
			{
				relTempCombo.SelectedIndex = 2;
			}
			((UIElement)(object)relTempCombo).IsEnabled = true;
		}

		private void UpdateSizingMethodWhenPhaseChanged()
		{
			OrificeSizingMethod? selectedValue = _SelectedValue;
			if (!selectedValue.HasValue || selectedValue.GetValueOrDefault() != _vm.SizingMethodValue)
			{
				ComSizingMethod.SelectedItem = _reverseItemIndex[_vm.SizingMethodValue];
			}
		}

		private void ComSizingMethod_SelectedItemChanged()
		{
			//IL_005c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0062: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (ComSizingMethod.SelectedIndex == -1)
			{
				ComSizingMethod.SelectedItem = _reverseItemIndex[_vm.SizingMethodValue];
			}
			if (!Information.IsNothing(((System.Windows.Controls.Control)(object)ComSizingMethod).Template))
			{
				XamComboEditor val = (XamComboEditor)((System.Windows.Controls.Control)(object)ComSizingMethod).Template.FindName("cmbBox", (FrameworkElement)(object)ComSizingMethod);
				if (!Information.IsNothing(val) && !((FrameworkElement)(object)val).IsLoaded)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			OrificeSizingMethod? selectedValue = _SelectedValue;
			if (selectedValue.HasValue && _vm.SizingMethodValue != selectedValue.GetValueOrDefault())
			{
				_vm.ChangeSizingMethod(selectedValue.GetValueOrDefault());
			}
			SetPhaseLabel();
			UpdateForm();
		}

		private void relTempCombo_SelectedItemChanged(object sender, RoutedPropertyChangedEventArgs<object> e)
		{
			if (relTempCombo.SelectedIndex == -1)
			{
				UpdateRelTempComboBox(null);
			}
			ComboBoxItemWithTooltip comboBoxItemWithTooltip = (ComboBoxItemWithTooltip)relTempCombo.ItemsSource.Cast<object>().ElementAtOrDefault(0);
			if ((TranslateUiStrings.ReliefTemperatureSource.Enum(comboBoxItemWithTooltip.Text) ?? ReliefTemperatureSource.Empty) == ReliefTemperatureSource.Reference)
			{
				if (relTempCombo.SelectedIndex == 0)
				{
					_vm.RelTempSource = ReliefTemperatureSource.Reference;
				}
				else if (relTempCombo.SelectedIndex == 1)
				{
					_vm.RelTempSource = ReliefTemperatureSource.Specified;
				}
				else if (relTempCombo.SelectedIndex == 2 && _vm.RelTempSource != ReliefTemperatureSource.VaporFraction)
				{
					_vm.RelTempSource = ReliefTemperatureSource.VaporFraction;
					if (double.IsNaN(_vm.VaporFraction))
					{
						_vm.RelTemp = double.NaN;
					}
				}
			}
			if (!Information.IsNothing(_vm))
			{
				_vm.NotifyPhasePropertyChanged();
				UpdateSizingMethodWhenPhaseChanged();
			}
			((FrameworkElement)(object)relTempCombo).GetBindingExpression(FrameworkElement.ToolTipProperty)?.UpdateTarget();
		}

		private void SetPhaseLabel()
		{
			OrificeSizingMethod? selectedValue = _SelectedValue;
			phaseLabel.Content = string.Format(FormResource.lbl_OrificeSizingProperties, TranslateUiStrings.OrificeSizingMethod.StringValue(selectedValue));
			if (!selectedValue.HasValue)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (selectedValue.GetValueOrDefault())
			{
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Vapor:
				labelCompostionData.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Liquid:
			case OrificeSizingMethod.NonCertifiedLiquid:
				labelCompostionData.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Steam:
				labelCompostionData.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_1:
				labelCompostionData.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_3:
				labelCompostionData.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_Direct:
				if (_vm.PSVModel.DirectIntegrationTable.Count > 0)
				{
					labelCompostionData.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				}
				else
				{
					labelCompostionData.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod:
				labelCompostionData.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_2:
				break;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateForm()
		{
			UserControlVisibilityChanged();
			LoadRelievingConditionGrid();
			LoadValveResultsGridData();
			UpdateSubScenarioForms();
		}

		private void UpdateSubScenarioForms()
		{
			if (ReliefLoadVisibility == ReliefLoadType.Scenario_Fire)
			{
				sceFire.UpdateForm();
			}
			else if (ReliefLoadVisibility == ReliefLoadType.Scenario_ValveFailure)
			{
				sceValFailure.UpdateForm();
			}
			else if (ReliefLoadVisibility == ReliefLoadType.Scenario_TubeRupture)
			{
				sceTubeRupture.UpdateForm();
			}
			else if (ReliefLoadVisibility == ReliefLoadType.Scenario_FanFailure)
			{
				sceFanFailure.UpdateForm();
			}
			else if (ReliefLoadVisibility == ReliefLoadType.Scenario_RefluxFailure)
			{
				sceRefluxFailure.UpdateForm();
			}
			else if (ReliefLoadVisibility == ReliefLoadType.Scenario_ThermalExpansion)
			{
				sceThermalExpansion.UpdateForm();
			}
		}

		private void RefreshScenarioForms()
		{
			switch (ReliefLoadVisibility)
			{
			case ReliefLoadType.Scenario_Fire:
				sceFire.RefreshForm();
				break;
			case ReliefLoadType.Scenario_ValveFailure:
				sceValFailure.RefreshForm();
				break;
			case ReliefLoadType.Scenario_TubeRupture:
				sceTubeRupture.RefreshForm();
				break;
			case ReliefLoadType.Scenario_FanFailure:
				sceFanFailure.RefreshForm();
				break;
			case ReliefLoadType.Scenario_RefluxFailure:
				sceRefluxFailure.RefreshForm();
				break;
			case ReliefLoadType.Scenario_ThermalExpansion:
				sceThermalExpansion.RefreshForm();
				break;
			case ReliefLoadType.None:
			case ReliefLoadType.Scenario_General:
				break;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateSubScenarioFormUnits()
		{
			sceFire.UpdateForm();
			sceValFailure.UpdateForm(isunitchange: true);
			sceTubeRupture.UpdateForm();
			sceFanFailure.UpdateUnit();
			sceRefluxFailure.UpdateUnit();
			sceThermalExpansion.UpdateUnit();
		}

		private void RefreshGridData()
		{
			ValveResult_Grid.InvalidateData();
			ValveResult_Grid_RD.InvalidateData();
			PressureResult_Grid.InvalidateData();
			RelievingConditions_Grid.InvalidateData();
			switch (_vm.SizingMethodValue)
			{
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_1:
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_2:
				MixedTypeABResults_Grid.InvalidateData();
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_3:
				MixedTypeCResults_Grid.InvalidateData();
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_Direct:
				LoadMixedDirectGridData();
				break;
			}
		}

		private void LoadGridData()
		{
			LoadValveResultsGridData();
			LoadPressureResultGrid();
			LoadRelievingConditionGrid();
			switch (_vm.SizingMethodValue)
			{
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_1:
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_2:
				LoadMixedTypeABResultsGridData();
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_3:
				LoadMixedTypeCResultsGridData();
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_Direct:
				LoadMixedDirectGridData();
				break;
			}
		}

		private void UnloadGridData()
		{
			((DataPresenterBase)ValveResult_Grid).DataSource = null;
			((DataPresenterBase)PressureResult_Grid).DataSource = null;
			((DataPresenterBase)RelievingConditions_Grid).DataSource = null;
			((DataPresenterBase)MixedTypeABResults_Grid).DataSource = null;
			((DataPresenterBase)MixedTypeCResults_Grid).DataSource = null;
			((DataPresenterBase)MixedDirect_Grid).DataSource = null;
		}

		protected override void OnHostDeactivated(EventArgs args)
		{
			base.OnHostDeactivated(args);
			ValveResult_Grid.ForceClosePopup();
			ValveResult_Grid_RD.ForceClosePopup();
			PressureResult_Grid.ForceClosePopup();
			RelievingConditions_Grid.ForceClosePopup();
			MixedTypeABResults_Grid.ForceClosePopup();
			MixedTypeCResults_Grid.ForceClosePopup();
		}

		private void LoadMixedDirectGridData()
		{
			if (_vm.PSVModel.DirectIntegrationTable.Any())
			{
				if ((_SelectedValue ?? OrificeSizingMethod.Vapor) == OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_Direct)
				{
					labelCompostionData.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				}
				else
				{
					labelCompostionData.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
				List<DirectIntegrationStepVm> list = new List<DirectIntegrationStepVm>();
				foreach (IterationResultDirectIntegrationStep item2 in _vm.PSVModel.DirectIntegrationTable)
				{
					DirectIntegrationStepVm item = new DirectIntegrationStepVm(item2);
					list.Add(item);
				}
				((DataPresenterBase)MixedDirect_Grid).DataSource = null;
				((DataPresenterBase)MixedDirect_Grid).DataSource = list;
			}
			else
			{
				((DataPresenterBase)MixedDirect_Grid).DataSource = null;
				labelCompostionData.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
		}

		private void LoadRelievingConditionGrid()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			GridDataItem gridDataItem = new GridDataItem(_vm, _vm.TypeFlow, "TypeFlow", FormResource.lbl_TypeofFlow);
			gridDataItem.ContentAlignment = System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Left;

			{
				flag = true;
				item2 = new GridDataItem(_vm, _vm.VaporFraction, "VaporFraction", FormResource.lbl_MoleVF);
			}
			GridDataItem item3 = new GridDataItem(_vm, ((MainViewModel)_vm).get_RelVaporMassFraction(notify: true), "RelVaporMassFraction", FormResource.lbl_VapFraction);

			GridDataItem item7 = null;
			bool flag2 = false;
			if (_vm.EmergencyType == EmergScenarioType.Fire)
			{
				flag2 = true;
				item7 = new GridDataItem(_vm, _vm.h_vlo, "h_vlo", FormResource.lbl_LatHeat, "MassEnthalpy", DefaultUnits.Instance.MassEnthalpyDisplayUnit, _vm.UOM_h_vlo);

			gridDataItem2.ToolTip = FormResource.tooltip_FluidCriticalPressure;

			gridDataItem3.ToolTip = FormResource.tooltip_SpecificHeatRatiok;
			GridDataItem gridDataItem4 = new GridDataItem(_vm, _vm.Coeff_Kv, "Coeff_Kv", FormResource.lbl_VisCorr);
			gridDataItem4.ToolTip = FormResource.tooltip_ViscosityCorrectionKv;
			GridDataItem item8 = new GridDataItem(_vm, _vm.Coeff_Kn, "Coeff_Kn", FormResource.lbl_ValCoeffKn)
			{
				ToolTip = FormResource.tooltip_ScenarioKn
			};
			List<GridDataItem> list = new List<GridDataItem>();
			OrificeSizingMethod? selectedValue = _SelectedValue;
			switch (selectedValue)
			{
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Vapor:
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Steam:
				list.Add(gridDataItem);
				list.Add(item);
				if (flag)
				{
					list.Add(item2);
				}
				list.Add(item3);
				list.Add(item4);
				list.Add(item6);
				if (flag2)
				{
					list.Add(item7);
				}
				list.Add(gridDataItem3);
				list.Add(gridDataItem2);
				if (selectedValue == OrificeSizingMethod.Steam)
				{
					list.Add(item8);
				}
				break;
			case OrificeSizingMethod.Liquid:
			case OrificeSizingMethod.NonCertifiedLiquid:
				list.Add(item);
				if (flag)
				{
					list.Add(item2);
				}
				list.Add(item3);
				list.Add(item5);
				list.Add(item6);
				list.Add(gridDataItem4);
				if (flag2)

		private void UpdateResultGridVisibility()
		{

				((UIElement)(object)ValveResult_Grid_RD).Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				binding.ElementName = "ValveResult_Grid";
				btnSelectOriSize.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				btnSelectRDSize.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			xte_desNotes.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.MaxWidthProperty, binding);
		}

		private bool IsRuptureDisk()
		{
			if (_vm?.PSVModel != null)
			{
				return _vm.PSVModel.PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk;
			}
			if (m_PSVCase != null)
			{
				PSVScenarioModel pSVScenarioModel = (PSVScenarioModel)m_PSVCase.GetPSVScenarioModel(base.ModelKey);
				if (pSVScenarioModel != null && pSVScenarioModel.PRDType == ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void PasteCanExecute(object sender, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			//IL_004f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(System.Windows.Clipboard.GetText()))
			{
				args.CanExecute = false;
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				if (args.OriginalSource is System.Windows.Controls.ComboBox)
				{
					System.Windows.Controls.ComboBox comboBox = (System.Windows.Controls.ComboBox)args.OriginalSource;
					if (comboBox != null)
					{
						if (!comboBox.IsEditable)
						{
							args.CanExecute = false;
							args.Handled = true;
						}
						return;
					}
				}
				if ((int)(CellValuePresenter)args.OriginalSource != 0)
				{
					DataRecord record = ((DataItemPresenter)(CellValuePresenter)args.OriginalSource).Record;
					if (record != null)
					{
						if (((Record)record).Index == 1)
						{
							args.CanExecute = false;
							args.Handled = true;
						}
						else
						{
							args.CanExecute = true;
						}
						return;
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				ProjectData.SetProjectError(ex);
				Exception ex2 = ex;
				ProjectData.ClearProjectError();
			}
			args.CanExecute = true;
		}

				if (_vm != null)
				{
					_vm.CleanEvent();
				}
				UnloadGridData();
				if (sceValFailure != null)
				{
					sceValFailure.Dispose();
				}
				if (sceThermalExpansion != null)
				{
					sceThermalExpansion.Dispose();
				}
				if (sceFanFailure != null)
				{
					sceFanFailure.Dispose();
				}
				if (sceRefluxFailure != null)
				{
					sceRefluxFailure.Dispose();
				}
				if (sceGeneral != null)
				{
					sceGeneral.Dispose();
				}
				if (sceTubeRupture != null)
				{
					sceTubeRupture.Dispose();
				}
				if (sceFire != null)
				{
					sceFire.Dispose();
				}
			}
			disposedValue = true;
		}

		private void LoadcmbTankType()
		{
			if (_vm.TankType == VesselTypeEnum.Horizontal)
			{
				cmbTankType.CurrentIndex = 0;
			}
			else if (_vm.TankType == VesselTypeEnum.Sphere)
			{
				cmbTankType.CurrentIndex = 1;
			}
			else if (_vm.TankType == VesselTypeEnum.Vertical_BotHead)
			{
				cmbTankType.CurrentIndex = 2;
			}
			else
			{
				cmbTankType.CurrentIndex = 3;
			}
		}

		private void LoadcmbAPI2000Editions()
		{
			if (_vm.NormalAPIEdition == TankNormalAPIEditionEnum.Edition6)
			{
				cmbAPI2000Edition.CurrentIndex = 0;
			}
			else if (_vm.NormalAPIEdition == TankNormalAPIEditionEnum.Edition7)
			{
				cmbAPI2000Edition.CurrentIndex = 1;
			}
			else if (_vm.NormalAPIEdition == TankNormalAPIEditionEnum.Edition7Annex)
			{
				cmbAPI2000Edition.CurrentIndex = 2;
			}
		}

		private void cmbTankType_SelectedItemChanged()
		{
			if (cmbTankType.CurrentIndex == 0)
			{
				_vm.TankType = VesselTypeEnum.Horizontal;
			}
			else if (cmbTankType.CurrentIndex == 1)
			{
				_vm.TankType = VesselTypeEnum.Sphere;
			}
			else if (cmbTankType.CurrentIndex == 2)
			{
				_vm.TankType = VesselTypeEnum.Vertical_BotHead;
			}
			else if (cmbTankType.CurrentIndex == 3)
			{
				_vm.TankType = VesselTypeEnum.Vertical_NoBotHead;
			}
		}

		private void cmbAPI2000Editions_SelectedItemChanged()
		{
			if (cmbAPI2000Edition.CurrentIndex == -1 && base.DataContext != null)
			{
				if (_vm.NormalAPIEdition == TankNormalAPIEditionEnum.Edition6)
				{
					cmbAPI2000Edition.CurrentIndex = 0;
				}
				else if (_vm.NormalAPIEdition == TankNormalAPIEditionEnum.Edition7)
				{
					cmbAPI2000Edition.CurrentIndex = 1;
				}
				else if (_vm.NormalAPIEdition == TankNormalAPIEditionEnum.Edition7Annex)
				{
					cmbAPI2000Edition.CurrentIndex = 2;
				}
			}
			if (cmbAPI2000Edition.CurrentIndex == 0)
			{
				_vm.NormalAPIEdition = TankNormalAPIEditionEnum.Edition6;
			}
			else if (cmbAPI2000Edition.CurrentIndex == 1)
			{
				_vm.NormalAPIEdition = TankNormalAPIEditionEnum.Edition7;
			}
			else if (cmbAPI2000Edition.CurrentIndex == 2)
			{
				_vm.NormalAPIEdition = TankNormalAPIEditionEnum.Edition7Annex;
			}
			if (base.DataContext != null)
			{
				LoadNormalVentingInputGridData();
			}
		}

		public void UpdateTankManagerGrid()
		{
			TankData.Clear();
			List<TankModel> list = (List<TankModel>)m_PSVCase.GetAllTankModels();
			foreach (TankModel item in list)
			{
				PSVTankData pSVTankData = new PSVTankData();

				pSVTankData.Key = new PSVDBKey(eRecordType.Utility, item.LegacyKey);
				pSVTankData.NodePath = item.Datapath;
				pSVTankData.Status = item.TankMessages;
				pSVTankData.StatusLevel = (int)item.TankMessageLevel;
				TankData.Add(pSVTankData);
			}
		}

		public bool OverrideStream
		{
			get
			{
				return mPSVTankModel.UsePropertyPackage;
			}
			set
			{
				if (string.Equals(Host, "ASPENPLUS"))
				{
					string text = TankNodeKey + "." + base.Simulator.PSVNavigationStrings.TankUseRefStream;
					int num = (value ? 1 : 0);
					CxsCaseHelper.MyDataProvider.BatchSet(text, "value", (string)null, (object)num);
					if (num == 1 && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(TankNodeKey))
					{
						TankNodeKey.IndexOf(".PSVTank");
						IPSVMessager iPSVMessager = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IPSVMessager>(uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]);
						if (!Information.IsNothing(iPSVMessager))
						{
							string text2 = iPSVMessager.ShowSelectReferenceStreamDialog("Plant");
							if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
							{
								CxsCaseHelper.MyDataProvider.BatchSet(text, "value", (string)null, (object)0);
								mPSVTankModel.UsePropertyPackage = false;
								mPSVTankModel.Fluid = null;
								return;
							}
							string streamID = Conversions.ToString(CxsCaseHelper.MyDataProvider.BatchGet(text2, "id", (string)null));
							string text3 = TankNodeKey + "." + base.Simulator.PSVNavigationStrings.TankRefStream;
							string fullPathWithID = GetFullPathWithID(text2, text3, streamID);
							CxsCaseHelper.MyDataProvider.BatchSet(text3, "value", (string)null, (object)fullPathWithID);
							mPSVTankModel.Fluid = mPSVTankModel.ChosenStream;
						}
					}
				}
				if (!value)
				{
					mPSVTankModel.Fluid = "";
				}
				mPSVTankModel.UsePropertyPackage = value;
				if (mPSVTankModel.UsePropertyPackage == value)
				{
					UpdateHostStream?.Invoke();
				}
				NotifyPropertyChanged("HostStream");
			}
		}

		public string HostStream
		{
			get
			{
				string text;
				if (string.Equals(Host, "ASPENPLUS"))
				{
					text = mPSVTankModel.ChosenStream;
					if (OverrideStream)
					{
						mPSVTankModel.Fluid = text;
					}
				}
				else if (OverrideStream)
				{
					string text2 = mPSVTankModel.Datapath + "." + base.Simulator.PSVNavigationStrings.TankRefStream;
					text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(CxsCaseHelper.MyDataProvider.BatchGet(text2, "value", (string)null)));
					mPSVTankModel.Fluid = text;
				}
				else
				{
					text = PSVTankModel.Fluid;
				}
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					return FormResource.str_Empty;
				}
				return text;
			}
			set
			{
				mPSVTankModel.Fluid = value;
			}
		}

		public string Service
		{
			get
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(mPSVTankModel.Service))
				{
					return FormResource.str_Empty;
				}
				return mPSVTankModel.Service;
			}
			set
			{
				mPSVTankModel.Service = value;
			}

		private string GetFullPathWithID(string FullStreamPath, string FullScenarioPath, string StreamID)
		{
			int startIndex = FullScenarioPath.IndexOf(".PSVTank.");
			string text = FullStreamPath.Substring(startIndex);
			startIndex = text.IndexOf(".Blocks.");
			string text2 = null;
			checked
			{
				while (startIndex != -1)
				{
					startIndex += 8;
					int num = text.IndexOf(".Data.");
					text2 = ((!Information.IsNothing(text2)) ? (text2 + "." + text.Substring(startIndex, num - startIndex)) : text.Substring(startIndex, num - startIndex));
					text = text.Substring(num + 5);
					startIndex = text.IndexOf(".Blocks.");
				}
				if (Information.IsNothing(text2))
				{
					return StreamID;
				}
				return text2 + "." + StreamID;
			}
		}

		}

		public void ExecutedCopyCommand(object sender, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0063: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (e.OriginalSource is XamDataGrid)
			{
				if (Operators.CompareString(((FrameworkElement)(XamDataGrid)e.OriginalSource).Name, "MulValveConfiguration_Grid", TextCompare: false) == 0)
				{
					DataPresenterCommands.Copy.Execute(null, (IInputElement)MulValveConfiguration_Grid);
				}
				else
				{
					DataPresenterCommands.Copy.Execute(null, (IInputElement)Spare_Grid);
				}
			}
			else if (e.OriginalSource is CellValuePresenter)
			{
				if (Operators.CompareString(((FrameworkElement)(object)((DataItemPresenter)(CellValuePresenter)e.OriginalSource).DataPresenter).Name, "MulValveConfiguration_Grid", TextCompare: false) == 0)
				{
					DataPresenterCommands.Copy.Execute(null, (IInputElement)MulValveConfiguration_Grid);
				}
				else
				{
					DataPresenterCommands.Copy.Execute(null, (IInputElement)Spare_Grid);
				}
			}
			string[] array = System.Windows.Clipboard.GetText().Split("\r\n".ToCharArray());
			int num = array[0].Split("\t".ToCharArray()).Length;
			checked
			{
				string[,] array2 = new string[array.Length - 2 + 1, num - 1 + 1];
				int num2 = array.Length - 2;
				for (int i = 0; i <= num2; i++)
				{
					string[] array3 = array[i].Split("\t".ToCharArray());
					int num3 = num - 1;
					for (int j = 0; j <= num3 && j < array3.Length; j++)
					{
						if (array3[j].Contains("\n"))
						{
							array3[j] = array3[j].Replace("\n", "");
						}
						array2[i, j] = array3[j];
					}
				}
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
				int num4 = num - 1;
				for (int k = 0; k <= num4; k++)
				{
					int num5 = array.Length - 2;
					for (int l = 0; l <= num5; l++)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(array2[l, k]);
						if (l < array.Length - 2)
						{
							stringBuilder.Append("\t");
						}
					}
					stringBuilder.Append("\r\n");
				}
				System.Windows.Clipboard.Clear();
				System.Windows.Clipboard.SetText(stringBuilder.ToString());
			}
		}

		private void Rating_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			LoadSizingSceList();
			LoadGrids();
			SetColumnVisibility();
			CheckRadioGroup();
			InitializeSelOriStyle();
			InitializeDisplayedRatingEstimatesStyle();
			((FrameworkElement)(object)ComDisRatingRes).Style = _displayedRatingStyle;
			UnRegisterEvents();
			RegisterEvents();
			_isLoaded = true;
			if (_vm != null)
			{
				base.DataContext = _vm;
				PRDSystemModel pRDSystemModel = _vm.PRDSystemModel;
				if (!Information.IsNothing(pRDSystemModel))
				{
					pRDSystemModel.PRDSystemModelPropertyChanged -= OnPRDModelPropertyChanged;
					pRDSystemModel.PRDSystemModelPropertyChanged += OnPRDModelPropertyChanged;
					PSVScenarioModel sizingCaseModel = _vm.PRDSystemModel.GetSizingCaseModel();
					if (!Information.IsNothing(sizingCaseModel))
					{
						sizingCaseModel.BaseModelChanged -= DoRefresh;
						sizingCaseModel.BaseModelChanged += DoRefresh;
						if (sizingCaseModel.get_OrificeCalcModel(notify: true) == OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod)
						{
							btnSelectOri.IsEnabled = false;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (Operators.CompareString(CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture.Name, "ru-RU", TextCompare: false) == 0)
			{
				panel.Width = 500.0;
				((FrameworkElement)(object)ComDisRatingRes).Width = 300.0;
			}
		}

		private void RegisterEvents()
		{
			((CompositePresentationEvent<PRDTypeChangedEventArgs>)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<PRDTypeChangedEvent>()).Subscribe((Action<PRDTypeChangedEventArgs>)UpdatReliefDeviceType);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<SizingMethodChangedEventArgs>)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<SizingMethodChangedEvent>()).Subscribe((Action<SizingMethodChangedEventArgs>)OnSizingMethodChanged);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<SizingCaseChangedEventArgs>)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<SizingCaseChangedEvent>()).Subscribe((Action<SizingCaseChangedEventArgs>)OnSizingCaseChanged);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<EventArgs>)(object)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<UpdateOrificeSizesEvent>()).Subscribe((Action<EventArgs>)OnOrificeSizesChanged);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<RenameEventArgs>)(object)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<RenameEvent>()).Subscribe((Action<RenameEventArgs>)RenameScenario);
			ComDisRatingRes.SelectedItemChanged += ComDisRatingRes_SelectedItemChanged;
			_vm.DataChanged += UpdateScenarioGrid;
			_vm.PrdSystemTypeChanged += OnPrdSystemTypeChanged;
		}

		private void UnRegisterEvents()
		{
			((CompositePresentationEvent<PRDTypeChangedEventArgs>)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<PRDTypeChangedEvent>()).Unsubscribe((Action<PRDTypeChangedEventArgs>)UpdatReliefDeviceType);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<SizingMethodChangedEventArgs>)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<SizingMethodChangedEvent>()).Unsubscribe((Action<SizingMethodChangedEventArgs>)OnSizingMethodChanged);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<SizingCaseChangedEventArgs>)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<SizingCaseChangedEvent>()).Unsubscribe((Action<SizingCaseChangedEventArgs>)OnSizingCaseChanged);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<RenameEventArgs>)(object)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<RenameEvent>()).Unsubscribe((Action<RenameEventArgs>)RenameScenario);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<EventArgs>)(object)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(base.uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<UpdateOrificeSizesEvent>()).Unsubscribe((Action<EventArgs>)OnOrificeSizesChanged);
			ComDisRatingRes.SelectedItemChanged -= ComDisRatingRes_SelectedItemChanged;
			if (_vm != null)
			{
				_vm.DataChanged -= UpdateScenarioGrid;
				_vm.PrdSystemTypeChanged -= OnPrdSystemTypeChanged;
			}
			PRDSystemModel pRDSystemModel = _vm.PRDSystemModel;
			if (!Information.IsNothing(pRDSystemModel))
			{
				pRDSystemModel.PRDSystemModelPropertyChanged -= OnPRDModelPropertyChanged;
			}
		}

		private void RenameScenario(RenameEventArgs arg)
		{
			if (!Information.IsNothing(_vm) && !Information.IsNothing(_vm.PRDSystemModel))
			{
				PSVScenarioModel sizingCaseModel = _vm.PRDSystemModel.GetSizingCaseModel();
				if (!Information.IsNothing(sizingCaseModel))
				{
					lbiSceName.Content = sizingCaseModel.ScenarioName;
				}
			}
		}

		private void LoadSizingSceList()
		{
			if (_vm == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			NotifyMulValveConfigGridDataChanged(new List<string> { "AllOverPre" });
			PSVScenarioModel sizingCaseModel = _vm.PRDSystemModel.GetSizingCaseModel();
			if (sizingCaseModel == null)
			{
				lbiSceFlow.Visibility = Visibility.Hidden;
				lbiSceName.Visibility = Visibility.Hidden;
				lbiScePhase.Visibility = Visibility.Hidden;
				lbiSceType.Visibility = Visibility.Hidden;
				lbiTotalOriReq.Visibility = Visibility.Hidden;
				lbiTotalSelOri.Visibility = Visibility.Hidden;
				return;
			}
			lbiSceFlow.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			lbiSceName.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			lbiScePhase.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			lbiSceType.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			lbiTotalOriReq.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			lbiTotalSelOri.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			lbiSceName.Content = sizingCaseModel.ScenarioName;
			lbiSceType.Content = TranslateUiStrings.EmergScenarioType.StringValue(sizingCaseModel.EmergencyType);
			lbiScePhase.Content = TranslateUiStrings.FluidPhaseRegime.StringValue(sizingCaseModel.Phase);
			if (!double.IsNaN(sizingCaseModel.get_RelFlow(notify: true)))
			{
				lbiSceFlow.Content = Format.FormatNumber(UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.MassFlow_kgh, DefaultUnits.Instance.MassFlowDisplayUnit, sizingCaseModel.get_RelFlow(notify: true), "MassFlow")) + " " + DefaultUnits.Instance.MassFlowDisplayUnit;
			}
			else
			{
				lbiSceFlow.Content = Format.FormatNumber(UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.MassFlow_kgh, DefaultUnits.Instance.MassFlowDisplayUnit, sizingCaseModel.get_RelFlow(notify: true), "MassFlow"));
			}
			lbiSceFlow.HorizontalContentAlignment = System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Right;
			if (!double.IsNaN(sizingCaseModel.get_CalcOrifice(notify: true)))
			{
				lbiTotalOriReq.Content = Format.FormatNumber(UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.SmallArea_cm2, DefaultUnits.Instance.AreaDisplayUnit, sizingCaseModel.get_CalcOrifice(notify: true), "SmallArea")) + " " + DefaultUnits.Instance.AreaDisplayUnit;
			}
			else
			{
				lbiTotalOriReq.Content = Format.FormatNumber(UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.SmallArea_cm2, DefaultUnits.Instance.AreaDisplayUnit, sizingCaseModel.get_CalcOrifice(notify: true), "SmallArea"));
			}
			lbiTotalOriReq.HorizontalContentAlignment = System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Right;
			if (!double.IsNaN(sizingCaseModel.SelectOrifice))
			{
				lbiTotalSelOri.Content = Format.FormatNumber(UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.SmallArea_cm2, DefaultUnits.Instance.AreaDisplayUnit, _vm.PRDSystemModel.TotalSelectedArea, "SmallArea")) + " " + DefaultUnits.Instance.AreaDisplayUnit;
			}
			else
			{
				lbiTotalSelOri.Content = Format.FormatNumber(UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.SmallArea_cm2, DefaultUnits.Instance.AreaDisplayUnit, _vm.PRDSystemModel.TotalSelectedArea, "SmallArea"));
			}
			lbiTotalSelOri.HorizontalContentAlignment = System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Right;
		}

		private void UnloadGridData()
		{
