		private void LoadMulValveConfigurationGrid()
		{
			List<PRDViewModel> pRDList = _vm.PRDList;
			List<MulValveConfigGridItem> list = new List<MulValveConfigGridItem>();
			if (pRDList.Count > 0)
			{
				int num = 1;
				foreach (PRDViewModel item in pRDList)
				{
					MulValveConfigGridItem mulValveConfigGridItem = new MulValveConfigGridItem(item, _vm);
					if (num == 1)
					{
						mulValveConfigGridItem.IsSetPreIncReadOnly = true;
						mulValveConfigGridItem.CanEditOverPress = true;
					}
					if (pRDList.Count == 1)
					{
						mulValveConfigGridItem.IsReqFlowSplitReadOnly = true;
					}
					else
					{
						mulValveConfigGridItem.IsReqFlowSplitReadOnly = false;
					}
					list.Add(mulValveConfigGridItem);
					num = checked(num + 1);
				}
			}
			((DataPresenterBase)MulValveConfiguration_Grid).DataSource = null;
			((DataPresenterBase)MulValveConfiguration_Grid).DataSource = list;
		}

		private void LoadSpareGrid()
		{
			List<PRDViewModel> sparePRDList = _vm.SparePRDList;
			List<SpareGridItem> list = new List<SpareGridItem>();
			if (sparePRDList.Count > 0)
			{
				int num = 1;
				foreach (PRDViewModel item2 in sparePRDList)
				{
					SpareGridItem item = new SpareGridItem(item2, _vm);
					list.Add(item);
					num = checked(num + 1);
				}
			}
			((DataPresenterBase)Spare_Grid).DataSource = null;
			((DataPresenterBase)Spare_Grid).DataSource = list;
		}

		private void LoadRatingSceGrid()
		{
			IList<PSVScenarioModel> list = null;
			if (_vm != null)
			{
				list = _vm.PRDSystemModel.OverallPRDModel.ScenarioModels;
			}
			if (ComDisRatingRes.SelectedIndex == -1)
			{
				ComDisRatingRes.SelectedIndex = 0;
			}
			int count = _vm.PRDList.Count;
			List<RatingSceGridItem> list2 = new List<RatingSceGridItem>();
			if (list.Count > 0)
			{
				double stabilityPctRatedFlow = _vm.PRDSystemModel.PSVSettings.StabilityPctRatedFlow;
				bool displayStabilityWarning = _vm.PRDSystemModel.PSVSettings.DisplayStabilityWarning;
				int num = 0;
				foreach (PSVScenarioModel item2 in list)
				{
					RatingSceGridItem item = new RatingSceGridItem(_vm, item2, num, ComDisRatingRes.SelectedIndex, count, stabilityPctRatedFlow, displayStabilityWarning);
					list2.Add(item);
					num = checked(num + 1);
				}
			}
			IOrderedEnumerable<RatingSceGridItem> dataSource = list2.OrderByDescending([SpecialName] (RatingSceGridItem p) => p.ReqFlow);
			((DataPresenterBase)Scenario_Grid).DataSource = null;
			((DataPresenterBase)Scenario_Grid).DataSource = dataSource;
			PSVScenarioModel sizingCaseModel = _vm.PRDSystemModel.GetSizingCaseModel();
			if (sizingCaseModel != null)
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(sizingCaseModel.SelectOrifice))
				{
					lbiTotalSelOri.Content = Format.FormatNumber(UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.SmallArea_cm2, DefaultUnits.Instance.AreaDisplayUnit, _vm.PRDSystemModel.TotalSelectedArea, "SmallArea")) + " " + DefaultUnits.Instance.AreaDisplayUnit;
				}
				else
				{
					lbiTotalSelOri.Content = Format.FormatNumber(UnitConversion.ConvertToDefaultDisplayValue(UnitStrings.SmallArea_cm2, DefaultUnits.Instance.AreaDisplayUnit, _vm.PRDSystemModel.TotalSelectedArea, "SmallArea"));
				}
			}
		}

		private void Scenario_Fire_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			vm = base.DataContext as MainViewModel;
			if (vm != null)
			{
				scenarioVm = (PSVScenarioControlViewModel)base.DataContext;
				UnRegisterEvents();
				RegisterEvents();
				LoadControls();
				int numVessels = Math.Max(vm.FireVesselCount, 1);
				_SetVesselVisibility(numVessels);
			}
		}

		private void RegisterEvents()
		{
			vm.VesselActiveChanged += UpdateFireCalMethodComboBox;
			vm.PSVModel.FireVesselCountChanged += UpdateForm;
			vm.PSVModel.SelectedFireMethodChanged += UpdateForm;
			((DataPresenterBase)ScenarioFire_Grid).InitializeRecord += ScenarioFireGrid_InitializeRecord;
		}

		private void UnRegisterEvents()
		{
			if (vm != null)
			{
				vm.VesselActiveChanged -= UpdateFireCalMethodComboBox;
				vm.PSVModel.FireVesselCountChanged -= UpdateForm;
				vm.PSVModel.SelectedFireMethodChanged -= UpdateForm;
			}
			((DataPresenterBase)ScenarioFire_Grid).InitializeRecord -= ScenarioFireGrid_InitializeRecord;
		}

		private void LoadControls()
		{
			InitializeFireCalTypeComboBoxDataSource();
			LoadFireVesselDataGrid();
			LoadFireLoadCalculationResultsGrid();
			LoadFireDataGrid();
			InitializeCellStyle();
			CheckFireResultsGridVisibility();
			CheckButtonVisibility();
		}

		private void UpdateFireCalMethodComboBox()
		{
			if (ComFireCalType.SelectedIndex == -1)
			{
				ComFireCalType.SelectedIndex = 0;
			}
			if (vm != null && scenarioVm.PSVModel.get_RelFlowSource(notify: true) == ProcessDataSource.Calculated)
			{
				List<ComboBoxItemWithTooltip> itemsSource = vm.PSVModel.FireValidMethods.Select([SpecialName] (FireCalcMethod m) => _MethodToItemIndex[m]).ToList();
				ComFireCalType.ItemsSource = itemsSource;
				ComboBoxItemWithTooltip comboBoxItemWithTooltip = _MethodToItemIndex[vm.PSVModel.FIRECalculationType.GetValueOrDefault()];
				if (((ValueEditor)ComFireCalType).Value != comboBoxItemWithTooltip)
				{
					((ValueEditor)ComFireCalType).Value = comboBoxItemWithTooltip;
				}
			}
		}

		private void ComNoVesChanged()
		{
			if (base.DataContext != null && scenarioVm != null && scenarioVm.PSVModel.EmergencyType == EmergScenarioType.Fire && scenarioVm.PSVModel.get_RelFlowSource(notify: true) == ProcessDataSource.Calculated)
			{
				int num = Math.Max(checked(ComNoVes.CurrentIndex + 1), 1);
				bool num2 = num > scenarioVm.FireVesselCount;
				scenarioVm.FireVesselCount = num;
				if (num2)
				{
					LoadFireVesselDataGrid();
				}
				_SetVesselVisibility(num);
				UpdateFireCalMethodComboBox();
			}
		}

		private void CheckButtonVisibility()
		{
			FireCalcMethod fireCalcMethod = vm.FireCalculationMethod ?? FireCalcMethod.FIREWetted;
			if ((fireCalcMethod == FireCalcMethod.SinglePhaseRigorous || fireCalcMethod == FireCalcMethod.TwoPhaseRigorous) && radioRelFlowCalc.IsChecked == true)
			{
				btViewDetails.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			}
			else
			{
				btViewDetails.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
		}

		public void UpdateForm()
		{
			if (unitPop != null && !unitPop.IsMouseOver && !unitPop.DisplayCombo)
			{
				unitPop.IsOpen = false;
				unitPop.StaysOpen = false;
			}
			if (scenarioVm != null)
			{
				if (scenarioVm.RelFlowFromRef)
				{
					radioRelFlowRef.IsChecked = true;
				}
				else if (scenarioVm.RelFlowSpecified)
				{
					relFlowManual.IsChecked = true;
				}
				else if (scenarioVm.RelFlowCalculated)
				{
					radioRelFlowCalc.IsChecked = true;
				}
			}
			if (vm != null)
			{
				vm.NotifySelectionsChanged();
				UpdateFireCalMethodComboBox();
				LoadFireVesselDataGrid();
				LoadFireLoadCalculationResultsGrid();
				LoadFireDataGrid();
				int numVessels = Math.Max(vm.FireVesselCount, 1);
				_SetVesselVisibility(numVessels);
			}
		}

		public override void RefreshForm()
		{
			base.RefreshForm();
			if (vm != null)
			{
				vm.NotifySelectionsChanged();
				UpdateFireCalMethodComboBox();
				UnWettedCaseData_Grid.InvalidateData();
				ScenarioFire_Grid.InvalidateData();
				DisengagementGrid.InvalidateData();
				LoadFireLoadCalculationResultsGrid();
			}
		}

		public void CheckFireResultsGridVisibility()
		{
			if (radioRelFlowCalc.IsChecked == true)
			{
				((UIElement)(object)FireLoadCalculationResults_Grid).Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				((UIElement)(object)UnWettedCaseData_Grid).Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			}
			else
			{
				((UIElement)(object)FireLoadCalculationResults_Grid).Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				((UIElement)(object)UnWettedCaseData_Grid).Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnHostDeactivated(EventArgs args)
		{
			base.OnHostDeactivated(args);
			UnWettedCaseData_Grid.ForceClosePopup();
			ScenarioFire_Grid.ForceClosePopup();
			DisengagementGrid.ForceClosePopup();
		}

		public void InitializeFireCalTypeComboBoxDataSource()
		{
			if (vm == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<ComboBoxItemWithTooltip> list = new List<ComboBoxItemWithTooltip>();
			ComboBoxItemWithTooltip item = new ComboBoxItemWithTooltip(TranslateUiStrings.FireCalcMethod.StringValue(FireCalcMethod.FIREUnwetted), FormResource.tooltip_FIRECalcMethod_Unwetted);
			ComboBoxItemWithTooltip item2 = new ComboBoxItemWithTooltip(TranslateUiStrings.FireCalcMethod.StringValue(FireCalcMethod.FIREWetted), FormResource.tooltip_FIRECalcMethod_Liquid);
			ComboBoxItemWithTooltip item3 = new ComboBoxItemWithTooltip(TranslateUiStrings.FireCalcMethod.StringValue(FireCalcMethod.NFPA30), FormResource.tooltip_FIRECalcMethod_NFPA30);
			ComboBoxItemWithTooltip item4 = new ComboBoxItemWithTooltip(TranslateUiStrings.FireCalcMethod.StringValue(FireCalcMethod.SinglePhaseRigorous), FormResource.tooltip_FIRECalcMethod_Supercritical);
			ComboBoxItemWithTooltip item5 = new ComboBoxItemWithTooltip(TranslateUiStrings.FireCalcMethod.StringValue(FireCalcMethod.TwoPhaseRigorous), FormResource.tooltip_FIRECalcMethod_SemiDynamic);
			FireCalcMethod fireCalcMethod = vm.FireCalculationMethod ?? FireCalcMethod.SinglePhaseRigorous;
			if ((vm.OperatingPhase == FluidPhaseRegime.Vapor) | (vm.OperatingPhase == FluidPhaseRegime.Supercritical))
			{
				list.Add(item);
				if (ComNoVes.CurrentIndex == 0)
				{
					list.Add(item4);
				}
				ComFireCalType.ItemsSource = null;
				ComFireCalType.ItemsSource = list;
				if (fireCalcMethod == FireCalcMethod.FIREUnwetted)
				{
					ComFireCalType.SelectedIndex = 0;
				}
				else if (ComNoVes.CurrentIndex == 0 && fireCalcMethod == FireCalcMethod.SinglePhaseRigorous)
				{
					ComFireCalType.SelectedIndex = 1;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (!((vm.OperatingPhase == FluidPhaseRegime.Liquid) | (vm.OperatingPhase == FluidPhaseRegime.TwoPhase)))
				{
					return;
				}
				list.Add(item2);
				list.Add(item3);
				if (ComNoVes.CurrentIndex == 0)
				{
					list.Add(item5);
					list.Add(item4);
				}
				ComFireCalType.ItemsSource = null;
				ComFireCalType.ItemsSource = list;
				switch (fireCalcMethod)
				{
				case FireCalcMethod.FIREWetted:
					ComFireCalType.SelectedIndex = 0;
					return;
				case FireCalcMethod.NFPA30:
					ComFireCalType.SelectedIndex = 1;
					return;
				}
				if (ComNoVes.CurrentIndex == 0 && fireCalcMethod == FireCalcMethod.TwoPhaseRigorous)
				{
					ComFireCalType.SelectedIndex = 2;
				}
				else if (ComNoVes.CurrentIndex == 0 && fireCalcMethod == FireCalcMethod.SinglePhaseRigorous)
				{
					ComFireCalType.SelectedIndex = 3;
				}
			}
		}

		private void ComFireCalType_SelectedItemChanged(object sender, RoutedPropertyChangedEventArgs<object> e)
		{
			if (vm.PSVModel.Model.IsBeingDeleted)
			{
				return;
			}
			FireCalcMethod fireCalcMethod = vm.FireCalculationMethod ?? FireCalcMethod.SinglePhaseRigorous;
			if (ComFireCalType.SelectedIndex == -1)
			{
				if (ComNoVes.CurrentIndex == 0)
				{
					switch (fireCalcMethod)
					{
					case FireCalcMethod.SinglePhaseRigorous:
						ComFireCalType.SelectedIndex = ((vm.OperatingPhase == FluidPhaseRegime.Vapor) ? 1 : 3);
						return;
					case FireCalcMethod.TwoPhaseRigorous:
						ComFireCalType.SelectedIndex = 2;
						break;
					default:
						if (((ComNoVes.CurrentIndex == 0) & (vm.OperatingPhase != FluidPhaseRegime.Vapor)) && fireCalcMethod == FireCalcMethod.SinglePhaseRigorous)
						{
							ComFireCalType.SelectedIndex = 3;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
				switch (fireCalcMethod)
				{
				case FireCalcMethod.FIREUnwetted:
					ComFireCalType.SelectedIndex = 0;
					break;
				case FireCalcMethod.FIREWetted:
					ComFireCalType.SelectedIndex = 0;
					break;
				case FireCalcMethod.NFPA30:
					ComFireCalType.SelectedIndex = 1;
					break;
				default:
					if (ComNoVes.CurrentIndex == 0 && fireCalcMethod == FireCalcMethod.TwoPhaseRigorous)
					{
						ComFireCalType.SelectedIndex = 2;
					}
					break;
				}
				if (!vm.FireCalculationMethod.HasValue)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			if (ComNoVes.CurrentIndex == -1 && vm.PSVModel.get_RelFlowSource(notify: true) == ProcessDataSource.Calculated)
			{
				ComNoVes.CurrentIndex = 0;
			}
			EventArgs e2 = new EventArgs();
			if ((vm.OperatingPhase == FluidPhaseRegime.Vapor) | (vm.OperatingPhase == FluidPhaseRegime.Supercritical))
			{
				if (ComNoVes.CurrentIndex == 0)
				{
					if (ComFireCalType.SelectedIndex == 0 && fireCalcMethod != FireCalcMethod.FIREUnwetted)
					{
						vm.FireCalculationMethod = FireCalcMethod.FIREUnwetted;
					}
					if (ComFireCalType.SelectedIndex == 1 && fireCalcMethod != FireCalcMethod.SinglePhaseRigorous)
					{
						vm.FireCalculationMethod = FireCalcMethod.SinglePhaseRigorous;
					}
				}
				else if (fireCalcMethod != FireCalcMethod.FIREUnwetted)
				{
					vm.FireCalculationMethod = FireCalcMethod.FIREUnwetted;
				}
			}
			else if (ComNoVes.CurrentIndex == 0)
			{
				if (ComFireCalType.SelectedIndex == 0 && fireCalcMethod != FireCalcMethod.FIREWetted)
				{
					vm.FireCalculationMethod = FireCalcMethod.FIREWetted;
				}
				if (ComFireCalType.SelectedIndex == 1 && fireCalcMethod != FireCalcMethod.NFPA30)
				{
					vm.FireCalculationMethod = FireCalcMethod.NFPA30;
				}
				if (ComFireCalType.SelectedIndex == 2 && fireCalcMethod != FireCalcMethod.TwoPhaseRigorous)
				{
					vm.FireCalculationMethod = FireCalcMethod.TwoPhaseRigorous;
				}
				if (ComFireCalType.SelectedIndex == 3 && fireCalcMethod != FireCalcMethod.SinglePhaseRigorous)
				{
					vm.FireCalculationMethod = FireCalcMethod.SinglePhaseRigorous;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				switch (ComFireCalType.SelectedIndex)
				{
				case 0:
					if (fireCalcMethod != FireCalcMethod.FIREWetted)
					{
						vm.FireCalculationMethod = FireCalcMethod.FIREWetted;
					}
					break;
				case 1:
					if (fireCalcMethod != FireCalcMethod.NFPA30)
					{
						vm.FireCalculationMethod = FireCalcMethod.NFPA30;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			((RoutedCompositePresentationEvent<EventArgs>)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(myContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).GetEvent<UpdateRelTempComboBoxEvent>()).Publish(e2);
			CheckButtonVisibility();
			vm.NotifyOnlyPropertyChanged("FIREVaryWettedSA");
		}

		private void LoadFireLoadCalculationResultsGrid()
		{
			FireCalcMethod fireCalcMethod = vm.FireCalculationMethod ?? FireCalcMethod.SinglePhaseRigorous;
			if ((fireCalcMethod == FireCalcMethod.TwoPhaseRigorous || fireCalcMethod == FireCalcMethod.SinglePhaseRigorous) | (vm.FireVesselCount == 1))
			{
				((DataPresenterBase)FireLoadCalculationResults_Grid).DataSource = null;
				return;
			}
			GridDataItem item = new GridDataItem(vm, vm.FIRECalcRelFlow, "FIRECalcRelFlow", FormResource.lbl_TotFireLoad, "MassFlow", DefaultUnits.Instance.MassFlowDisplayUnit, vm.FIREUOMCalcRelFlow);
			GridDataItem item2 = new GridDataItem(vm, vm.FIREExposedArea, "FIREExposedArea", FormResource.lbl_TotExpArea, "Area", DefaultUnits.Instance.LargeAreaDisplayUnit, vm.FIREUOMExposedArea);
			List<GridDataItem> list = new List<GridDataItem>();
			list.Add(item);
			list.Add(item2);
			((DataPresenterBase)FireLoadCalculationResults_Grid).DataSource = null;
			((DataPresenterBase)FireLoadCalculationResults_Grid).DataSource = list;
		}

		public string GetExposedAreaOptTooltip()
		{
			if (!vm.FireCalculationMethod.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			switch (vm.FireCalculationMethod.GetValueOrDefault())
			{
			case FireCalcMethod.FIREUnwetted:
				return FormResource.tooltip_FIREExpAreaOpt_Unwetted;
			case FireCalcMethod.FIREWetted:
			case FireCalcMethod.NFPA30:
				return FormResource.tooltip_FIREExpAreaOpt_Unwetted;
			case FireCalcMethod.SinglePhaseRigorous:
				return FormResource.tooltip_FIREExpAreaOpt_SinglePhaseRigorous;
			case FireCalcMethod.TwoPhaseRigorous:
				return FormResource.tooltip_FIREExpAreaOpt_TwoPhaseRigorous;
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		public string GetMaxTempTooltip()
		{
			if (!vm.FireCalculationMethod.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			FireCalcMethod valueOrDefault = vm.FireCalculationMethod.GetValueOrDefault();
			if (valueOrDefault == FireCalcMethod.FIREUnwetted)
			{
				return FormResource.tooltip_FIREMaxTemp_Unwetted;
			}
			return FormResource.tooltip_FIREMaxTemp_Rigorous;
		}

		public string GetLiquidLevelTooltip()
		{
			return vm.FireCalculationMethod.GetValueOrDefault() switch
			{
				FireCalcMethod.FIREWetted => FormResource.tooltip_FIRELiquidLevel_Wetted, 
				FireCalcMethod.NFPA30 => FormResource.tooltip_FIRELiquidLevel_NFPA30, 
				FireCalcMethod.TwoPhaseRigorous => FormResource.tooltip_FIRELiquidLevel_Semidynamic, 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		private void UnWettedCaseData_Grid_InitializeRecord(object sender, InitializeRecordEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Expected O, but got Unknown
			int index = e.Record.Index;
			DataRecord val = (DataRecord)e.Record;
			FireCalcMethod fireCalcMethod = vm.FireCalculationMethod ?? FireCalcMethod.SinglePhaseRigorous;
			switch (fireCalcMethod)
			{
			case FireCalcMethod.FIREWetted:
			case FireCalcMethod.NFPA30:
				if (index == _WettedAreaExponentRow)
				{
					val.Cells[1].EditorType = typeof(XamTextEditor);
					val.Cells[1].EditorStyle = (Style)base.Resources["editableCellStyle"];
					val.Cells[1].EditAsType = typeof(double);
				}
				else if (fireCalcMethod == FireCalcMethod.FIREWetted && index == _AdequateDrainageRow)
				{
					val.Cells[1].EditorType = typeof(XamComboEditor);
					val.Cells[1].EditorStyle = DrainageStyle;
					val.Cells[1].EditAsType = typeof(bool);
				}
				else if (index == _CalculateLatentHeatRow)
				{
					val.Cells[1].EditorType = typeof(XamComboEditor);
					val.Cells[1].EditorStyle = comboBoxStyle;
				}
				else if (index == _LatentHeatRow)
				{
					val.Cells[1].EditorType = typeof(XamTextEditor);
					val.Cells[1].EditorStyle = LatentHeatStyle;
					val.Cells[1].EditAsType = typeof(double);
				}
				else if (index == _LatentHeatInitPctRow || index == _LatentHeatFinalPctRow)
				{
					val.Cells[1].EditorType = typeof(XamTextEditor);
					val.Cells[1].EditorStyle = VaporizedStyle;
					val.Cells[1].EditAsType = typeof(double);
				}
				else if (index == _IncludeSensibleHeatRow)
				{
					val.Cells[1].EditorType = typeof(XamComboEditor);
					val.Cells[1].EditorStyle = SensibleHeatStyle;
				}
				else if (index == _DisengagementSelectionRow)
				{
					val.Cells[1].EditorType = typeof(XamComboEditor);
					val.Cells[1].EditorStyle = _DisengagementSelectionStyle;
				}
				else if (index == _DisengagementVesselModelRow)
				{
					val.Cells[1].EditorType = typeof(XamComboEditor);
					val.Cells[1].EditorStyle = _DisengagementVesselModelStyle;
				}
				else if (index == _DisengagementRegimeRow)
				{
					val.Cells[1].EditorType = typeof(XamComboEditor);
					val.Cells[1].EditorStyle = _DisengagementRegimeStyle;
				}
				else if (index == _DisengagementC0Row)
				{
					val.Cells[1].EditorType = typeof(XamTextEditor);
					val.Cells[1].EditorStyle = _DisengagementNumberStyle;
				}
				else
				{
					val.Cells[1].EditorType = typeof(XamTextEditor);
					val.Cells[1].EditorStyle = (Style)base.Resources["editableCellStyle"];
					val.Cells[1].EditAsType = typeof(double);
				}
				break;
			case FireCalcMethod.FIREUnwetted:
				if (index == 0)
				{
					val.Cells[1].EditorType = typeof(XamTextEditor);
					val.Cells[1].EditorStyle = (Style)base.Resources["editableCellStyle"];
					val.Cells[1].EditAsType = typeof(double);
				}
				break;
			case FireCalcMethod.TwoPhaseRigorous:
				if (index == 1)
				{
					val.Cells[1].EditorType = typeof(XamComboEditor);
					val.Cells[1].EditorStyle = DrainageStyle;
					val.Cells[1].EditAsType = typeof(bool);
				}
				else
				{
					val.Cells[1].EditorType = typeof(XamTextEditor);
					val.Cells[1].EditorStyle = (Style)base.Resources["editableCellStyle"];
					val.Cells[1].EditAsType = typeof(double);
				}
				break;
			case FireCalcMethod.SinglePhaseRigorous:
				if (index == 1)
				{
					val.Cells[1].EditorType = typeof(XamComboEditor);
					val.Cells[1].EditorStyle = DrainageStyle;
					val.Cells[1].EditAsType = typeof(bool);
				}
				else
				{
					val.Cells[1].EditorType = typeof(XamTextEditor);
					val.Cells[1].EditorStyle = (Style)base.Resources["editableCellStyle"];
					val.Cells[1].EditAsType = typeof(double);
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		private void DisengagementGrid_InitializeRecord(object sender, InitializeRecordEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Expected O, but got Unknown
			int index = e.Record.Index;
			DataRecord val = (DataRecord)e.Record;
			if (_BlankRowsForDisengagement.Contains(index))
			{
				val.Cells[1].EditorType = typeof(XamTextEditor);
				val.Cells[1].EditorStyle = (Style)base.Resources["blankCellStyle"];
				return;
			}
			int num = index;
			if (num == _DisengagementTwoPhaseRow)
			{
				val.Cells[1].EditorType = typeof(XamComboEditor);
				val.Cells[1].EditorStyle = _DisengagementTwoPhaseStyle;
				val.Cells[1].EditAsType = typeof(bool);
			}
			else if (num == _DisengagementLatentHeatRow)
			{
				val.Cells[1].EditorType = typeof(XamTextEditor);
				val.Cells[1].EditorStyle = _DisengagementHvapStyle;
				val.Cells[1].EditAsType = typeof(double);
			}
			else if (num == _DisengagementVesselAreaRow)
			{
				val.Cells[1].EditorType = typeof(XamTextEditor);
				val.Cells[1].EditorStyle = _DisengagementAreaStyle;
				val.Cells[1].EditAsType = typeof(double);
			}
			else if (num == _DisengagementSelectedReliefSourceRow)
			{
				val.Cells[1].EditorType = typeof(XamComboEditor);
				val.Cells[1].EditorStyle = _DisengagementSelectedReliefSourceStyle;
				val.Cells[1].EditAsType = typeof(string);
			}
			else if (num == _DisengagementSelectedReliefRow)
			{
				val.Cells[1].EditorType = typeof(XamComboEditor);
				val.Cells[1].EditorStyle = _DisengagementSelectedReliefStyle;
				val.Cells[1].EditAsType = typeof(string);
			}
			else
			{
				val.Cells[1].EditorType = typeof(XamTextEditor);
				val.Cells[1].EditorStyle = (Style)base.Resources["gridCellStyle"];
				val.Cells[1].EditAsType = typeof(double);
			}
		}

			InitializeVaporizedStyle();
			InitializeStyleForExposedVolume();
			InitializeStyleForNFPALiquidLevel();
			InitializeDisengagementStyles();
		}

		private void InitializeSetters()

		private DataTrigger _GetChangeToReadOnlyTrigger(string propertyName, bool triggerForValue)
		{
			DataTrigger dataTrigger = new DataTrigger();
			dataTrigger.Binding = new System.Windows.Data.Binding
			{
				Path = new PropertyPath(propertyName),
				Source = vm
			};
			dataTrigger.Value = triggerForValue;
			dataTrigger.Setters.Add(setterReadOnly);
			dataTrigger.Setters.Add(setterFontBlack);
			dataTrigger.Setters.Add(setterFontNormal);
			return dataTrigger;
		}

		private MultiDataTrigger _GetChangeToEditableMultitrigger(string firstPropertyName, object firstTriggerForValue, string secondPropertyName, object secondTriggerForValue)
		{
			MultiDataTrigger multiDataTrigger = new MultiDataTrigger();
			multiDataTrigger.Conditions.Add(new Condition(new System.Windows.Data.Binding
			{
				Path = new PropertyPath(firstPropertyName),
				Source = vm
			}, RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(firstTriggerForValue)));
			multiDataTrigger.Conditions.Add(new Condition(new System.Windows.Data.Binding
			{
				Path = new PropertyPath(secondPropertyName),
				Source = vm
			}, RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(secondTriggerForValue)));
			multiDataTrigger.Setters.Add(setterNotReadOnly);
			multiDataTrigger.Setters.Add(setterFontBlue);
			multiDataTrigger.Setters.Add(setterFontBold);
			return multiDataTrigger;
		}

		private MultiDataTrigger _GetChangeToEditableMultitrigger(IEnumerable<(string propertyName, object triggerValue)> triggerSelections)
		{
			MultiDataTrigger multiDataTrigger = new MultiDataTrigger();
			foreach (var triggerSelection in triggerSelections)
			{
				multiDataTrigger.Conditions.Add(new Condition(new System.Windows.Data.Binding
				{
					Path = new PropertyPath(triggerSelection.propertyName),
					Source = vm
				}, RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(triggerSelection.triggerValue)));
			}
			multiDataTrigger.Setters.Add(setterNotReadOnly);
			multiDataTrigger.Setters.Add(setterFontBlue);
			multiDataTrigger.Setters.Add(setterFontBold);
			return multiDataTrigger;
		}

	public class CellValueToTextConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		private double _dbvalue;

		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(value.ToString()))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (double.TryParse(value.ToString(), out _dbvalue))
			{
				if (double.IsNaN(_dbvalue))
				{
					return "";
				}
				return Format.FormatNumber(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(value));
			}
			return value.ToString();
		}

		object IValueConverter.Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			//ILSpy generated this explicit interface implementation from .override directive in Convert
			return this.Convert(value, targetType, parameter, culture);
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			string text = value.ToString().Replace(",", ".");
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			if (double.TryParse(text, NumberStyles.Any, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var result))
			{
				return result;
			}
			return double.NaN;
		}

		object IValueConverter.ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			//ILSpy generated this explicit interface implementation from .override directive in ConvertBack

		}

			//ILSpy generated this explicit interface implementation from .override directive in Convert
			return this.Convert(value, targetType, parameter, culture);
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			string text = value.ToString().Replace(",", ".");
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			if (double.TryParse(text, NumberStyles.Any, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var result))
			{
				return result;
			}
			return double.NaN;
		}

		object IValueConverter.ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			//ILSpy generated this explicit interface implementation from .override directive in ConvertBack
			return this.ConvertBack(value, targetType, parameter, culture);
		}

		public double Value
		{
			get
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(Conversions.ToString(_propertyInfo.GetValue(_vm, null))))
				{
					_value = double.NaN;
				}
				else
				{
					_value = Conversions.ToDouble(_propertyInfo.GetValue(_vm, null));
				}
				return _value;
			}
			set
			{
				checked
				{
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_propertyName) && Operators.CompareString(_propertyInfo.PropertyType.Name, "Double", TextCompare: false) == 0)
					{
						if (double.TryParse(Conversions.ToString(value), out var result))
						{
							if (_propertyInfo.GetIndexParameters().Length > 0)
							{
								object[] array = new object[_propertyInfo.GetIndexParameters().Length - 1 + 1];
								int num = 0;
								ParameterInfo[] indexParameters = _propertyInfo.GetIndexParameters();
								foreach (ParameterInfo parameterInfo in indexParameters)
								{
									array[num] = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(parameterInfo.DefaultValue);
									num++;
								}
								_propertyInfo.SetValue(_vm, result, array);
							}
							else
							{
								_propertyInfo.SetValue(_vm, result, null);
							}
						}
						else
						{
							_propertyInfo.SetValue(_vm, double.NaN, null);
						}
					}
					_value = value;
				}
			}
		}

	public class ValveFailureValueToTextConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		private double _dbvalue;

		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(value.ToString()))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (double.TryParse(value.ToString(), out _dbvalue))
			{
				if (double.IsNaN(_dbvalue))
				{
					return "";
				}
				return Format.FormatNumber(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(value));
			}
			return value.ToString();
		}

		object IValueConverter.Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			//ILSpy generated this explicit interface implementation from .override directive in Convert
			return this.Convert(value, targetType, parameter, culture);
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			string text = value.ToString().Replace(",", ".");
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			if (double.TryParse(text, NumberStyles.Any, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var result))
			{
				return result;
			}
			return double.NaN;
		}

		object IValueConverter.ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			//ILSpy generated this explicit interface implementation from .override directive in ConvertBack

	public class ValveFailurePressureValueToDisplayConverter : IValueConverter
	{

		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)

			if (value == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(value.ToString()))

				return FormResource.str_Empty;

			string text = Format.FormatNumber(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(value));

				string gaugePressDisplayUnit = DefaultUnits.Instance.GaugePressDisplayUnit;

	public class ChokingGridVisibilityConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return System.Windows.Data.Binding.DoNothing;

	public class ValveNameViewModel : BaseViewModel
	{
		private string NodeKey;

		private PRDSystemModel ValveModel;

		private string _name;

		public PRDSystemModel PRDSystemModel => ValveModel;

		public string Name
		{
			get
			{
				return _name;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
				{
					_name = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public ValveNameViewModel(IUnityContainer unityContainer)
			: base(unityContainer)
		{
		}

		public void Initialize(string nodeKey, ref IPsvCase psvcase, PsvKey psvkey)
		{
			NodeKey = nodeKey;
			ValveModel = (PRDSystemModel)psvcase.GetPRDSystemModel(psvkey);
			_name = ValveModel.PRDSystemName;
		}

		public bool UpdateValveNameOrTellUser()
		{
			if (UpdateNames())
			{
				return false;
			}
			string valveRenameErr_Msg = FormResource.ValveRenameErr_Msg;
			string valveRenameErr_Title = FormResource.ValveRenameErr_Title;
			if (Interaction.MsgBox(valveRenameErr_Msg, MsgBoxStyle.RetryCancel, valveRenameErr_Title) == MsgBoxResult.Cancel)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool UpdateNames()
		{
			if (Operators.CompareString(_name, ValveModel.PRDSystemName, TextCompare: false) == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IPSVMessager>(uContainer, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]).SetViewableName(NodeKey, _name))
			{
				string pRDSystemName = ValveModel.PRDSystemName;
				ValveModel.PRDSystemName = _name;
				RenameEventArgs e = new RenameEventArgs
				{
					NewName = ValveModel.PRDSystemName,
					OldName = pRDSystemName,
					Path = NodeKey,
					ObjectType = "ValveName",
					Key = ValveModel.DBKey
				};
				e.Scenarios = ((IEnumerable<PSVScenarioModel>)ValveModel.OverallScenarioModels).Select((Func<PSVScenarioModel, PsvModelKey>)([SpecialName] (PSVScenarioModel scen) => scen.DBKey)).ToList();
				if (uContainer.Parent != null)
				{
					IEventAggregator obj = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(uContainer.Parent, (ResolverOverride[])(object)new ResolverOverride[0]);
					((RoutedCompositePresentationEvent<RenameEventArgs>)obj.GetEvent<RenameEvent>()).Publish(e);
					object objectValue = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(((AspenTech.EquipmentAnalysis.Infrastructure.IBaseModel)ValveModel.Model).DataModel);
					((CompositePresentationEvent<SystemRenamedEventArgs>)obj.GetEvent<SystemRenamedEvent>()).Publish(new SystemRenamedEventArgs(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(objectValue), pRDSystemName));
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

		private void btnOK_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			string text = txtName.Text.Trim();
			if (LikeOperator.LikeString(text, "*[!,.)'( _0-9A-Za-z(?)-]*", CompareMethod.Binary))
			{
				System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(FormResource.PRDNameErrorPrompt_Specialsymbol, FormResource.PSVSizing, MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Hand);
			}
			else
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					return;
				}
				if (Regex.IsMatch(text, "[^\\u0000-\\u007F]"))
				{
					System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(FormResource.PRDNameErrorPrompt_NONASCII, FormResource.PSVSizing, MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Hand);
					return;
				}
				vm.Name = text;
				if (!vm.UpdateValveNameOrTellUser())
				{
					MyWindow.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		private void btnCancel_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			MyWindow.Close();
		}

		private bool ValidAspenID(string check)
		{
			char[] array = check.ToCharArray();
			int num = checked(array.Length - 1);
			for (int i = 0; i <= num; i = checked(i + 1))
			{
				if (i == 0)
				{
					if (!char.IsLetterOrDigit(array[i]))
					{
						return false;
					}
					continue;
				}
				char c = array[i];
				if (!((char.IsLetterOrDigit(c) || c == ',' || c == '$' || c == ':' || c == '+' || c == '-') | (Convert.ToInt32(c) == 13) | (Convert.ToInt32(c) == 8)))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void txtName_PreviewTextInput(object sender, TextCompositionEventArgs e)
		{
			if (IsAspenPlus)
			{
				int caretIndex = txtName.CaretIndex;
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(txtName.Text);
				if (txtName.SelectedText.Trim().Length > 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Replace(txtName.SelectedText, e.Text);
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.Insert(caretIndex, e.Text);
				}
				if ((stringBuilder.Length > 8) | !ValidAspenID(stringBuilder.ToString()))
				{
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
		}

			e.Handled = true;
		}

		public void CreatePassThroughs()
		{
			_service = (ITextBoxProcessVar)new ProcessVarPassThrough<PSVTankViewModel, string>(Vm, (PSVTankViewModel vm) => vm.Service, SpecifierType.User);
			_fluidName = (ITextBoxProcessVar)new ProcessVarPassThrough<PSVTankViewModel, string>(Vm, (PSVTankViewModel vm) => vm.HostStream, SpecifierType.User);
			_calcCode = new ProcessEnumFromListPassThrough<PSVTankViewModel, StorageTankCalcCode>(Vm, (PSVTankViewModel vm) => vm.CalcCodeAsIndex, SpecifierType.User, Vm.TankDesignCode, TranslateUiStrings.StorageTankCalcCode.Enum, StorageTankCalcCode.Api_650);
			_barometricPressure = new ProcessQuantityPassThrough<PSVTankViewModel, PressureDifference>(Vm, (PSVTankViewModel vm) => vm.AtmPress, SpecifierType.User, null);
			_inFlow = new ProcessQuantityPassThrough<PSVTankViewModel, VolumeFlow>(Vm, (PSVTankViewModel vm) => vm.InFlow, SpecifierType.User, null);
			_outFlow = new ProcessQuantityPassThrough<PSVTankViewModel, VolumeFlow>(Vm, (PSVTankViewModel vm) => vm.OutFlow, SpecifierType.User, null);
			_tankType = new ProcessEnumPassThrough<PSVTankViewModel, VesselTypeEnum>(Vm, (PSVTankViewModel vm) => vm.TankType, SpecifierType.User, VesselTypeEnum.Horizontal);
			_diameter = new ProcessQuantityPassThrough<PSVTankViewModel, Distance>(Vm, (PSVTankViewModel vm) => vm.Diameter, SpecifierType.User, null);
			_height = new ProcessQuantityPassThrough<PSVTankViewModel, Distance>(Vm, (PSVTankViewModel vm) => vm.Height, SpecifierType.User, null);
			_normalDeviceItem = new ProcessStringPassThrough<PSVTankViewModel>(Vm, (PSVTankViewModel vm) => vm.NormDevName, SpecifierType.User);
			_thermalInBreath = new ProcessQuantityPassThrough<PSVTankViewModel, StandardVolumeFlow>(Vm, (PSVTankViewModel vm) => vm.ThermInBreath, SpecifierType.Calculation, null);
			_thermalOutBreath = new ProcessQuantityPassThrough<PSVTankViewModel, StandardVolumeFlow>(Vm, (PSVTankViewModel vm) => vm.ThermOutBreath, SpecifierType.Calculation, null);
			_inBreathing = new ProcessQuantityPassThrough<PSVTankViewModel, StandardVolumeFlow>(Vm, (PSVTankViewModel vm) => vm.InBreathing, SpecifierType.Calculation, null);
			_outBreathing = new ProcessQuantityPassThrough<PSVTankViewModel, StandardVolumeFlow>(Vm, (PSVTankViewModel vm) => vm.OutBreathing, SpecifierType.Calculation, null);
			_totalInBreathing = new ProcessQuantityPassThrough<PSVTankViewModel, StandardVolumeFlow>(Vm, (PSVTankViewModel vm) => vm.TotInBreathing, SpecifierType.Calculation, null);
			_totalOutBreathing = new ProcessQuantityPassThrough<PSVTankViewModel, StandardVolumeFlow>(Vm, (PSVTankViewModel vm) => vm.TotOutBreathing, SpecifierType.Calculation, null);
			_designPressure = new ProcessPressurePassThrough<PSVTankViewModel>(Vm, (PSVTankViewModel vm) => vm.DesPress, SpecifierType.User, PressureReference.Gauge, null);
			_designVacuum = new ProcessQuantityPassThrough<PSVTankViewModel, PressureDifference>(Vm, (PSVTankViewModel vm) => vm.TankDesVacuum, SpecifierType.User, null);
			_f = new ProcessDoublePassThrough<PSVTankViewModel>(Vm, (PSVTankViewModel vm) => vm.Coeff_F, SpecifierType.User);
